Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value:
BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
--10/17/23 --DECLARE @SQL VARCHAR(6000) = '' --DECLARE @Where VARCHAR(1000) = '' DECLARE @SQL VARCHAR(MAX) = '' DECLARE @Where VARCHAR(MAX) = ''
--6/14/23 - added case statement to join of AIMSourceLocationGuarantee table. --4/20/21 - added AIMNutrientCode to Select statement (so report can be sorted by nutrient code or name)
--exec usp_Report_AIMSourceLocationGuarantees '5/11/2020 12:00:00 AM', '5/11/2020 12:00:00 AM', 0, 0, 0, 1, 'R' -- exec usp_Report_AIMSourceLocationGuarantees @ToDate = '8/24/2023 12:00:00 AM', @FromDate='1/01/2020 12:00:00 AM', @Flag=1, @AdjustedOrResult='R'
--------------------------------------------- -- The adjusted moisture on the report is calculated in the Entity:
-- EX: -- 15.574 - Protein result -- 12.432 - Moisture for (for the sample) -- 13 - Adjusted moisture for Protein (coming from maintenace) -- -- Calculation = 100 - 12.432 = 87.5678 -- 100 - 13 = 87 -- 87 / 87.5678 = .993518377 (dry matter) -- -- Final result: 15.574 * .993518377 = 16.5678 ---------------------------------------------
SET @Where = 'WHERE AM.MaterialTypeID = 1 and S.IsActive = 1 and ASLG.IsActive = 1 ' if @FromDate IS NOT NULL SET @Where += ' AND S.SampleDate >= ''' + Convert(varchar,Cast(@FromDate as datetime), 120) + ''' ' if @ToDate IS NOT NULL SET @Where += ' AND S.SampleDate <= ''' + Convert(varchar,Cast(@ToDate as datetime), 120) + ''' ' if @AimMaterialID IS NOT NULL and @AimMaterialID > 0 SET @Where += ' AND S.AimMaterialID = ' + Convert(varchar,@AimMaterialID) + ' ' if @Source IS NOT NULL and @Source > 0 SET @Where += ' AND S.AimSourceID = ' + Convert(varchar,@Source) + ' '
if @SourceLocation IS NOT NULL Begin if @SourceLocation > 0 SET @Where += ' AND S.AimSourceLocationID = ' + Convert(varchar,@SourceLocation) + ' ' End
--SET @Where += ' AND CASE WHEN SR.ResultValue > ASLG.[Min] OR (SR.ResultValue > ASLG.[Max] AND ASLG.[Max] != 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END = 1 '
-- Waiting to hear what Versova wants to do with samples that don't have a moisture nutrient --SET @Where += ' and (Select top 1 ResultValue from dbo.SampleResult R -- inner join dbo.AIMNutrientRefAnalyzerNutrient x on R.AnalyzerNutrientID = x.AnalyzerNutrientID -- inner join dbo.SystemSettings ss on ss.AIMNutrientID = x.AIMNutrientID -- where R.sampleid = S.SampleID) > 0 '
--6/16/23 - added check of flag and added AdjustedOrResult (Mountaire) if @Flag = 1 Begin if @AdjustedOrResult = 'A' SET @Where += ' and ASLG.Moisture > 0 ' else if @AdjustedOrResult = 'R' SET @Where += ' and (SR.ResultValue < ASLG.[Min] OR (SR.ResultValue > ASLG.[Max] and ASLG.[Max] <> 0)) ' End
SET @SQL = 'SELECT DISTINCT ' If @ToDate is NOT NULL SET @Sql += '''' + convert(varchar,@ToDate) + ''' as ToDate, ' If @FromDate IS NOT NULL SET @Sql += '''' + convert(varchar,@FromDate) + ''' as FromDate, '
SET @SQL += ' S.SampleID , S.SampleCode , S.SampleDate , S.AIMMaterialID , S.AimSourceID , S.AimSourceLocationID , S.AIMMaterialID , S.LoadNumber , S.BillOfLoad , SA.AIMNutrientID , SA.AIMUsedValue , SA.SampleResultID , SR.AnalyzerNutrientID , SR.ResultValue , AMS.SourceName , ASL.SourceLocationName , AM.AIMMaterialName , AN.AIMNutrientName , AN.AIMNutrientCode , AOL.LocationCode as OwnerLocationCode , AOL.LocationName as OwnerLocationName , ASLG.Min , ASLG.Max , ASLG.Moisture
, CASE WHEN SR.ResultValue < ASLG.[Min] OR (SR.ResultValue > ASLG.[Max] AND ASLG.[Max] != 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Flag
, (Select top 1 ResultValue from dbo.SampleResult R inner join dbo.AIMNutrientRefAnalyzerNutrient x on R.AnalyzerNutrientID = x.AnalyzerNutrientID inner join dbo.SystemSettings ss on ss.AIMNutrientID = x.AIMNutrientID where R.sampleid = S.SampleID ) as SampleMoisture
, (Select top 1 ResultValue from dbo.SampleResult R inner join dbo.AIMNutrientRefAnalyzerNutrient x on R.AnalyzerNutrientID = x.AnalyzerNutrientID inner join dbo.SystemSettings ss on ss.DryMatterAIMNutrientID = x.AIMNutrientID where R.sampleid = S.SampleID ) as SampleDryMatter
, CASE WHEN (Select top 1 ResultValue from dbo.SampleResult R inner join dbo.AIMNutrientRefAnalyzerNutrient x on R.AnalyzerNutrientID = x.AnalyzerNutrientID inner join dbo.SystemSettings ss on ss.AIMNutrientID = x.AIMNutrientID where R.sampleid = S.SampleID ) = 0 AND (Select top 1 ResultValue from dbo.SampleResult R inner join dbo.AIMNutrientRefAnalyzerNutrient x on R.AnalyzerNutrientID = x.AnalyzerNutrientID inner join dbo.SystemSettings ss on ss.DryMatterAIMNutrientID = x.AIMNutrientID where R.sampleid = S.SampleID ) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS FlagBothZero
FROM dbo.Sample S with (nolock) INNER JOIN dbo.SampleAIM SA with (nolock) ON SA.SampleID = S.SampleID INNER JOIN dbo.SampleResult SR with (nolock) ON SR.SampleResultID = SA.SampleResultID INNER JOIN dbo.AIMSourceLocationGuarantee ASLG with (nolock) ON S.AimSourceID = ASLG.AIMSourceID AND S.AimSourceLocationID = case when ASLG.AIMSourceLocationID = 0 then S.AimSourceLocationID else ASLG.AIMSourceLocationID end '
if @SourceLocation IS NOT NULL Begin if @SourceLocation > 0 SET @Sql += ' AND S.AIMSourceLocationID = ASLG.AIMSourceLocationID ' End
SET @Sql += '
AND S.AIMMaterialID = ASLG.AIMMaterialID AND SA.AIMNutrientID = ASLG.AIMNutrientID
LEFT JOIN dbo.AIMSource AMS with (nolock) on S.AIMSourceID = AMS.AIMSourceID LEFT JOIN dbo.AIMSourceLocation ASL with (nolock) on S.AIMSourceLocationID = ASL.AIMSourceLocationID LEFT JOIN dbo.AIMMaterial AM with (nolock) on S.AIMMaterialID = AM.AIMMaterialID LEFT JOIN dbo.AIMNutrient AN with (nolock) on SA.AIMNutrientID = AN.AIMNutrientID LEFT JOIN dbo.AIMOwnerLocation AOL with (nolock) on S.AIMOwnerLocationID = AOL.AIMOwnerLocationID
' + @Where
EXEC (@SQL) --print @sql
END

-- 4/20/22 - added S.TicketNumber to Select stmt
IF @SampleOwnerID = 0 BEGIN SET @SampleOwnerID = NULL END
IF @AIMOwnerLocationID = 0 BEGIN SET @AIMOwnerLocationID = NULL END
IF @AIMSourceID = 0 BEGIN SET @AIMSourceID = NULL END
IF @AIMSourceLocationID = 0 BEGIN SET @AIMSourceLocationID = NULL END
IF @AIMMaterialID = 0 BEGIN SET @AIMMaterialID = NULL END
IF Len(@Ticket) = 0 BEGIN SET @Ticket = NULL END
IF @QueryTemplateID IS NULL BEGIN
SET @Where = 'WHERE AM.MaterialTypeID = 1 and '

--4/27/18 --if @FromDate IS NOT NULL -- SET @Where += ' SR.AnalysisDate >= ''' + Convert(varchar,Cast(@FromDate as datetime), 120) + ''' and ' --if @ToDate IS NOT NULL -- SET @Where += ' SR.AnalysisDate <= ''' + Convert(varchar,Cast(@ToDate as datetime), 120) + ''' and ' if @FromDate IS NOT NULL SET @Where += ' S.SampleDate >= ''' + Convert(varchar,Cast(@FromDate as datetime), 120) + ''' and ' if @ToDate IS NOT NULL SET @Where += ' S.SampleDate <= ''' + Convert(varchar,Cast(@ToDate as datetime), 120) + ''' and '
if Right(@Where,4) = 'and ' Set @Where = Left(@Where,len(@Where) - 4)
END ELSE BEGIN
-- These functions create the where statements the query will use EXEC @Where = [dbo].[AnalysisReports_WhereStatement] @QueryTemplateID EXEC @CFCWhere = [dbo].[AnalysisReports_CFCIngredient_WhereStatement] @QueryTemplateID EXEC @MatNutWhere = [dbo].[AnalysisReports_MaterialNutrient_WhereStatement] @QueryTemplateID
SET @Where = ' WHERE S.IsActive = 1 ' + @Where IF LEN(@MatNutWhere) > 0 SET @Where += @MatNutWhere END
SET @SQL = 'SELECT '
If @ToDate is NOT NULL SET @Sql += '''' + convert(varchar,@ToDate) + ''' as ToDate, ' If @FromDate IS NOT NULL SET @Sql += '''' + convert(varchar,@FromDate) + ''' as FromDate, '
SET @SQL += ' case when len(S.SampleCode) > 0 then S.SampleCode Else convert(nvarchar,S.SampleID) end as SampleCode , SA.AimUsedValue as ResultValue , AO.OwnerName , AOL.LocationName , SS.SourceName , SL.SourceLocationName , AN.AIMNutrientCode , AN.AIMNutrientName
, 0 as CFCProductID , '''' as CFCProductCode , '''' as CFCProductName , CI.CFCIngredientID , CI.CFCIngredientCode , CI.CFCIngredientName
, UT.UnitTypeDescription as Unit , AM.AIMMaterialCode AS MaterialCode , AM.AIMMaterialName AS MaterialName , SR.AnalyzerNutrientCode , convert(varchar(20),S.SampleDate, 101) as StringSampleDate , S.TicketNumber
FROM dbo.Sample S WITH(NOLOCK) INNER JOIN dbo.SampleResult SR WITH(NOLOCK) ON SR.SampleID = S.SampleID AND SR.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN dbo.SampleAIM SA WITH(NOLOCK) ON SA.SampleID = S.SampleID AND SA.SampleResultID = SR.SampleResultID AND SA.IsActive = 1 LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.CFCIngredientRefAIMMaterial CIRAM WITH(NOLOCK) ON CIRAM.AIMMaterialID = S.AIMMaterialID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.CFCIngredient CI WITH(NOLOCK) ON CI.CFCIngredientID = CIRAM.CFCIngredientID AND CI.AimDatabaseID = ' + Convert(varchar, @AimDataBaseID) + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMOwner AO WITH(NOLOCK) ON AO.AIMOwnerID = S.AIMOwnerID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMMaterial AM WITH(NOLOCK) ON AM.AIMMaterialID = S.AIMMaterialID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMOwnerLocation AOL WITH(NOLOCK) ON AOL.AIMOwnerLocationID = S.AIMOwnerLocationID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMSource SS WITH(NOLOCK) ON SS.AIMSourceID = S.AIMSourceID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMSourceLocation SL WITH(NOLOCK) ON SL.AIMSourceLocationID = S.AIMSourceLocationID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMNutrient AN WITH(NOLOCK) ON AN.AIMNutrientID = SA.AIMNutrientID AND AN.IsActive = 1 LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.UnitType UT with (nolock) ON AN.UnitTypeID = UT.UnitTypeID
' + @Where + ' ' +
@CFCWhere +
' ORDER BY S.SampleCode '
EXEC (@SQL) --print @SQL
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_Report_AnalysisDetail_Product] @SampleOwnerID INT = NULL , @AIMOwnerLocationID INT = NULL , @AIMSourceID INT = NULL , @AIMSourceLocationID INT = NULL , @ToDate DATE = NULL , @FromDate DATE = NULL , @AIMMaterialID INT = NULL , @Ticket NVARCHAR(20) = NULL , @AimDataBaseID INT = NULL , @QueryTemplateID INT = NULL
--exec usp_Report_AnalysisDetail_Product 1, 47, 0, 0, '2018-04-19', '2018-01-01', 0, '', 2
AS

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value:
BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
--10/17/23 --DECLARE @SQL VARCHAR(6000) = '' --DECLARE @Where VARCHAR(6000) = '' --DECLARE @WhereValue VARCHAR(6000) = '' DECLARE @SQL VARCHAR(MAX) = '' DECLARE @Where VARCHAR(MAX) = '' DECLARE @WhereValue VARCHAR(MAX) = ''
DECLARE @MoistureID INT = 0
-- Used for Dry-Matter Base calculation SET @MoistureID = (Select TOP 1 AIMNutrientID from dbo.SystemSettings with (nolock))
IF @SampleOwnerID = 0 BEGIN SET @SampleOwnerID = NULL END
IF @AIMOwnerLocationID = 0 SET @AIMOwnerLocationID = NULL IF @AIMSourceID = 0 SET @AIMSourceID = NULL IF @AIMSourceLocationID = 0 SET @AIMSourceLocationID = NULL IF @AIMMaterialID = 0 SET @AIMMaterialID = NULL IF Len(@Ticket) = 0 SET @Ticket = NULL
IF @AIMMaterialList IS NULL SET @AIMMaterialList = '' IF @AIMMaterialList2 IS NULL SET @AIMMaterialList2 = '' IF @AIMMaterialList3 IS NULL SET @AIMMaterialList3 = ''
SET @AIMMaterialList = @AIMMaterialList + @AIMMaterialList2 + @AIMMaterialList3 SELECT AIMMaterialID, AIMMaterialCode, AIMMaterialName INTO ##TempMaterial FROM AIMMaterial WHERE AIMMaterialID IN( SELECT CAST(Item AS INTEGER) FROM dbo.SplitString(@AIMMaterialList, ','))
IF @QueryTemplateID IS NULL BEGIN
SET @Where = 'WHERE AN.IsActive = 1 AND S.IsActive = 1 and AM.AIMMaterialName IS NOT NULL '
if @SampleOwnerID IS NOT NULL SET @Where += ' and S.AIMOwnerID = ' + Cast(@SampleOwnerID as varchar) + ' ' if @AIMOwnerLocationID IS NOT NULL SET @Where += ' and S.AIMOwnerLocationID = ' + Cast(@AIMOwnerLocationID as varchar) + ' ' if @AIMSourceID IS NOT NULL SET @Where += ' and S.AIMSourceID = ' + Cast(@AIMSourceID as varchar) + ' ' if @AIMSourceLocationID IS NOT NULL SET @Where += ' and S.AIMSourceLocationID = ' + Cast(@AIMSourceLocationID as varchar) + ' ' if @AIMMaterialID IS NOT NULL SET @Where += ' and S.AIMMaterialID = ' + Cast(@AIMMaterialID as varchar) + ' ' if @Ticket IS NOT NULL SET @Where += ' and S.TicketNumber = ''' + Cast(@Ticket as varchar) + ''' ' if @FromDate IS NOT NULL SET @Where += ' and S.SampleDate >= ''' + Convert(varchar,Cast(@FromDate as datetime), 120) + ''' ' if @ToDate IS NOT NULL SET @Where += ' and S.SampleDate <= ''' + Convert(varchar,Cast(@ToDate as datetime), 120) + ''' '
--print @Where END
ELSE
BEGIN SET @Where = ''
--- This create the where statement that the query will be using DECLARE WhereCur CURSOR FOR SELECT CASE WHEN QTD.IsAnd = 0 THEN 'OR ' ELSE 'AND ' END + QF.FieldName + ' ' + CASE WHEN QTD.Value > 0 THEN REPLACE(QO.Command, '@VALUE', QTD.Value) ELSE REPLACE(QO.Command, '@VALUE', '''' + CAST(QTD.DateValue AS VARCHAR) + '''') END AS WhereValue FROM dbo.QueryTemplateDetail QTD INNER JOIN dbo.QueryField QF ON QF.QueryFieldID = QTD.QueryFieldID INNER JOIN dbo.QueryOperation QO ON QO.QueryOperationID = QTD.QueryOperationID WHERE QTD.QueryTemplateID = @QueryTemplateID
OPEN WhereCur FETCH NEXT FROM WhereCur INTO @WhereValue WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN IF @Where = '' SET @Where += 'WHERE ' + SUBSTRING(@WhereValue, 5, LEN(@WhereValue)) ELSE SET @Where += ' ' + @WhereValue FETCH NEXT FROM WhereCur INTO @WhereValue END CLOSE WhereCur DEALLOCATE WhereCur END
IF @DryMatterBase = 1 Begin SET @SQL = ' SELECT S.SampleID , SUM(SA.AIMUsedValue) as ResultValue , 100 - SUM(SA.AIMUsedValue) as DryMatter , 100/(100 - SUM(SA.AIMUsedValue)) as AdjDryMatter INTO ##DryMatter FROM dbo.Sample S WITH(NOLOCK) INNER JOIN dbo.SampleAIM SA WITH(NOLOCK) ON SA.SampleID = S.SampleID AND SA.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN dbo.SampleResult SR WITH(NOLOCK) ON SR.SampleResultID = SA.SampleResultID AND SR.IsActive = 1 '
IF Len(@AIMMaterialList) > 0 SET @SQL = @SQL + 'INNER JOIN ##TempMaterial AM on S.AIMMaterialID = AM.AIMMaterialID ' else SET @SQL = @SQL + 'INNER JOIN dbo.AIMMaterial AM WITH(NOLOCK) ON AM.AIMMaterialID = S.AIMMaterialID ' SET @SQL = @SQL + '
LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMNutrient AN WITH(NOLOCK) ON AN.AIMNutrientID = SA.AIMNutrientID ' + @Where + ' and AN.AIMNutrientID = ' + Cast(@MoistureID as varchar) + ' GROUP BY S.SampleID ' EXEC (@SQL) --print (@SQL) End
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- SET @SQL = 'SELECT '
If @ToDate is NOT NULL SET @Sql += '''' + convert(varchar,@ToDate) + ''' as ToDate, ' If @FromDate IS NOT NULL SET @Sql += '''' + convert(varchar,@FromDate) + ''' as FromDate, '
-- * * * Added MaterialNameTotal field because on the Pivot Report, the Material Name is the FieldValue, -- which shows up in both the column headers and in the grand totals. Needed more space for the nutrient columns, -- so shrunk the MaterialName column header so only the first 2 or 3 digits appear. (Didn't want to see just part -- of the material name, so put spaces at the beginning - so spaces show up instead - but the whole material name -- still shows up in the grand total.)
SET @SQL += ' case when len(S.SampleCode) > 0 then S.SampleCode else convert(nvarchar,S.SampleID) end as SampleCode , S.SampleID , S.SampleDate , AN.AIMNutrientCode , case when AN.AIMNutrientShortName IS NULL OR LEN(AN.AIMNutrientShortName) = 0 then LEFT(AN.AIMNutrientName,15) else AN.AIMNutrientShortName End as AIMNutrientName , UT.UnitTypeDescription , convert(varchar, aimnutrientname) + '' - '' + convert(varchar, unittypedescription) as AIMNutrientHeading , convert(varchar, CAST(WL.Min AS DECIMAL(3,1)) ) + ''-'' + convert(varchar, CAST(WL.Max AS DECIMAL(3,1)) ) as MinMaxRange , AM.AIMMaterialCode AS MaterialCode , AM.AIMMaterialName as MaterialName , ' + ''' ''+' + 'AM.AIMMaterialName AS MaterialNameTotal , SS.SourceName , SL.SourceLocationName '
IF @DryMatterBase = 1 SET @SQL += ', TT.AdjDryMatter , case when AN.AIMNutrientID = ' + Cast(@MoistureID as varchar) + ' then 0 else SUM(SA.AIMUsedValue) * TT.AdjDryMatter end as ResultValue ' Else SET @SQL += ', SUM(SA.AIMUsedValue) as ResultValue '
SET @SQL += ' FROM dbo.Sample S WITH(NOLOCK) INNER JOIN dbo.SampleResult SR WITH(NOLOCK) ON S.SampleID = SR.SampleID AND SR.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN dbo.SampleAIM SA WITH(NOLOCK) ON SA.SampleID = S.SampleID AND SR.SampleResultID = SA.SampleResultID and SA.IsActive = 1 '
IF Len(@AIMMaterialList) > 0 SET @SQL = @SQL + 'INNER JOIN ##TempMaterial AM on S.AIMMaterialID = AM.AIMMaterialID ' else SET @SQL = @SQL + 'INNER JOIN dbo.AIMMaterial AM WITH(NOLOCK) ON AM.AIMMaterialID = S.AIMMaterialID ' SET @SQL = @SQL + '
LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMOwner AO WITH(NOLOCK) ON AO.AIMOwnerID = S.AIMOwnerID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMOwnerLocation AOL WITH(NOLOCK) ON AOL.AIMOwnerLocationID = S.AIMOwnerLocationID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMSource SS WITH(NOLOCK) ON SS.AIMSourceID = S.AIMSourceID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMSourceLocation SL WITH(NOLOCK) ON SL.AIMSourceLocationID = S.AIMSourceLocationID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMNutrient AN WITH(NOLOCK) ON AN.AIMNutrientID = SA.AIMNutrientID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.UnitType UT with (nolock) ON AN.UnitTypeID = UT.UnitTypeID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.WarningLimits WL with (nolock) ON AN.AIMNutrientID = WL.AIMNutrientID AND AM.AIMMaterialID = WL.AIMMaterialID '
IF @DryMatterBase = 1 SET @SQL += ' INNER JOIN ##DryMatter TT ON S.SampleID = TT.SampleID '
SET @SQL += ' ' + @Where + ' '
SET @SQL += 'GROUP BY case when len(S.SampleCode) > 0 then S.SampleCode else convert(nvarchar,S.SampleID) end , S.SampleID , S.SampleDate , AN.AIMNutrientCode , AN.AIMNutrientName , AN.AIMNutrientShortName , AM.AIMMaterialCode , AM.AIMMaterialName , UT.UnitTypeDescription , WL.Min , WL.Max , SS.SourceName , SL.SourceLocationName '
IF @DryMatterBase = 1 SET @SQL += ', TT.AdjDryMatter, AN.AIMNutrientID '
EXEC (@SQL) --Print @SQL
IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM tempdb.sys.tables WHERE [name] like '##TempMaterial%') DROP TABLE ##TempMaterial IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM tempdb.sys.tables WHERE [name] like '##DryMatter%') DROP TABLE ##DryMatter
END

IF Len(@AIMMaterialList) > 0 SET @SQL = @SQL + 'INNER JOIN ##TempMaterial AM on S.AIMMaterialID = AM.AIMMaterialID ' else SET @SQL = @SQL + 'INNER JOIN dbo.AIMMaterial AM WITH(NOLOCK) ON AM.AIMMaterialID = S.AIMMaterialID ' SET @SQL = @SQL + '
LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMOwner AO WITH(NOLOCK) ON AO.AIMOwnerID = S.AIMOwnerID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMOwnerLocation AOL WITH(NOLOCK) ON AOL.AIMOwnerLocationID = S.AIMOwnerLocationID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMSource SS WITH(NOLOCK) ON SS.AIMSourceID = S.AIMSourceID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMSourceLocation SL WITH(NOLOCK) ON SL.AIMSourceLocationID = S.AIMSourceLocationID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMNutrient AN WITH(NOLOCK) ON AN.AIMNutrientID = SA.AIMNutrientID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.UnitType UT with (nolock) ON AN.UnitTypeID = UT.UnitTypeID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.WarningLimits WL with (nolock) ON AN.AIMNutrientID = WL.AIMNutrientID AND AM.AIMMaterialID = WL.AIMMaterialID '
IF @DryMatterBase = 1 SET @SQL += ' INNER JOIN ##DryMatter TT ON S.SampleID = TT.SampleID '
SET @SQL += ' ' + @Where + ' '
SET @SQL += 'GROUP BY AOL.LocationName, AO.AIMOwnerID, AM.AIMMaterialCode , case when len(S.SampleCode) > 0 then S.SampleCode else convert(nvarchar,S.SampleID) end , S.SampleID , S.SampleDate , AN.AIMNutrientCode , AN.AIMNutrientName , AN.AIMNutrientShortName , AM.AIMMaterialName , UT.UnitTypeDescription , WL.Min , WL.Max ,SS.SourceName , SL.SourceLocationName '
IF @DryMatterBase = 1 SET @SQL += ', TT.AdjDryMatter, AN.AIMNutrientID '
SET @SQL += 'ORDER BY AM.AIMMaterialCode, AOL.LocationName, case when len(S.SampleCode) > 0 then S.SampleCode else convert(nvarchar,S.SampleID) end , S.SampleDate '
EXEC (@SQL) --Print @SQL
IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM tempdb.sys.tables WHERE [name] like '##TempMaterial%') DROP TABLE ##TempMaterial IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM tempdb.sys.tables WHERE [name] like '##DryMatter%') DROP TABLE ##DryMatter
END

BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
--10/17/23 --DECLARE @SQL VARCHAR(6000) = '' --DECLARE @Where VARCHAR(6000) = '' --DECLARE @WhereValue VARCHAR(6000) = '' DECLARE @SQL VARCHAR(MAX) = '' DECLARE @Where VARCHAR(MAX) = '' DECLARE @WhereValue VARCHAR(MAX) = ''
DECLARE @MoistureID INT = 0
-- Used for Dry-Matter Base calculation SET @MoistureID = (Select TOP 1 AIMNutrientID from dbo.SystemSettings with (nolock))
IF @SampleOwnerID = 0 BEGIN SET @SampleOwnerID = NULL END
IF @AIMOwnerLocationID = 0 SET @AIMOwnerLocationID = NULL IF @AIMSourceID = 0 SET @AIMSourceID = NULL IF @AIMSourceLocationID = 0 SET @AIMSourceLocationID = NULL IF @AIMMaterialID = 0 SET @AIMMaterialID = NULL IF Len(@Ticket) = 0 SET @Ticket = NULL
IF @AIMMaterialList IS NULL SET @AIMMaterialList = '' IF @AIMMaterialList2 IS NULL SET @AIMMaterialList2 = '' IF @AIMMaterialList3 IS NULL SET @AIMMaterialList3 = ''
SET @AIMMaterialList = @AIMMaterialList + @AIMMaterialList2 + @AIMMaterialList3 SELECT AIMMaterialID, AIMMaterialCode, AIMMaterialName INTO ##TempMaterial FROM AIMMaterial WHERE AIMMaterialID IN( SELECT CAST(Item AS INTEGER) FROM dbo.SplitString(@AIMMaterialList, ','))
IF @QueryTemplateID IS NULL BEGIN
SET @Where = 'WHERE AN.IsActive = 1 AND S.IsActive = 1 and AM.AIMMaterialName IS NOT NULL '
if @SampleOwnerID IS NOT NULL SET @Where += ' and S.AIMOwnerID = ' + Cast(@SampleOwnerID as varchar) + ' ' if @AIMOwnerLocationID IS NOT NULL SET @Where += ' and S.AIMOwnerLocationID = ' + Cast(@AIMOwnerLocationID as varchar) + ' ' if @AIMSourceID IS NOT NULL SET @Where += ' and S.AIMSourceID = ' + Cast(@AIMSourceID as varchar) + ' ' if @AIMSourceLocationID IS NOT NULL SET @Where += ' and S.AIMSourceLocationID = ' + Cast(@AIMSourceLocationID as varchar) + ' ' if @AIMMaterialID IS NOT NULL SET @Where += ' and S.AIMMaterialID = ' + Cast(@AIMMaterialID as varchar) + ' ' if @Ticket IS NOT NULL SET @Where += ' and S.TicketNumber = ''' + Cast(@Ticket as varchar) + ''' ' if @FromDate IS NOT NULL SET @Where += ' and S.SampleDate >= ''' + Convert(varchar,Cast(@FromDate as datetime), 120) + ''' ' if @ToDate IS NOT NULL SET @Where += ' and S.SampleDate <= ''' + Convert(varchar,Cast(@ToDate as datetime), 120) + ''' '
--print @Where END
ELSE
BEGIN SET @Where = ''
--- This creates the where statement that the query will be using DECLARE WhereCur CURSOR FOR SELECT CASE WHEN QTD.IsAnd = 0 THEN 'OR ' ELSE 'AND ' END + QF.FieldName + ' ' + CASE WHEN QTD.Value > 0 THEN REPLACE(QO.Command, '@VALUE', QTD.Value) ELSE REPLACE(QO.Command, '@VALUE', '''' + CAST(QTD.DateValue AS VARCHAR) + '''') END AS WhereValue FROM dbo.QueryTemplateDetail QTD INNER JOIN dbo.QueryField QF ON QF.QueryFieldID = QTD.QueryFieldID INNER JOIN dbo.QueryOperation QO ON QO.QueryOperationID = QTD.QueryOperationID WHERE QTD.QueryTemplateID = @QueryTemplateID
OPEN WhereCur FETCH NEXT FROM WhereCur INTO @WhereValue WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN IF @Where = '' SET @Where += 'WHERE ' + SUBSTRING(@WhereValue, 5, LEN(@WhereValue)) ELSE SET @Where += ' ' + @WhereValue FETCH NEXT FROM WhereCur INTO @WhereValue END CLOSE WhereCur DEALLOCATE WhereCur END
IF @DryMatterBase = 1 Begin SET @SQL = ' SELECT AOL.LocationName, M.AIMMaterialCode, SUM(SA.AIMUsedValue) as ResultValue , 100 - SUM(SA.AIMUsedValue) as DryMatter , 100/(100 - SUM(SA.AIMUsedValue)) as AdjDryMatter INTO ##DryMatter FROM dbo.Sample S WITH(NOLOCK) INNER JOIN dbo.SampleAIM SA WITH(NOLOCK) ON SA.SampleID = S.SampleID AND SA.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN dbo.SampleResult SR WITH(NOLOCK) ON SR.SampleResultID = SA.SampleResultID AND SR.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN dbo.AimOwnerLocation AOL on S.AIMOwnerLocationID = AOL.AIMOwnerLocationID INNER JOIN dbo.AIMMaterial M on S.AIMMaterialID = M.AimMaterialID '
IF Len(@AIMMaterialList) > 0 SET @SQL = @SQL + 'INNER JOIN ##TempMaterial AM on S.AIMMaterialID = AM.AIMMaterialID ' else SET @SQL = @SQL + 'INNER JOIN dbo.AIMMaterial AM WITH(NOLOCK) ON AM.AIMMaterialID = S.AIMMaterialID ' SET @SQL = @SQL + '
LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMNutrient AN WITH(NOLOCK) ON AN.AIMNutrientID = SA.AIMNutrientID ' + @Where + ' and AN.AIMNutrientID = ' + Cast(@MoistureID as varchar) + ' GROUP BY AOL.LocationName, M.AIMMaterialCode ' EXEC (@SQL) --print (@SQL) End
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- SET @SQL = 'SELECT '
If @ToDate is NOT NULL SET @Sql += '''' + convert(varchar,@ToDate) + ''' as ToDate, ' If @FromDate IS NOT NULL SET @Sql += '''' + convert(varchar,@FromDate) + ''' as FromDate, '
-- * * * Added MaterialNameTotal field because on the Pivot Report, the Material Name is the FieldValue, -- which shows up in both the column headers and in the grand totals. Needed more space for the nutrient columns, -- so shrunk the MaterialName column header so only the first 2 or 3 digits appear. (Didn't want to see just part -- of the material name, so put spaces at the beginning - so spaces show up instead - but the whole material name -- still shows up in the grand total.)
SET @SQL += ' AO.AIMOwnerID, AOL.LocationName, AN.AIMNutrientCode , case when AN.AIMNutrientShortName IS NULL OR LEN(AN.AIMNutrientShortName) = 0 then LEFT(AN.AIMNutrientName,15) else AN.AIMNutrientShortName End as AIMNutrientName , UT.UnitTypeDescription , convert(varchar, aimnutrientname) + '' - '' + convert(varchar, unittypedescription) as AIMNutrientHeading , convert(varchar, CAST(WL.Min AS DECIMAL(3,1)) ) + ''-'' + convert(varchar, CAST(WL.Max AS DECIMAL(3,1)) ) as MinMaxRange , AM.AIMMaterialCode AS MaterialCode , AM.AIMMaterialName as MaterialName , ' + ''' ''+' + 'AM.AIMMaterialName AS MaterialNameTotal , SS.SourceName , SL.SourceLocationName '
IF @DryMatterBase = 1 SET @SQL += ', TT.AdjDryMatter , case when AN.AIMNutrientID = ' + Cast(@MoistureID as varchar) + ' then 0 else SUM(SA.AIMUsedValue) * TT.AdjDryMatter end as ResultValue ' Else SET @SQL += ', SUM(SA.AIMUsedValue) as ResultValue '
SET @SQL += ' FROM dbo.Sample S WITH(NOLOCK) INNER JOIN dbo.SampleResult SR WITH(NOLOCK) ON S.SampleID = SR.SampleID AND SR.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN dbo.SampleAIM SA WITH(NOLOCK) ON SA.SampleID = S.SampleID AND SR.SampleResultID = SA.SampleResultID and SA.IsActive = 1 '
IF Len(@AIMMaterialList) > 0 SET @SQL = @SQL + 'INNER JOIN ##TempMaterial AM on S.AIMMaterialID = AM.AIMMaterialID ' else SET @SQL = @SQL + 'INNER JOIN dbo.AIMMaterial AM WITH(NOLOCK) ON AM.AIMMaterialID = S.AIMMaterialID ' SET @SQL = @SQL + '
LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMOwner AO WITH(NOLOCK) ON AO.AIMOwnerID = S.AIMOwnerID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMOwnerLocation AOL WITH(NOLOCK) ON AOL.AIMOwnerLocationID = S.AIMOwnerLocationID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMSource SS WITH(NOLOCK) ON SS.AIMSourceID = S.AIMSourceID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMSourceLocation SL WITH(NOLOCK) ON SL.AIMSourceLocationID = S.AIMSourceLocationID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMNutrient AN WITH(NOLOCK) ON AN.AIMNutrientID = SA.AIMNutrientID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.UnitType UT with (nolock) ON AN.UnitTypeID = UT.UnitTypeID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.WarningLimits WL with (nolock) ON AN.AIMNutrientID = WL.AIMNutrientID AND AM.AIMMaterialID = WL.AIMMaterialID '
IF @DryMatterBase = 1 SET @SQL += ' INNER JOIN ##DryMatter TT ON AM.AIMMaterialCode = TT.AIMMaterialCode and AOL.LocationName = TT.LocationName '
SET @SQL += ' ' + @Where + ' '
Begin SET @SQL += 'GROUP BY AO.AIMOwnerID, AOL.LocationName, AM.AIMMaterialCode , AM.AIMMaterialName , SS.SourceName , SL.SourceLocationName, AN.AIMNutrientCode , AN.AIMNutrientName , AN.AIMNutrientShortName , UT.UnitTypeDescription , WL.Min , WL.Max ' End
IF @DryMatterBase = 1 SET @SQL += ', TT.AdjDryMatter, AN.AIMNutrientID '
--'ORDER BY AM.AIMMaterialCode, AOL.LocationName, SS.SourceName , SL.SourceLocationName ' SET @SQL += 'ORDER BY AM.AIMMaterialCode, SS.SourceName , SL.SourceLocationName '
EXEC (@SQL) --Print @SQL
IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM tempdb.sys.tables WHERE [name] like '##TempMaterial%') DROP TABLE ##TempMaterial IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM tempdb.sys.tables WHERE [name] like '##DryMatter%') DROP TABLE ##DryMatter
END

IF @AIMOwnerLocationID IS NOT NULL SET @SQL = @SQL + ' , AOL.LocationName ' ELSE SET @SQL = @SQL + ', ''All'' as LocationName '
IF @AIMSourceID IS NOT NULL SET @SQL = @SQL + ' , SS.SourceName ' ELSE SET @SQL = @SQL + ', ''All'' as SourceName '
IF @AIMSourceLocationID IS NOT NULL SET @SQL = @SQL + ' , SL.SourceLocationName ' ELSE SET @SQL = @SQL + ', ''All'' as SourceLocationName '
SET @SQL = @SQL + '
FROM dbo.Sample S WITH(NOLOCK) INNER JOIN dbo.SampleResult SR WITH(NOLOCK) ON SR.SampleID = S.SampleID AND SR.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN dbo.SampleAIM SA WITH(NOLOCK) ON SA.SampleID = S.SampleID and SA.SampleResultID = SR.SampleResultID AND SA.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN dbo.CFCProductArchive CPA with (nolock) ON S.CFCProductArchiveID = CPA.CFCProductArchiveID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMOwner AO WITH(NOLOCK) ON AO.AIMOwnerID = S.AIMOwnerID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMMaterial AM WITH(NOLOCK) ON AM.AIMMaterialID = S.AIMMaterialID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMOwnerLocation AOL WITH(NOLOCK) ON AOL.AIMOwnerLocationID = S.AIMOwnerLocationID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMSource SS WITH(NOLOCK) ON SS.AIMSourceID = S.AIMSourceID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMSourceLocation SL WITH(NOLOCK) ON SL.AIMSourceLocationID = S.AIMSourceLocationID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMNutrient AN WITH(NOLOCK) ON AN.AIMNutrientID = SA.AIMNutrientID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.UnitType UT with (nolock) ON AN.UnitTypeID = UT.UnitTypeID
' + @Where + ' ' +
' GROUP BY AN.AIMNutrientCode , AN.AIMNutrientName , UT.UnitTypeDescription '
IF @AIMMaterialID IS NOT NULL SET @SQL = @SQL + ', AM.AIMMaterialCode, AM.AIMMaterialName ' IF @SampleOwnerID IS NOT NULL SET @SQL = @SQL + ', AO.OwnerName ' IF @AIMOwnerLocationID IS NOT NULL SET @SQL = @SQL + ', AOL.LocationName ' IF @AIMSourceID IS NOT NULL SET @SQL = @SQL + ' , SS.SourceName ' IF @AIMSourceLocationID IS NOT NULL SET @SQL = @SQL + ' , SL.SourceLocationName '

, (select am.AIMNutrientName from dbo.AIMNutrient am Where am.AIMNutrientID = ' + cast(@Datasource1AIMNutrientID1 as varchar) + ' ) as Datasource1AIMNutrientName1 , (select am.AIMNutrientName from dbo.AIMNutrient am Where am.AIMNutrientID = ' + cast(@Datasource2AIMNutrientID1 as varchar) + ' ) as Datasource2AIMNutrientName1 , (select am.AIMNutrientName from dbo.AIMNutrient am Where am.AIMNutrientID = ' + cast(@Datasource1AIMNutrientID2 as varchar) + ' ) as Datasource1AIMNutrientName2 , (select am.AIMNutrientName from dbo.AIMNutrient am Where am.AIMNutrientID = ' + cast(@Datasource2AIMNutrientID2 as varchar) + ' ) as Datasource2AIMNutrientName2 , (select am.AIMNutrientName from dbo.AIMNutrient am Where am.AIMNutrientID = ' + cast(@Datasource1AIMNutrientID3 as varchar) + ' ) as Datasource1AIMNutrientName3 , (select am.AIMNutrientName from dbo.AIMNutrient am Where am.AIMNutrientID = ' + cast(@Datasource2AIMNutrientID3 as varchar) + ' ) as Datasource2AIMNutrientName3

BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
-- exec usp_Report_ExportBatchDetail
SELECT
H.UpdateIngredientHeaderID , H.UpdateName , H.UpdateStamp , H.UpdateCFCUserID , AD.Name as AimDatabaseName , case when H.ExportTargetID = 1 then 'Base' else case when H.ExportTargetID = 2 then 'Default' else case when H.ExportTargetID = 3 then 'Specific' else '' end end end as TargetOverlay , H.CreateDate , CP.CFCPlantName , D.CFCIngredientID , D.CFCNutrientID , round(D.ProposedValue,3) as ProposedValue , round(D.Mean,3) as Mean , round(D.StandardDeviation,3) as StandardDeviation , D.Override , CI.CFCIngredientName , CI.CFCIngredientCode , N.CFCNutrientCode , N.CFCNutrientName , case when D.Override > 0 then D.Override else Round(D.ProposedValue,3) end as UsedValue , D.Status , CP.CFCPlantCode , ISNULL(CN.Value, 0) as CurrentNutrientVal , U.UserName
FROM dbo.UpdateIngredientDetail D WITH(NOLOCK) INNER JOIN dbo.UpdateIngredientHeader H ON D.UpdateIngredientHeaderID = H.UpdateIngredientHeaderID INNER JOIN dbo.CFCIngredient CI WITH(NOLOCK) ON D.CFCIngredientID = CI.CFCIngredientID INNER JOIN dbo.CFCNutrient N WITH(NOLOCK) ON D.CFCNutrientID = N.CFCNutrientID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.CFCIngredientNutrient CN WITH(NOLOCK) ON CN.CFCNutrientID = N.CFCNutrientID AND CN.CFCIngredientID = CI.CFCIngredientID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.CFCPlant CP with (nolock) ON D.CFCPlantID = CP.CFCPlantID LEFT OUTER JOIN CFCUser.CFCUser U WITH(NOLOCK) ON D.UpdateCFCUserID = U.CFCUserID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMDatabase AD ON AD.AIMDatabaseID = H.AIMDatabaseID
WHERE H.STATUS = 1
END

BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
-- exec usp_Report_ExportBatchDetail_UpdateIngredientHeaderID 58, 4 Declare @plantName varchar(20) = '' declare @plantID int = 0
IF @TargetID = 3 -- Specific Overlay Begin Set @plantID = (Select CFCPlantID from dbo.UpdateIngredientHeader WHERE UpdateIngredientHeaderID = @UpdateIngredientHeaderID) Set @plantName = (Select CFCPlantName from dbo.CFCPlant p where p.CFCPlantID = @plantID) End
IF @TargetID = 4 --Base For Begin Set @plantID = (Select CFCPlantID from dbo.UpdateIngredientHeader WHERE UpdateIngredientHeaderID = @UpdateIngredientHeaderID) Set @plantName = (Select ShortName from dbo.UpdateIngredientHeader WHERE UpdateIngredientHeaderID = @UpdateIngredientHeaderID) End
SELECT
H.UpdateIngredientHeaderID , H.UpdateName , H.UpdateStamp , H.UpdateCFCUserID , AD.Name as AimDatabaseName , case when H.ExportTargetID = 1 then 'Base' else case when H.ExportTargetID = 2 then 'Default' else case when H.ExportTargetID = 3 then 'Specific' else case when H.ExportTargetID = 4 then 'Base For' else '' end end end end as TargetOverlay , H.CreateDate , CP.CFCPlantName , D.CFCIngredientID , D.CFCNutrientID , Round(D.ProposedValue,3) as ProposedValue , Round(D.Mean,3) as Mean , Round(D.StandardDeviation,3) as StandardDeviation , D.Override , CI.CFCIngredientName , CI.CFCIngredientCode , N.CFCNutrientName , case when D.Override > 0 then D.Override else Round(D.ProposedValue,3) end as UsedValue , N.CFCNutrientCode , Sum(D.NumberOfSamples) as NumberOfSamples , D.Status , CP.CFCPlantCode , @plantName as PlantName , ISNULL(CN.Value, 0) as CurrentNutrientVal , U.UserName , D.UpdateCFCUserID
FROM dbo.UpdateIngredientDetail D WITH(NOLOCK) INNER JOIN dbo.UpdateIngredientHeader H ON D.UpdateIngredientHeaderID = H.UpdateIngredientHeaderID INNER JOIN dbo.CFCIngredient CI WITH(NOLOCK) ON D.CFCIngredientID = CI.CFCIngredientID INNER JOIN dbo.CFCNutrient N WITH(NOLOCK) ON D.CFCNutrientID = N.CFCNutrientID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.CFCIngredientNutrient CN WITH(NOLOCK) ON CN.CFCNutrientID = N.CFCNutrientID AND CN.CFCIngredientID = CI.CFCIngredientID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.CFCPlant CP with (nolock) ON D.CFCPlantID = CP.CFCPlantID LEFT OUTER JOIN CFCUser.CFCUser U WITH(NOLOCK) ON D.CFCUserID = U.CFCUserID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMDatabase AD ON AD.AIMDatabaseID = H.AIMDatabaseID
WHERE H.UpdateIngredientHeaderID = @UpdateIngredientHeaderID
GROUP BY H.UpdateIngredientHeaderID , H.UpdateName , H.UpdateStamp , H.UpdateCFCUserID , AD.Name , H.ExportTargetID , H.CreateDate , CP.CFCPlantName , D.CFCIngredientID , D.CFCNutrientID , D.ProposedValue , D.Mean , D.StandardDeviation , D.Override , CI.CFCIngredientName , CI.CFCIngredientCode , N.CFCNutrientName , N.CFCNutrientCode , D.Status , CP.CFCPlantCode , ISNULL(CN.Value, 0) , U.UserName , D.UpdateCFCUserID
ORDER BY CI.CFCIngredientCode, N.CFCNutrientCode
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_Report_SampleActivity_QualityControl]
@FromDate VARCHAR(23) , @ToDate VARCHAR(23) , @CFCUserID INT , @MaterialTypeID INT
--exec usp_Report_SampleActivity_QualityControl '2022-03-01 00:00:00.000', '2022-04-30 00:00:00.000', 1, 1
AS

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value:
BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
DECLARE @SQL VARCHAR(MAX) = '' DECLARE @Where VARCHAR(MAX) = '' DECLARE @WhereValue VARCHAR(MAX) = '' Declare @SampleID INT declare @AnalysisString varchar(500)
if @ToDate = '' BEGIN SET @ToDate = null END
SET @Where = ' WHERE DST.DataSourceTypeID = ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, @DataSourceTypeID)
if @CFCUserID <> 0 BEGIN SET @Where += ' AND S.CFCUserID = ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, @CFCUserID) END
IF @FromDate IS NOT NULL BEGIN SET @Where += ' AND S.CreatedStamp >= ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, @FromDate) + '''' END
IF @ToDate IS NOT NULL BEGIN SET @Where += ' AND S.CreatedStamp <= ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, @ToDate) + ' 23:59:59.999''' END
IF @AIMMaterialID > 0 BEGIN SET @Where += ' AND AM.AIMMaterialID = ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, @AIMMaterialID) END
IF @SupplierID > 0 BEGIN SET @Where += ' AND AMS.AIMSourceID = ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, @SupplierID) END ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ -- Put SampleID and Sample Test Type into a temp table to use below IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM tempdb.sys.tables WHERE [name] like '#TestType%') DROP TABLE #TestType CREATE TABLE #TestType (SampleID int, AnalysisString varchar(500))
SET @SQL = ' DECLARE SampleCur scroll cursor for SELECT S.SampleID FROM dbo.Sample S INNER JOIN dbo.SampleTestTypeResult STTR ON STTR.SampleID = S.SampleID INNER JOIN dbo.SampleTestTypeDetail STTD ON STTD.SampleTestTypeDetailID = STTR.SampleTestTypeDetailID INNER JOIN dbo.AIMMaterial AM ON AM.AIMMaterialID = S.AIMMaterialID INNER JOIN dbo.DataSourceType DST ON DST.DataSourceTypeID = STTD.DataSourceTypeID INNER JOIN dbo.AIMSource AMS ON AMS.AIMSourceID = S.AIMSourceID INNER JOIN dbo.AIMSourceLocation AMSL ON AMSL.AIMSourceID = S.AIMSourceID ' + @Where EXEC (@SQL)
open SampleCur fetch next from SampleCur into @SampleID while @@fetch_status = 0
begin declare tempcur scroll cursor for SELECT STUFF(( Select '; ' + STT.SampleTestTypeName FROM dbo.SampleTestTypeResult STTR INNER JOIN dbo.SampleTestTypeDetail STTD ON STTD.SampleTestTypeDetailID = STTR.SampleTestTypeDetailID INNER JOIN dbo.SampleTestType STT ON STTD.SampleTestTypeID = STT.SampleTestTypeID WHERE sttr.isincluded = 1 and sttr.isactive = 1 and STTR.Sampleid = @SampleID and STTD.DataSourceTypeID = @DataSourceTypeID GROUP BY STT.SampleTestTypeName FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') as AnalysisString FROM dbo.SampleTestTypeResult STTR
open tempcur fetch next from tempcur into @AnalysisString if @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 Begin INSERT into #TestType (SampleID, AnalysisString) Select @SampleID, @AnalysisString fetch next from tempcur into @AnalysisString end close tempcur deallocate tempcur fetch next from SampleCur into @SampleID end close SampleCur deallocate SampleCur ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SET @SQL = 'SELECT S.SampleID , CASE WHEN LEN(S.SampleCode) > 0 THEN S.SampleCode ELSE CONVERT(NVARCHAR, S.SampleID) END AS SampleCode , S.SampleDate , S.CreatedStamp , AM.AIMMaterialID , AM.AIMMaterialCode , AM.AIMMaterialName , DST.DataSourceTypeID , DST.DataSourceTypeCode , DST.Name as DataSourceName , T.AnalysisString , AMS.AIMSourceID as SupplierID , AMS.SourceName as Supplier , AMSL.SourceLocationName as SupplierLocation FROM dbo.Sample S INNER JOIN dbo.SampleTestTypeResult STTR ON STTR.SampleID = S.SampleID INNER JOIN dbo.SampleTestTypeDetail STTD ON STTD.SampleTestTypeDetailID = STTR.SampleTestTypeDetailID INNER JOIN dbo.AIMMaterial AM ON AM.AIMMaterialID = S.AIMMaterialID INNER JOIN dbo.DataSourceType DST ON DST.DataSourceTypeID = STTD.DataSourceTypeID INNER JOIN dbo.AIMSource AMS ON AMS.AIMSourceID = S.AIMSourceID INNER JOIN dbo.AIMSourceLocation AMSL ON AMSL.AIMSourceLocationID = S.AIMSourceLocationID LEFT OUTER JOIN #TestType T ON S.SampleID = T.SampleID
' + @Where + ' GROUP BY S.SampleID , S.SampleCode , S.SampleDate , S.CreatedStamp , AM.AIMMaterialID , AM.AIMMaterialCode , AM.AIMMaterialName , DST.DataSourceTypeID , DST.DataSourceTypeCode , DST.[Name] , T.AnalysisString , AMS.AIMSourceID , AMS.SourceName , AMSL.SourceLocationName ORDER BY S.SampleCode ' EXEC (@SQL) --print @SQL
END

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value:
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON; DECLARE @RecordID INT = 0 DECLARE @ErrorNumber INT = 0 DECLARE @ErrorMessage VARCHAR(200) = ''
--10/17/23 --DECLARE @SQL VARCHAR(6000) = '' --DECLARE @Where VARCHAR(1000) = '' --DECLARE @WhereDataSource1 VARCHAR(1000) = '' --DECLARE @WhereDataSource2 VARCHAR(1000) = '' --DECLARE @WhereRest VARCHAR(1000) = '' DECLARE @SQL VARCHAR(MAX) = '' DECLARE @Where VARCHAR(MAX) = '' DECLARE @WhereDataSource1 VARCHAR(MAX) = '' DECLARE @WhereDataSource2 VARCHAR(MAX) = '' DECLARE @WhereRest VARCHAR(MAX) = ''
/* -- DataSource1 and DataSource2 can be a combination of system and user-defined datasources ex: Foss vs. WetLab Foss vs. Adissio WetLab vs. another external datasource
-- TYPES NO LONGER USED 3/12/20 -- Type1 and Type2 are bits, 0 and 1. 0 = Internal, 1 = External -- Type1 and Type2 fields are necessary to use the correct datasource table Internal = DataSourceType table External = DataSourceUser table */
IF @SampleOwnerID = 0 BEGIN SET @SampleOwnerID = NULL END
IF @AIMOwnerLocationID = 0 BEGIN SET @AIMOwnerLocationID = NULL END
IF @AIMSupplierID = 0 BEGIN SET @AIMSupplierID = NULL END
IF @AIMSupplierLocationID = 0 BEGIN SET @AIMSupplierLocationID = NULL END
IF @AIMMaterialID = 0 BEGIN SET @AIMMaterialID = NULL END
IF Len(@SampleCode) = 0 BEGIN SET @SampleCode = NULL END
SET @Where = ' WHERE SR.IsActive = 1 '
--3/12/20 - Internal/External no longer used --IF @Type1 = 0 -- SET @WhereDataSource1 += ' AND AN.DataSourceTypeID = ' + cast(@DataSource1 as varchar) --IF @Type1 = 1 -- SET @WhereDataSource1 += ' AND AN.DataSourceTypeID = ' + cast( @DataSource1 as varchar) --IF @Type2 = 0 -- SET @WhereDataSource2 += ' AND AN.DataSourceTypeID = ' + cast(@DataSource2 as varchar) --IF @Type2 = 1 -- SET @WhereDataSource2 += ' AND AN.DataSourceTypeID = ' + cast(@DataSource2 as varchar) SET @WhereDataSource1 += ' AND DST.DataSourceTypeID = ' + cast(@DataSource1 as varchar) SET @WhereDataSource2 += ' AND DST.DataSourceTypeID = ' + cast(@DataSource2 as varchar)
IF @SampleOwnerID IS NOT NULL SET @WhereRest += ' and S.AIMOwnerID = ' + Cast(@SampleOwnerID as varchar) + ' ' IF @AIMOwnerLocationID IS NOT NULL SET @WhereRest += ' and S.AIMOwnerLocationID = ' + Cast(@AIMOwnerLocationID as varchar) + ' ' IF @AIMSupplierID IS NOT NULL SET @WhereRest += ' and S.AIMSourceID = ' + Cast(@AIMSupplierID as varchar) + ' ' IF @AIMSupplierLocationID IS NOT NULL SET @WhereRest += ' and S.AIMSourceLocationID = ' + Cast(@AIMSupplierLocationID as varchar) + ' ' IF @AIMMaterialID IS NOT NULL SET @WhereRest += ' and S.AIMMaterialID = ' + Cast(@AIMMaterialID as varchar) + ' ' IF @SampleCode IS NOT NULL SET @WhereRest += ' and S.SampleCode = ''' + Cast(@SampleCode as varchar) + ''' ' IF @FromDate IS NOT NULL SET @WhereRest += ' and SR.AnalysisDate >= ''' + Convert(varchar,Cast(@FromDate as datetime), 120) + ''' ' IF @ToDate IS NOT NULL SET @WhereRest += ' and SR.AnalysisDate <= ''' + Convert(varchar,Cast(@ToDate as datetime), 120) + ''' '
SET @SQL = 'SELECT '
If @ToDate is NOT NULL SET @Sql += '''' + convert(varchar,@ToDate) + ''' as ToDate, ' If @FromDate IS NOT NULL SET @Sql += '''' + convert(varchar,@FromDate) + ''' as FromDate, ' SET @SQL += '
SampleID , AimMaterialID, AimMaterialName, AimNutrientID, AimNutrientName, AimNutrientCode , case when sum(Val1) is not null then sum(Val1) end as ResultValue1 , case when sum(Val2) is not null then sum(Val2) end as ResultValue2 , samplecode , aimownerid , aimownerlocationid , aimsourceid , aimsourcelocationid
FROM ( SELECT S.SampleID , S.AimMaterialID , AMM.AIMMaterialName , AMN.AIMNutrientID , AMN.AIMNutrientName , AMN.AIMNutrientCode , SR.ResultValue as Val1 , Null as Val2 , DST.DataSourceTypeID
, s.samplecode , s.aimownerid , s.aimownerlocationid , s.aimsourceid , s.aimsourcelocationid
FROM dbo.sample S with (nolock) INNER JOIN dbo.SampleResult SR with (nolock) ON S.SampleID = SR.SampleID INNER JOIN dbo.AIMNutrientRefAnalyzerNutrient AMRAN with (nolock) ON SR.AnalyzerNutrientID = AMRAN.AnalyzerNutrientID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AnalyzerNutrient AN with (nolock) ON AMRAN.AnalyzerNutrientID = AN.AnalyzerNutrientID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMNutrient AMN with (nolock) ON AMRAN.AimNutrientID = AMN.AimNutrientID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMMaterial AMM with (nolock) ON S.AIMMaterialID = AMM.AIMMaterialID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.DataSourceType DST ON AN.DataSourceTypeID = DST.DataSourceTypeID ' + @Where + @WhereDataSource1 + @WhereRest +
' UNION
SELECT S.SampleID , S.AimMaterialID , AMM.AIMMaterialName , AMN.AIMNutrientID , AMN.AIMNutrientName , AMN.AIMNutrientCode , Null as Val1 , SR.ResultValue as Val2 , DST.DataSourceTypeID
, s.samplecode , s.aimownerid , s.aimownerlocationid , s.aimsourceid , s.aimsourcelocationid
FROM dbo.sample S with (nolock) INNER JOIN dbo.SampleResult SR with (nolock) ON S.SampleID = SR.SampleID INNER JOIN dbo.AIMNutrientRefAnalyzerNutrient AMRAN with (nolock) ON SR.AnalyzerNutrientID = AMRAN.AnalyzerNutrientID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AnalyzerNutrient AN with (nolock) ON AMRAN.AnalyzerNutrientID = AN.AnalyzerNutrientID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMNutrient AMN with (nolock) ON AMRAN.AimNutrientID = AMN.AimNutrientID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMMaterial AMM with (nolock) ON S.AIMMaterialID = AMM.AIMMaterialID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.DataSourceType DST ON AN.DataSourceTypeID = DST.DataSourceTypeID ' + @Where + @WhereDataSource2 + @WhereRest +
' ) x
GROUP BY SampleID, AimMaterialID, AimMaterialName, AimNutrientID, AimNutrientName, AimNutrientCode , samplecode , aimownerid , aimownerlocationid , aimsourceid , aimsourcelocationid
' If @BothMustHaveValues = 1 SET @SQL += 'HAVING sum(Val1) is not null and sum(Val2) is not null'
--print @sql EXEC (@SQL)
END

AS

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value:
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON;
--10/17/23 --DECLARE @SQL VARCHAR(6000) = '' --DECLARE @Where VARCHAR(1000) = '' DECLARE @SQL VARCHAR(MAX) = '' DECLARE @Where VARCHAR(MAX) = '' DECLARE @SampleResultOption VARCHAR(MAX) = '' DECLARE @SampleResultWhere VARCHAR(MAX) = ''
SET @Where = ' WHERE S.IsActive = 1 and AM.MaterialTypeID = ' + Cast(@MaterialTypeID as varchar) if @AIMOwnerLocationID <> 0 SET @Where = @Where + ' and S.AIMOwnerLocationID = ' + Cast(@AIMOwnerLocationID as varchar) if @FromDate IS NOT NULL SET @Where = @Where + ' and S.SampleDate >= ''' + Convert(varchar,Cast(@FromDate as datetime), 120) + ''' ' if @ToDate IS NOT NULL SET @Where = @Where + ' and S.SampleDate <= ''' + Convert(varchar,Cast(@ToDate as datetime), 120) + ''' '
SET @SampleResultOption = CASE WHEN @SampleResultType = 1 THEN 'LEFT OUTER JOIN' WHEN @SampleResultType = 2 THEN 'LEFT OUTER JOIN' ELSE 'INNER JOIN' -- Don't check for 0, just default if 0 or anything else gets passed to proc doesn't break END
IF @SampleResultType = 1 SET @Where = @Where + ' AND SR.SampleResultID IS NULL '
SET @SQL = 'SELECT
S.SampleCode , S.SampleDate , S.CreatedStamp as SampleCreatedStamp , S.ContractNumber , S.PoNumber , S.InvoiceNumber , S.TicketNumber , S.LoadNumber , S.BillOfLoad , S.VehicleNumber , S.LotNumber , S.AlternateCode , S.Notes ' --, AM.AIMMaterialCode --, AM.AIMMaterialName If @GroupMaterials = 0 Begin SET @SQL = @SQL + ', AM.AIMMaterialCode, AM.AIMMaterialName ' End Else Begin SET @SQL = @SQL + ' , Case when GH.AIMMaterialGroupHeaderName is not null then '''' Else AM.AIMMaterialCode end as AIMMaterialCode , Case when GH.AIMMaterialGroupHeaderName is not null then GH.AIMMaterialGroupHeaderName Else AM.AIMMaterialName end as AIMMaterialName ' End
SET @SQL = @SQL + '
, MT.MaterialTypeName , AO.OwnerCode as AIMOwnerCode , AO.OwnerName as AIMOwnerName , AOL.LocationCode as AIMOwnerLocationCode , AOL.LocationName as AIMOwnerLocationName , AMS.AIMSupplierCode , AMS.SourceName as AIMSupplierName , ASL.AIMSupplierLocationCode , ASL.SourceLocationName as AIMSupplierLocationName , AN.AnalyzerNutrientCode , AN.AnalyzerNutrientName , SR.Unit , SR.ResultValue , SR.AnalysisDate as ResultAnalysisDate , DST.DataSourceTypeCode , CP.CFCProductCode , CP.CFCProductName , CPA.ProductionDate , CPA.ProductionVersion , Case when SFA.SampleFurtherAnalysisID is null then '''' Else DST.Name end as FurtherAnalysis , Case when GUG.GroundUnGroundID = ''1'' then ''Ground'' else case when GUG.GroundUnGroundID = ''2'' then ''Whole'' else '''' end end as GroundUnGround , ST.SampleTypeName , WL.Min AS WLMin , WL.Max AS WLMax , ISNULL(CASE WHEN SR.ResultValue < WL.Min THEN 1 ELSE CASE WHEN SR.ResultValue > WL.Max THEN 2 ELSE 0 END END, 0) AS ResultValueFlag , WL.AIMNutrientID FROM dbo.Sample S with (nolock) '
+ @SampleResultOption + '
dbo.SampleResult SR with (nolock) ON S.SampleID = SR.SampleID AND SR.IsActive = 1 LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMMaterial AM with (nolock) ON S.AIMMaterialID = AM.AIMMaterialID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.MaterialType MT with (nolock) ON AM.MaterialTypeID = MT.MaterialTypeID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMOwner AO with (nolock) ON S.AIMOwnerID = AO.AIMOwnerID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMOwnerLocation AOL with (nolock) ON S.AIMOwnerLocationID = AOL.AIMOwnerLocationID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMSource AMS with (nolock) ON S.AIMSourceID = AMS.AIMSourceID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMSourceLocation ASL with (nolock) ON S.AIMSourceLocationID = ASL.AIMSourceLocationID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AnalyzerNutrient AN with (nolock) ON SR.AnalyzerNutrientID = AN.AnalyzerNutrientID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.DataSourceType DST with (nolock) ON AN.DataSourceTypeID = DST.DataSourceTypeID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.CFCProductArchive CPA with (nolock) ON S.CFCProductArchiveID = CPA.CFCProductArchiveID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.CFCProduct CP WITH (NOLOCK) ON CPA.CFCProductID = CP.CFCProductID
LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMMaterialGroupDetail GD on S.AimMaterialID = GD.AIMMaterialID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMMaterialGroupHeader GH on GD.AIMMaterialGroupHeaderID = GH.AIMMaterialGroupHeaderID
LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.SampleFurtherAnalysis SFA on S.FurtherAnalysisID = SFA.SampleFurtherAnalysisID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.GroundUnGround GUG on GUG.GroundUnGroundID = S.GroundUnGroundID
LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.SampleType ST ON ST.SampleTypeID = S.SampleTypeID
LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMNutrientRefAnalyzerNutrient AMNX ON SR.AnalyzerNutrientID = AMNX.AnalyzerNutrientID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.WarningLimits WL ON WL.AIMNutrientID = AMNX.AIMNutrientID AND WL.AIMMaterialID = S.AIMMaterialID '
SET @SQL = @SQL + @Where
--print @sql EXEC (@SQL)
END

LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMMaterial AM with (nolock) ON S.AIMMaterialID = AM.AIMMaterialID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.MaterialType MT with (nolock) ON AM.MaterialTypeID = MT.MaterialTypeID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMOwner AO with (nolock) ON S.AIMOwnerID = AO.AIMOwnerID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMOwnerLocation AOL with (nolock) ON S.AIMOwnerLocationID = AOL.AIMOwnerLocationID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMSource AMS with (nolock) ON S.AIMSourceID = AMS.AIMSourceID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMSourceLocation ASL with (nolock) ON S.AIMSourceLocationID = ASL.AIMSourceLocationID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AnalyzerNutrient AN with (nolock) ON SR.AnalyzerNutrientID = AN.AnalyzerNutrientID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.DataSourceType DST with (nolock) ON AN.DataSourceTypeID = DST.DataSourceTypeID
LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMMaterialGroupDetail GD on S.AimMaterialID = GD.AIMMaterialID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMMaterialGroupHeader GH on GD.AIMMaterialGroupHeaderID = GH.AIMMaterialGroupHeaderID
LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.SampleFurtherAnalysis SFA on S.FurtherAnalysisID = SFA.SampleFurtherAnalysisID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.GroundUnGround GUG on GUG.GroundUnGroundID = S.GroundUnGroundID
LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.SampleType ST ON ST.SampleTypeID = S.SampleTypeID
LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.WarningLimits WL ON WL.AIMNutrientID = AMNX.AIMNutrientID AND WL.AIMMaterialID = S.AIMMaterialID ' SET @SQL = @SQL + @Where

BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
DECLARE @RecordID INT = 0 DECLARE @ErrorNumber INT = 0 DECLARE @ErrorMessage VARCHAR(200) = ''
--10/17/23 --DECLARE @SQL VARCHAR(6000) = '' --DECLARE @Where VARCHAR(1000) = '' --DECLARE @WhereValue VARCHAR(1000) = '' --DECLARE @MatNutWhere VARCHAR(1000) = '' --DECLARE @CFCWhere VARCHAR(1000) = '' DECLARE @SQL VARCHAR(MAX) = '' DECLARE @Where VARCHAR(MAX) = '' DECLARE @WhereValue VARCHAR(MAX) = '' DECLARE @MatNutWhere VARCHAR(MAX) = '' DECLARE @CFCWhere VARCHAR(MAX) = ''
IF @AIMOwnerID = 0 BEGIN SET @AIMOwnerID = NULL END
IF @AIMOwnerLocationID = 0 BEGIN SET @AIMOwnerLocationID = NULL END
IF @AIMSourceID = 0 BEGIN SET @AIMSourceID = NULL END
IF @AIMSourceLocationID = 0 BEGIN SET @AIMSourceLocationID = NULL END
IF @AIMMaterialID = 0 BEGIN SET @AIMMaterialID = NULL END
IF Len(@Ticket) = 0 BEGIN SET @Ticket = NULL END
IF @QueryTemplateID IS NULL BEGIN
SET @Where = 'WHERE AN.IsActive = 1 and S.IsActive = 1 and '
if @AIMOwnerID IS NOT NULL SET @Where += ' and S.AIMOwnerID = ' + Cast(@AIMOwnerID as varchar) + ' ' if @AIMOwnerLocationID IS NOT NULL SET @Where += ' and S.AIMOwnerLocationID = ' + Cast(@AIMOwnerLocationID as varchar) + ' ' if @AIMSourceID IS NOT NULL SET @Where += ' and S.AIMSourceID = ' + Cast(@AIMSourceID as varchar) + ' ' if @AIMSourceLocationID IS NOT NULL SET @Where += ' and S.AIMSourceLocationID = ' + Cast(@AIMSourceLocationID as varchar) + ' ' if @AIMMaterialID IS NOT NULL SET @Where += ' and S.AIMMaterialID = ' + Cast(@AIMMaterialID as varchar) + ' ' if @Ticket IS NOT NULL SET @Where += ' and S.TicketNumber = ' + Cast(@Ticket as varchar) + ' ' END ELSE BEGIN
-- These functions create the where statements the query will use EXEC @Where = [dbo].[AnalysisReports_WhereStatement] @QueryTemplateID EXEC @CFCWhere = [dbo].[AnalysisReports_CFCIngredient_WhereStatement] @QueryTemplateID EXEC @MatNutWhere = [dbo].[AnalysisReports_MaterialNutrient_WhereStatement] @QueryTemplateID
SET @Where = ' WHERE S.IsActive = 1 and sr.isactive = 1 ' + @Where --SET @Where = ' WHERE S.IsActive = 1 and sr.isactive = 1 and aimmaterialcode = ''71300'' ' + @Where
IF LEN(@MatNutWhere) > 0 SET @Where += @MatNutWhere END
SET @SQL = 'SELECT '
IF @UseAnalysisDate = 1 SET @SQL += ' convert(date,SR.AnalysisDate) as SampleDate ' Else SET @SQL += ' S.SampleDate '
SET @SQL += ' , AMM.AIMMaterialCode , AMS.AIMSupplierCode , AOL.LocationName , S.TicketNumber , AMN.AIMNutrientName , max(case when dst.DataSourceTypeID = ' + cast(@DataSourceTypeID1 as varchar) + ' then resultValue end) as val1 , max(case when dst.DataSourceTypeID = ' + cast(@DataSourceTypeID2 as varchar) + ' then resultValue end) as val2 , (select name from datasourcetype where datasourcetypeid = ' + cast(@DataSourceTypeID1 as varchar) + ') as DataSourceName1 , (select name from datasourcetype where datasourcetypeid = ' + cast(@DataSourceTypeID2 as varchar) + ') as DataSourceName2 , s.samplecode , s.aimownerid , s.aimownerlocationid , s.aimsourceid , s.aimsourcelocationid , S.SampleID , S.AimMaterialID , AMN.AIMNutrientID , AMN.AIMNutrientCode
FROM dbo.sample S with (nolock) INNER JOIN dbo.SampleResult SR with (nolock) ON S.SampleID = SR.SampleID INNER JOIN dbo.SampleAIM SA WITH(NOLOCK) ON SA.SampleID = S.SampleID AND SA.SampleResultID = SR.SampleResultID AND SA.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN dbo.AIMNutrientRefAnalyzerNutrient AMRAN with (nolock) ON SR.AnalyzerNutrientID = AMRAN.AnalyzerNutrientID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AnalyzerNutrient AN with (nolock) ON AMRAN.AnalyzerNutrientID = AN.AnalyzerNutrientID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMNutrient AMN with (nolock) ON AMRAN.AimNutrientID = AMN.AimNutrientID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMMaterial AMM with (nolock) ON S.AIMMaterialID = AMM.AIMMaterialID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.DataSourceType DST ON AN.DataSourceTypeID = DST.DataSourceTypeID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMOwnerLocation AOL WITH(NOLOCK) ON AOL.AIMOwnerLocationID = S.AIMOwnerLocationID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMSource AMS ON S.AIMSourceID = AMS.AIMSourceID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMSourceLocation AMSL ON S.AIMSourceLocationID = AMSL.AIMSourceLocationID
' + @Where + ' ' +
'GROUP BY '
IF @UseAnalysisDate = 1 SET @SQL += ' SR.AnalysisDate ' Else SET @SQL += ' S.SampleDate '
SET @SQL += ' , AMM.AIMMaterialCode , AMS.AIMSupplierCode , AOL.LocationName , S.TicketNumber
, AMN.AIMNutrientName , s.samplecode , s.aimownerid , s.aimownerlocationid , s.aimsourceid , s.aimsourcelocationid , S.SampleID , S.AimMaterialID , AMN.AIMNutrientID , AMN.AIMNutrientCode
'
---- having max(case when dst.DataSourceTypeID = ' + cast(@DataSourceTypeID1 as varchar) + ' then resultValue end) > 0 ---- and max(case when dst.DataSourceTypeID = ' + cast(@DataSourceTypeID2 as varchar) + ' then resultValue end) > 0
--print @sql EXEC (@SQL)
END

-- exec usp_Report_SamplesByOwnerLocation '2015-06-15', '', NULL, 2, NULL, NULL, NULL
AS

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value:
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON;
DECLARE @RecordID INT = 0 DECLARE @ErrorNumber INT = 0 DECLARE @ErrorMessage VARCHAR(200) = '' declare @CurTestTypeID int
declare @DataSourceString varchar(MAX) DECLARE @SQL VARCHAR(MAX) = '' DECLARE @Where VARCHAR(MAX) = ''
IF @AIMOwnerID = 0 BEGIN SET @AIMOwnerID = NULL END IF @AIMOwnerLocationID = 0 BEGIN SET @AIMOwnerLocationID = NULL END
--1/15/24 IF @AIMMaterialID = 0 BEGIN SET @AIMMaterialID = NULL END
------------------------------------------------------------------ if @UseSampleDate = 1 SET @Where = ' WHERE S.SampleDate >= ''' + @FromDate + ''' ' else SET @Where = ' WHERE S.CreatedStamp >= ''' + @FromDate + ''' '
if @ToDate <> '' Begin if @UseSampleDate = 1 SET @Where = @Where + ' and S.SampleDate <= ''' + @ToDate + ''' ' else SET @Where = @Where + ' and S.CreatedStamp <= ''' + @ToDate + ''' ' End
if @CFCUserID <> 0 BEGIN SET @Where += ' AND S.CFCUserID = ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, @CFCUserID) END
IF @AIMOwnerID IS NOT NULL SET @Where += ' and S.AIMOwnerID = ' + Cast(@AIMOwnerID as varchar) + ' ' IF @AIMOwnerLocationID IS NOT NULL SET @Where += ' and S.AIMOwnerLocationID = ' + Cast(@AIMOwnerLocationID as varchar) + ' '
--if @SampleTestTypeID <> 0 -- SET @Where = @Where + ' and STTD.SampleTestTypeID = ' + Cast(@SampleTestTypeID as varchar) if @SampleTestTypeID = 0 SET @Where = @Where + ' and STTD.SampleTestTypeID > 0 ' if @MaterialTypeID <> 0 SET @Where = @Where + ' and AM.MaterialTypeID = ' + convert(varchar, @MaterialTypeID) if @SampleTestTypeID <> 0 SET @Where = @Where + ' and STTD.SampleTestTypeID = ' + convert(varchar, @SampleTestTypeID) SET @Where = @Where + ' and STTD.IsActive = 1 and STTR.IsActive = 1' if @AIMMaterialID <> 0 SET @Where = @Where + ' and AM.AIMMaterialID = ' + convert(varchar, @AIMMaterialID)
------------------------------------------------------------------ -- Put all the test types and datasource strings into a temp table IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM tempdb.sys.tables WHERE [name] like '#TestTypes%') DROP TABLE #TestTypes CREATE TABLE #TestTypes (SampleTestTypeID int, DataSourceString varchar(500))
declare TestTypecur scroll cursor for SELECT STT.SampleTestTypeID FROM dbo.SampleTestType STT open testTypecur fetch next from TestTypecur into @CurTestTypeID while @@fetch_status = 0 begin declare tempcur scroll cursor for SELECT STUFF((SELECT '; ' + DST.DataSourceTypeCode FROM SampleTestTypeResult STTR INNER JOIN dbo.SampleTestTypeDetail STTD on STTR.SampleTestTypeDetailID = STTD.SampleTestTypeDetailID INNER JOIN dbo.DataSourceType DST on STTD.DataSourceTypeID = DST.DataSourceTypeID WHERE STTD.SampleTestTypeID = @CurTestTypeID and STTD.IsActive = 1 and STTR.IsActive = 1 GROUP BY dst.DataSourceTypeCode FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') DataSourceString FROM SampleTestTypeDetail STTD WHERE STTD.SampleTestTypeID = @CurTestTypeID and STTD.IsActive = 1
open tempcur fetch next from tempcur into @DataSourceString if @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 begin insert into #TestTypes (SampleTestTypeID, DataSourceString) Select @CurTestTypeID, @DataSourceString fetch next from tempcur into @DataSourceString end close tempcur deallocate tempcur fetch next from TestTypecur into @CurTestTypeID end close TestTypecur deallocate TestTypecur
------------------------------------------------------------------ SET @SQL = 'SELECT
S.SampleID , S.SampleCode , S.LoadNumber , AOL.LocationName as OwnerLocationName , AM.AIMMaterialName as IngredientName , STT.SampleTestTypeName '
if @UseSampleDate = 1 Begin SET @SQL += ' , S.SampleDate , S.SampleDate as CreatedStamp , convert(varchar,convert(date, S.SampleDate)) as CreatedStampGroup ' End Else Begin SET @SQL += ' , S.CreatedStamp as SampleDate , S.CreatedStamp , convert(varchar,convert(date, S.CreatedStamp)) as CreatedStampGroup ' End
SET @SQL += ' , S.Notes , T.DataSourceString
FROM dbo.Sample S LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.SampleTestTypeResult STTR ON S.SampleID = STTR.SampleID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.SampleTestTypeDetail STTD ON STTR.SampleTestTypeDetailID = STTD.SampleTestTypeDetailID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.SampleTestType STT ON STTD.SampleTestTypeID = STT.SampleTestTypeID LEFT OUTER JOIN #TestTypes T ON STTD.SampleTestTypeID = T.SampleTestTypeID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMMaterial AM ON S.AIMMaterialID = AM.AIMMaterialID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMOwner AMO ON S.AIMOwnerID = AMO.AIMOwnerID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMOwnerLocation AOL ON S.AIMOwnerID = AOL.AIMOwnerID and S.AIMOwnerLocationID = AOL.AIMOwnerLocationID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMSource AMS ON S.AIMSourceID = AMS.AIMSourceID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMSourceLocation AMSL ON S.AIMSourceID = AMSL.AIMSourceID and S.AIMSourceLocationID = AMSL.AIMSourceLocationID ' SET @SQL = @SQL + @Where
SET @SQL = @SQL + '
GROUP BY S.SampleID , S.SampleCode , AOL.LocationName , STT.SampleTestTypeName , AMS.SourceName , AMSL.SourceLocationName , AM.AIMMaterialName , AM.MaterialTypeID '
if @UseSampleDate = 1 SET @SQL = @SQL + ', S.SampleDate ' else SET @SQL = @SQL + ', S.CreatedStamp '
SET @SQL = @Sql + ' , S.Notes , S.LoadNumber , T.DataSourceString
ORDER BY S.SampleCode '
--print @sql EXEC (@SQL)
END

Property.Name: BodyScript

BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON; DECLARE @RecordID INT = 0 DECLARE @ErrorNumber INT = 0 DECLARE @ErrorMessage VARCHAR(200) = ''
--5/4/17 - comment these and declared above. --DECLARE @AnalyzerMaterialID INT = 0 --DECLARE @AnalyzerSupplierID INT = 0 --DECLARE @AnalyzerSupplierLocationID INT = 0
--6/19/18 - Added 'TOP 1' to select stmt below (Marilyn and Nickki have 2 recs in System Settings table!?) --5/22/18 - Check SystemsSettings for auto-generated LotNumber and increment DECLARE @AutoLotNumber INT = 0 SET @AutoLotNumber = (SELECT TOP 1 Case When AutoGenerateLotNumber = 1 then NextLotNumber else 0 end FROM dbo.SystemSettings SS)
IF @AutoLotNumber <> 0 and (@LotNumber IS NULL or @LotNumber = '') BEGIN SET @LotNumber = @AutoLotNumber UPDATE dbo.SystemSettings SET NextLotNumber = NextLotNumber + 1 END
-- INSERT ANALYZER MATERIAL ------------------------------------------------------ IF ((@AnalyzerMaterialID = 0 OR @AnalyzerMaterialID = NULL) AND (Len(@AnalyzerMaterialCode) != 0 or @AnalyzerMaterialCode != NULL)) BEGIN IF EXISTS( SELECT AnalyzerMaterialID FROM dbo.AnalyzerMaterial WHERE AnalyzerMaterialCode = @AnalyzerMaterialCode AND DataSourceTypeID = @DataSourceTypeID ) BEGIN SET @AnalyzerMaterialID = (SELECT TOP 1 AnalyzerMaterialID FROM dbo.AnalyzerMaterial WHERE AnalyzerMaterialCode = @AnalyzerMaterialCode AND DataSourceTypeID = @DataSourceTypeID AND IsActive = 1) END ELSE BEGIN INSERT dbo.AnalyzerMaterial ( AnalyzerMaterialCode , AnalyzerMaterialName , DataSourceTypeID , CFCUserID ) VALUES ( @AnalyzerMaterialCode , @AnalyzerMaterialCode , @DataSourceTypeID , @CFCUserID ) SET @AnalyzerMaterialID = (SELECT TOP 1 AnalyzerMaterialID FROM dbo.AnalyzerMaterial WHERE AnalyzerMaterialCode = @AnalyzerMaterialCode AND DataSourceTypeID = @DataSourceTypeID AND IsActive = 1) END END -- INSERT ANALYZER MATERIAL CROSS-REFERENCE -------------------------------------- IF NOT EXISTS( SELECT AIMMaterialRefAnalyzerMaterialID FROM dbo.AIMMaterialRefAnalyzerMaterial XREF WHERE AIMMaterialID = @AIMMaterialID and AnalyzerMaterialID = @AnalyzerMaterialID) BEGIN INSERT dbo.AIMMaterialRefAnalyzerMaterial ( AIMMaterialID , AnalyzerMaterialID , UpdateStamp , CFCUserID ) VALUES ( @AIMMaterialID , @AnalyzerMaterialID , GetDate() , @CFCUserID ) END
-- INSERT ANALYZER SUPPLIER ------------------------------------------------------ IF ((@AnalyzerSupplierID = 0 OR @AnalyzerSupplierID = NULL) AND (Len(@AnalyzerSupplierCode) != 0 or @AnalyzerSupplierCode != NULL)) BEGIN IF EXISTS( SELECT AnalyzerSupplierID FROM dbo.AnalyzerSupplier WHERE AnalyzerSupplierCode = @AnalyzerSupplierCode AND DataSourceTypeID = @DataSourceTypeID ) BEGIN SET @AnalyzerSupplierID = (SELECT TOP 1 AnalyzerSupplierID FROM dbo.AnalyzerSupplier WHERE AnalyzerSupplierCode = @AnalyzerSupplierCode AND DataSourceTypeID = @DataSourceTypeID AND IsActive = 1) END ELSE BEGIN INSERT dbo.AnalyzerSupplier ( AnalyzerSupplierCode , AnalyzerSupplierName , DataSourceTypeID , CFCUserID ) VALUES ( @AnalyzerSupplierCode , @AnalyzerSupplierName , @DataSourceTypeID , @CFCUserID ) SET @AnalyzerSupplierID = (SELECT TOP 1 AnalyzerSupplierID FROM dbo.AnalyzerSupplier WHERE AnalyzerSupplierCode = @AnalyzerSupplierCode AND DataSourceTypeID = @DataSourceTypeID AND IsActive = 1) END END -- INSERT ANALYZER SUPPLIER CROSS-REFERENCE -------------------------------------- IF NOT EXISTS( SELECT AIMSupplierRefAnalyzerSupplierID FROM dbo.AIMSupplierRefAnalyzerSupplier XREF WHERE AIMSupplierID = @AIMSourceID and AnalyzerSupplierID = @AnalyzerSupplierID) BEGIN INSERT dbo.AIMSupplierRefAnalyzerSupplier ( AIMSupplierID , AnalyzerSupplierID , UpdateStamp , CFCUserID ) VALUES ( @AIMSourceID , @AnalyzerSupplierID , GetDate() , @CFCUserID ) END
-- INSERT ANALYZER SUPPLIER LOCATION --------------------------------------------- IF ((@AnalyzerSupplierLocationID = 0 OR @AnalyzerSupplierLocationID = NULL) AND (Len(@AnalyzerSupplierLocationCode) != 0 or @AnalyzerSupplierLocationCode != NULL)) BEGIN IF EXISTS( SELECT AnalyzerSupplierLocationID FROM dbo.AnalyzerSupplierLocation WHERE AnalyzerSupplierLocationCode = @AnalyzerSupplierLocationCode AND AnalyzerSupplierID = @AnalyzerSupplierID AND DataSourceTypeID = @DataSourceTypeID ) BEGIN SET @AnalyzerSupplierLocationID = (SELECT TOP 1 AnalyzerSupplierLocationID FROM dbo.AnalyzerSupplierLocation WHERE AnalyzerSupplierLocationCode = @AnalyzerSupplierLocationCode AND AnalyzerSupplierID = @AnalyzerSupplierID AND DataSourceTypeID = @DataSourceTypeID AND IsActive = 1) END ELSE BEGIN INSERT dbo.AnalyzerSupplierLocation ( AnalyzerSupplierID , AnalyzerSupplierLocationCode , AnalyzerSupplierLocationName , DataSourceTypeID , CFCUserID ) VALUES ( @AnalyzerSupplierID , @AnalyzerSupplierLocationCode , @AnalyzerSupplierLocationName , @DataSourceTypeID , @CFCUserID ) SET @AnalyzerSupplierLocationID = (SELECT TOP 1 AnalyzerSupplierLocationID FROM dbo.AnalyzerSupplierLocation WHERE AnalyzerSupplierLocationCode = @AnalyzerSupplierLocationCode AND AnalyzerSupplierID = @AnalyzerSupplierID AND DataSourceTypeID = @DataSourceTypeID AND IsActive = 1) END END -- INSERT ANALYZER SupplierLocation LOCATION CROSS-REFERENCE ----------------------------- IF NOT EXISTS( SELECT AIMSupplierLocationRefAnalyzerSupplierLocationID FROM dbo.AIMSupplierLocationRefAnalyzerSupplierLocation XREF WHERE AIMSupplierLocationID = @AIMSourceLocationID and AIMSupplierID = @AIMSourceID and AnalyzerSupplierLocationID = @AnalyzerSupplierLocationID and AnalyzerSupplierID = @AnalyzerSupplierID) BEGIN INSERT dbo.AIMSupplierLocationRefAnalyzerSupplierLocation ( AIMSupplierLocationID , AnalyzerSupplierLocationID , AIMSupplierID , AnalyzerSupplierID , UpdateStamp , CFCUserID ) VALUES ( @AIMSourceLocationID , @AnalyzerSupplierLocationID , @AIMSourceID , @AnalyzerSupplierID , GetDate() , @CFCUserID ) END
-- Update Sample -------------------------------------------------------------- IF @SampleID > 0 BEGIN UPDATE dbo.Sample WITH(ROWLOCK) SET SampleCode = ISNULL(@SampleCode, SampleCode) , SampleDate = ISNULL(@SampleDate, SampleDate) , AlternateCode = ISNULL(@AlternateCode, AlternateCode) , AIMOwnerID = ISNULL(@AIMOwnerID, AIMOwnerID) , AIMSourceID = ISNULL(@AIMSourceID, AIMSourceID) , AIMSourceLocationID = ISNULL(@AIMSourceLocationID, AIMSourceLocationID) , AIMMaterialID = ISNULL(@AIMMaterialID, AIMMaterialID) , AnalyzerMaterialID = ISNULL(@AnalyzerMaterialID, AnalyzerMaterialID) , ContractNumber = ISNULL(@ContractNumber, ContractNumber) , PoNumber = ISNULL(@PoNumber, PoNumber) , InvoiceNumber = ISNULL(@InvoiceNumber, InvoiceNumber) , TicketNumber = ISNULL(@TicketNumber, TicketNumber) , LoadNumber = ISNULL(@LoadNumber, LoadNumber) , BillOfLoad = ISNULL(@BillOfLoad, BillOfLoad) , VehicleNumber = ISNULL(@VehicleNumber, VehicleNumber) , IsActive = ISNULL(@IsActive, @IsActive) , LotNumber = ISNULL(@LotNumber, @LotNumber) , AnalysisDate = ISNULL(@AnalysisDate, @AnalysisDate) , AIMOwnerLocationID = ISNULL(@AIMOwnerLocationID, @AIMOwnerLocationID) , CFCUserID = ISNULL(@CFCUserID, CFCUserID) , UpdateStamp = GETDATE() , FurtherAnalysisID = ISNULL(@FurtherAnalysisID, FurtherAnalysisID) , DataSourceTypeID = ISNULL(@DataSourceTypeID, DataSourceTypeID) , CFCProductArchiveID = ISNULL(@CFCProductArchiveID, CFCProductArchiveID) , Notes = ISNULL(@Notes, Notes) , ExpirationDate = ISNULL(@ExpirationDate, ExpirationDate) , SupportingDocumentPath = ISNULL(@SupportingDocumentPath, SupportingDocumentPath) , SampleTypeID = ISNULL(@SampleTypeID, SampleTypeID) , IsGround = ISNULL(@IsGround, IsGround) , SampleTestTypeID = ISNULL(@SampleTestTypeID, SampleTestTypeID) , GroundUnGroundID = ISNULL(@GroundUnGroundID, GroundUnGroundID) , @ErrorMessage = 'Successfully Saved' WHERE SampleID = @SampleID
END
-- Insert Sample -------------------------------------------------------------- ELSE BEGIN
INSERT dbo.Sample WITH(ROWLOCK) ( SampleCode , AlternateCode , SampleDate , CreatedStamp , AIMOwnerID , AIMSourceID , AIMSourceLocationID , AIMMaterialID , AnalyzerMaterialID , ContractNumber , PoNumber , InvoiceNumber , TicketNumber , LoadNumber , BillOfLoad , VehicleNumber , LotNumber , AnalysisDate , AIMOwnerLocationID , CFCUserID , FurtherAnalysisID , DataSourceTypeID , CFCProductArchiveID , Notes , ExpirationDate , SupportingDocumentPath , SampleTypeID , IsGround , SampleTestTypeID , GroundUnGroundID ) VALUES ( @SampleCode , @AlternateCode , @SampleDate , GETDATE() , @AIMOwnerID , @AIMSourceID , @AIMSourceLocationID , @AIMMaterialID , @AnalyzerMaterialID , @ContractNumber , @PoNumber , @InvoiceNumber , @TicketNumber , @LoadNumber , @BillOfLoad , @VehicleNumber , @LotNumber , @AnalysisDate , @AIMOwnerLocationID , @CFCUserID , @FurtherAnalysisID , @DataSourceTypeID , @CFCProductArchiveID , @Notes , @ExpirationDate , @SupportingDocumentPath , @SampleTypeID , @IsGround , @SampleTestTypeID , @GroundUnGroundID )
IF @SampleCode IS NULL OR len(@SampleCode) = 0 Begin UPDATE dbo.SAMPLE with (rowlock) SET SampleCode = SampleID WHERE SampleID = @@IDENTITY End END
SELECT @@IDENTITY as RecordID , @ErrorNumber AS ErrorNumber , @ErrorMessage AS ErrorMessage
END

----------------------------------------------------------------------------- --This gets the numbers for the math. Any changes have to be made to the ##Proposed table --When doing the Quartile and the sample size is less than four, Quartile1 = min and Quartile3 = max of the sample set --This is so the outlier will not kick those values out if there are fewer than 4 samples.
--9/8/17 -- added "AND S.AIMNutrientID = SAM.AIMNutrientID" to join of SampleAIM table below. -- Perdue data somehow calulates exponential standard dev of 3.76972873230979E-08 -- on SampleID 53511, AIMMaterialID 947, AIMNutrientID 102, SampleResultID 271862, AIMUsedValue = 3.15
--untrimmed SampleSize is in the next select statement below. SET @SQL = 'SELECT ST.AIMMaterialID' + @ST + @Location + ' , ST.AIMNutrientID , Q.SampleSize , ISNULL(Q.Quartile1, 0) AS Quartile1 , ISNULL(Q.Quartile3, 0) AS Quartile3 , ST.Mean , ST.StandardDeviation , ST.DetailMin , ST.DetailMax , ST.DetailSQRT , ST.WarningGlobalH , ST.WarningMinMaxLimit , ISNULL(ROUND(Q.Quartile1 - 1.5 * (Q.Quartile3 - Q.Quartile1), 4), 0) AS LMin , ISNULL(ROUND(Q.Quartile1 - 3 * (Q.Quartile3 - Q.Quartile1), 4), 0) AS LMax , ISNULL(ROUND(Q.Quartile3 + 1.5 * (Q.Quartile3 - Q.Quartile1), 4), 0) AS UMin , ISNULL(ROUND(Q.Quartile3 + 3 * (Q.Quartile3 - Q.Quartile1), 4), 0) AS UMax , CASE WHEN ISNULL(Q.Quartile1, 0) = ISNULL(Q.Quartile3, 0) THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN ISNULL(Q.Quartile1, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN ISNULL(Q.Quartile3, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END END END AS IsUntrimmedValidOutlier INTO ##Statis1 FROM ( SELECT S.AIMMaterialID' + @SStat + @LocationStat + ' , S.AIMNutrientID , ROUND(AVG(S.AIMUsedValue), 4) AS Mean , ROUND(STDEV(S.AIMUsedValue), 4) AS StandardDeviation , MIN(S.AIMUsedValue) AS DetailMin , MAX(S.AIMUsedValue) AS DetailMax , SQRT(COUNT(*)) AS DetailSQRT , SUM(CASE WHEN SAM.AimUsedValue NOT BETWEEN WL.Min and WL.Max THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as WarningMinMaxLimit , SUM(CASE WHEN SRP.GlobalH > SRP.Limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as WarningGlobalH
FROM ##Sample S LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.SampleResultPredict SRP WITH(NOLOCK) ON SRP.SampleResultID = S.SampleResultID LEFT JOIN dbo.SampleAIM SAM WITH(NOLOCK) ON S.SampleID = SAM.SampleID AND S.AIMNutrientID = SAM.AIMNutrientID LEFT JOIN dbo.WarningLimits WL WITH(NOLOCK) ON S.AIMMaterialID = WL.AIMMaterialID AND S.AIMNutrientID = WL.AIMNutrientID GROUP BY S.AIMMaterialID' + @SStat + @LocationStat + ', S.AIMNutrientID ) ST INNER JOIN ( SELECT S.AIMMaterialID' + @SStat + @LocationStat + ' , S.AIMNutrientID , S.SampleSize , CASE WHEN SampleSize < 4 THEN MinValue ELSE Quartile1 END Quartile1 , CASE WHEN SampleSize < 4 THEN MaxValue ELSE Quartile3 END Quartile3 FROM ( SELECT S.AIMMaterialID' + @SStat + @LocationStat + ' , S.AIMNutrientID , COUNT(*) AS SampleSize , MAX(AIMUsedValue) AS MaxValue , MIN(AIMUsedValue) AS MinValue , ROUND((Max(Q1NextVal) - MAX(Q1Val)) * Max(Q1Frac) + Max(Q1Val), 4) AS Quartile1 , ROUND((Max(Q3NextVal) - MAX(Q3Val)) * Max(Q3Frac) + Max(Q3Val), 4) AS Quartile3 FROM ( SELECT D.AIMMaterialID' + @DStat + @LocationStat + ' , D.AIMNutrientID , CASE WHEN RowNum = Q1Idx THEN AIMUsedValue ELSE NULL END AS Q1Val , CASE WHEN RowNum = Q1Idx + 1 THEN AIMUsedValue ELSE NULL END AS Q1NextVal , CASE WHEN RowNum = Q3Idx THEN AIMUsedValue ELSE NULL END AS Q3Val , CASE WHEN RowNum = Q3Idx + 1 THEN AIMUsedValue ELSE NULL END AS Q3NextVal , Q1Frac , Q3Frac , AIMUsedValue FROM ( SELECT S.AIMUsedValue , S.AIMMaterialID' + @SStat + @LocationStat + ' , S.AIMNutrientID , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY S.AIMMaterialID' + ', S.AIMNutrientID ORDER BY S.AIMUsedValue) AS RowNum FROM ##Sample S ) D LEFT OUTER JOIN (/*the values at the quartile points.*/ SELECT S.AIMMaterialID' + @SStat + @LocationStat + ' , S.AIMNutrientID , FLOOR((COUNT(*) + 3) / 4.0) AS Q1Idx , ((COUNT(*) + 3) / 4.0) - FLOOR((COUNT(*) + 3) / 4.0) AS Q1Frac , FLOOR((COUNT(*) * 3 + 1) / 4.0) AS Q3Idx , ((COUNT(*) * 3 + 1) / 4.0) - FLOOR((COUNT(*) * 3 + 1) / 4.0) AS Q3Frac FROM ##Sample S GROUP BY S.AIMMaterialID' + @SStat + @LocationStat + ', S.AIMNutrientID HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) S ON D.AIMMaterialID = S.AIMMaterialID ' + @ONStat + 'AND D.AIMNutrientID = S.AIMNutrientID ) S GROUP BY S.AIMMaterialID ' + @SStat + @LocationStat + ', S.AIMNutrientID ) S ) Q ON Q.AIMMaterialID = ST.AIMMaterialID ' + @QONStat + 'AND Q.AIMNutrientID = ST.AIMNutrientID ORDER BY ST.AIMMaterialID , ST.AIMNutrientID' EXEC (@SQL) --print @SQL ----goto continu
----------------------------------------------------------------------------- SET @SQL = 'SELECT S.SampleID , S.SampleCode , S.AIMMaterialID , S.AIMOwnerID , S.AIMOwnerLocationID , S.AIMSourceID , S.AIMSourceLocationID , S.SampleDate , S.IsActive , S.AIMNutrientID , S.AIMUsedValue , S.SampleAIMID , S.AIMMaterialCode , S.AIMMaterialName , S.AIMNutrientCode , S.AIMNutrientName , S.MathTypeID '
if @AnalysisQuery = 2 BEGIN SET @SQL += ', S.DataSourceTypeName ' SET @SQL += ', S.LotNumber ' --Task1147 DB260420 SET @SQL += ' , S.SampleTypeID ' --Task1147 DB260421 SET @SQL += ' , S.SampleTypeName ' --Task1147 DB260421 SET @SQL += ' , S.WLMin ' --Task1147 DB260422 SET @SQL += ' , S.WLMax ' --Task1147 DB260422 END --6/24/20 --SET @SQL += ' --, CASE WHEN ST.LMin > S.AIMUsedValue THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS LMin --, CASE WHEN ST.LMax > S.AIMUsedValue THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS LMax --, CASE WHEN S.AIMUsedValue > ST.UMin THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS UMin --, CASE WHEN S.AIMUsedValue > ST.UMax THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS UMax SET @SQL += ' , CASE When S.AimUsedValue < 0 Then Case When ST.LMin < S.AIMUsedValue Then 1 Else 0 End else Case When St.LMin > S.AimUsedValue Then 1 else 0 end END as LMin , CASE When S.AimUsedValue < 0 Then Case When St.LMax < S.AimUsedValue Then 1 Else 0 End else Case When St.LMax > S.AimUsedValue Then 1 else 0 end END as LMax , CASE When S.AimUsedValue < 0 Then Case When S.AIMUsedValue < ST.UMin Then 1 Else 0 End else Case When S.AIMUsedValue > ST.UMin Then 1 else 0 end END as UMin , CASE When S.AimUsedValue < 0 Then Case When S.AIMUsedValue < ST.UMax Then 1 Else 0 End else Case When S.AIMUsedValue > ST.UMax Then 1 else 0 end END as UMax
INTO ##Statis2 FROM ##Sample S LEFT OUTER JOIN ##Statis1 ST ON ST.AIMMaterialID = S.AIMMaterialID ' + @SON + 'AND ST.AIMNutrientID = S.AIMNutrientID' EXEC (@SQL) --print @sql ----goto continu
