----------------------------------------------------------------------------- --This gets the numbers for the PROPOSED math Any changes have to be made to the ##Statis1 table
--9/8/17 -- added "AND S.AIMNutrientID = SA.AIMNutrientID" to join of SampleAIM table below. -- Perdue data somehow calulates exponential standard dev of 3.76972873230979E-08 -- on SampleID 53511, AIMMaterialID 947, AIMNutrientID 102, SampleResultID 271862, AIMUsedValue = 3.15
--10/2/20 -- added TSS join and TSS.TotalSampleSize to select stmt (per Nickki) --12/19/22 -- added join to SampleResult in ST below, to get only Active sample results (SR.IsActive = 1)
SET @SQL = 'SELECT ST.AIMMaterialID' + @ST + @Location + ', ST.AIMNutrientID , ST.TrimmedSampleSize , TSS.TotalSampleSize , ISNULL(Q.TrimmedQuartile1, 0) AS TrimmedQuartile1 , ISNULL(Q.TrimmedQuartile3, 0) AS TrimmedQuartile3 , ST.TrimmedMean , ST.TrimmedStandardDeviation , ST.TrimmedDetailMin , ST.TrimmedDetailMax , ST.TrimmedDetailSQRT , ISNULL(ROUND(Q.TrimmedQuartile1 - 1.5 * (Q.TrimmedQuartile3 - Q.TrimmedQuartile1), 4), 0) AS TrimmedLMin , ISNULL(ROUND(Q.TrimmedQuartile1 - 3 * (Q.TrimmedQuartile3 - Q.TrimmedQuartile1), 4), 0) AS TrimmedLMax , ISNULL(ROUND(Q.TrimmedQuartile3 + 1.5 * (Q.TrimmedQuartile3 - Q.TrimmedQuartile1), 4), 0) AS TrimmedUMin , ISNULL(ROUND(Q.TrimmedQuartile3 + 3 * (Q.TrimmedQuartile3 - Q.TrimmedQuartile1), 4), 0) AS TrimmedUMax , CASE WHEN ISNULL(Q.TrimmedQuartile1, 0) = ISNULL(Q.TrimmedQuartile3, 0) THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN ISNULL(Q.TrimmedQuartile1, 0) + ISNULL(Q.TrimmedQuartile3, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN ISNULL(Q.TrimmedQuartile1, 0) + ISNULL(Q.TrimmedQuartile3, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END END END AS IsTrimmedValidOutlier INTO ##Proposed FROM ( SELECT S.AIMMaterialID' + @S + @Location + ', S.AIMNutrientID , ROUND(AVG(S.AIMUsedValue), 4) AS TrimmedMean , ROUND(STDEV(S.AIMUsedValue), 4) AS TrimmedStandardDeviation , MIN(S.AIMUsedValue) AS TrimmedDetailMin , MAX(S.AIMUsedValue) AS TrimmedDetailMax , SQRT(COUNT(*)) AS TrimmedDetailSQRT , COUNT(*) AS TrimmedSampleSize FROM ##Sample S LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.SampleResultPredict SRP WITH(NOLOCK) ON SRP.SampleResultID = S.SampleResultID INNER JOIN dbo.SampleAIM SA WITH(NOLOCK) ON S.SampleID = SA.SampleID AND S.AIMNutrientID = SA.AIMNutrientID INNER JOIN dbo.SampleResult SR ON SA.SampleResultID = SR.SampleResultID LEFT JOIN dbo.SampleAIMRefCFCUser SARCU WITH(NOLOCK) ON SARCU.SampleAIMID = S.SampleAIMID AND SARCU.CFCUserID = ' + CAST(@CFCUserID AS VARCHAR) + ' WHERE S.IsActive = 1 and SR.IsActive = 1 AND SARCU.SampleAIMRefCFCUserID IS NULL ' + @Where + 'GROUP BY S.AIMMaterialID' + @S + @Location + ', S.AIMNutrientID ) ST
INNER JOIN (SELECT S.AIMMaterialID, S.AIMNutrientID, COUNT(*) AS TotalSampleSize FROM ##Sample S INNER JOIN dbo.SampleAIM SA WITH(NOLOCK) ON S.SampleID = SA.SampleID AND S.AIMNutrientID = SA.AIMNutrientID INNER JOIN dbo.SampleResult SR ON SA.SampleResultID = SR.SampleResultID WHERE S.IsActive = 1 and SR.IsActive = 1' + @Where + ' GROUP BY S.AIMMaterialID, S.AIMNutrientID ) TSS ON TSS.AIMMaterialID = ST.AIMMaterialID AND TSS.AIMNutrientID = ST.AIMNutrientID
INNER JOIN ( SELECT S.AIMMaterialID' + @S + @Location + ', S.AIMNutrientID , ROUND((Max(Q1NextVal) - MAX(Q1Val)) * Max(Q1Frac) + Max(Q1Val), 4) AS TrimmedQuartile1 , ROUND((Max(Q3NextVal) - MAX(Q3Val)) * Max(Q3Frac) + Max(Q3Val), 4) AS TrimmedQuartile3 FROM ( SELECT D.AIMMaterialID' + @D + @Location + ', D.AIMNutrientID , CASE WHEN RowNum = Q1Idx THEN AIMUsedValue ELSE NULL END AS Q1Val , CASE WHEN RowNum = Q1Idx + 1 THEN AIMUsedValue ELSE NULL END AS Q1NextVal , CASE WHEN RowNum = Q3Idx THEN AIMUsedValue ELSE NULL END AS Q3Val , CASE WHEN RowNum = Q3Idx + 1 THEN AIMUsedValue ELSE NULL END AS Q3NextVal , Q1Frac , Q3Frac , AIMUsedValue FROM ##SampleRowNumber D LEFT OUTER JOIN (/*the values at the quartile points.*/ SELECT S.AIMMaterialID' + @S + @Location + ', S.AIMNutrientID , FLOOR((COUNT(*) + 3) / 4.0) AS Q1Idx , ((COUNT(*) + 3) / 4.0) - FLOOR((COUNT(*) + 3) / 4.0) AS Q1Frac , FLOOR((COUNT(*) * 3 + 1) / 4.0) AS Q3Idx , ((COUNT(*) * 3 + 1) / 4.0) - FLOOR((COUNT(*) * 3 + 1) / 4.0) AS Q3Frac FROM ##Sample S
INNER JOIN dbo.SampleAIM SA ON S.SampleID = SA.SampleID
LEFT JOIN dbo.SampleAIMRefCFCUser SARCU WITH(NOLOCK) ON SARCU.SampleAIMID = S.SampleAIMID AND SARCU.CFCUserID = ' + CAST(@CFCUserID AS VARCHAR) + ' WHERE SARCU.SampleAIMRefCFCUserID IS NULL ' + @Where + 'GROUP BY S.AIMMaterialID' + @S + @Location + ', S.AIMNutrientID HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) AS S ON D.AIMMaterialID = S.AIMMaterialID ' + @ON + 'AND D.AIMNutrientID = S.AIMNutrientID ) AS S GROUP BY S.AIMMaterialID ' + @S + @Location + ', S.AIMNutrientID ) Q ON Q.AIMMaterialID = ST.AIMMaterialID ' + @QON + 'AND Q.AIMNutrientID = ST.AIMNutrientID ORDER BY ST.AIMMaterialID , ST.AIMNutrientID' EXEC (@SQL) ----print @sql ----goto continu
----------------------------------------------------------------------------- --This gets the final query - and will have different columns based on the grouping SET @SQL = 'SELECT CASE WHEN T.IncludedSample = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS IsInclude , ISNULL(SR.SampleSize, 1) AS SampleSize , ISNULL(P.TrimmedSampleSize,1) AS TrimmedSampleSize , ISNULL(P.TotalSampleSize,1) AS TotalSampleSize , T.CFCIngredientName , T.SampleValue , T.CFCIngredientCode , T.Unit , T.AIMMaterialID , T.AIMMaterialCode , T.AIMMaterialName , T.AIMNutrientID , T.AIMNutrientCode , T.AIMNutrientName , T.MathTypeID '
if @AnalysisQuery = 2 BEGIN SET @SQL += ', T.DataSourceTypeName ' SET @SQL += ', T.LotNumber ' --Task1147 DB260420 SET @SQL += ', T.SampleTypeID ' --Task1147 DB260421 SET @SQL += ', T.SampleTypeName' --Task1147 DB260421 SET @SQL += ', T.WLMin ' --Task1147 DB260422 SET @SQL += ', T.WLMax ' --Task1147 DB260422 SET @SQL += ', ISNULL(CASE WHEN T.SampleValue < T.WLMin THEN 1 ELSE CASE WHEN T.SampleValue > T.WLMax THEN 2 ELSE 0 END END, 0) AS ResultValueFlag ' END SET @SQL += ' , T.CFCNutrientCode , T.CFCNutrientName , T.NumberOfSample , T.CFCIngredientID , T.CFCNutrientID , SR.IsUntrimmedValidOutlier , ISNULL(SR.Quartile1, T.SampleValue) AS Quartile1 , ISNULL(SR.Quartile3, T.SampleValue) AS Quartile3 , ISNULL(SR.Mean, T.SampleValue) AS UntrimmedMean , ISNULL(SR.StandardDeviation, 0) AS UntrimmedStandardDeviation , ISNULL(SR.DetailMin, T.SampleValue) AS UntrimmedDetailMin , ISNULL(SR.DetailMax, T.SampleValue) AS UntrimmedDetailMax , ISNULL(SR.DetailSQRT, T.SampleValue) AS UntrimmedDetailSQRT , ISNULL(SR.WarningGlobalH, 0) AS WarningGlobalH , ISNULL(SR.WarningMinMaxLimit, 0) AS WarningMinMaxLimit , ISNULL(T.LMin,0) AS LMin , ISNULL(T.LMax,0) AS LMax , ISNULL(T.UMin,0) AS UMin , ISNULL(T.UMax,0) AS UMax , P.IsTrimmedValidOutlier , ISNULL(P.TrimmedQuartile1, T.SampleValue) AS TrimmedFirstQuartile , ISNULL(P.TrimmedQuartile3, T.SampleValue) AS TrimmedThirdQuartile , ISNULL(P.TrimmedMean, T.SampleValue) AS TrimmedMean , ISNULL(P.TrimmedStandardDeviation, 0) AS TrimmedStandardDeviation , ISNULL(P.TrimmedDetailMin, T.SampleValue) AS TrimmedDetailMin , ISNULL(P.TrimmedDetailMax, T.SampleValue) AS TrimmedDetailMax , ISNULL(P.TrimmedDetailSQRT, T.SampleValue) AS TrimmedDetailSQRT , ' + @StrNutrValue + @Total + @CFCLocation + ' FROM ( SELECT S.IsActive , S.AIMMaterialID , S.AIMMaterialCode , S.AIMMaterialName , S.AIMNutrientID , S.AIMNutrientCode , S.AIMNutrientName , S.MathTypeID '
if @AnalysisQuery = 2 BEGIN SET @SQL += ', S.DataSourceTypeName ' SET @SQL += ', S.LotNumber ' --Task1147 DB260420 SET @SQL += ', S.SampleTypeID ' --Task1147 DB260421 SET @SQL += ', S.SampleTypeName ' --Task1147 DB260421 SET @SQL += ', S.WLMin ' --Task1147 DB260422 SET @SQL += ', S.WLMax ' --Task1147 DB260422 END SET @SQL += '
, CI.CFCIngredientName , CI.CFCIngredientID , CI.CFCIngredientCode , CN.Unit , CN.CFCNutrientID , CN.CFCNutrientCode , CN.CFCNutrientName , AVG(S.AIMUsedValue) AS SampleValue , SUM(S.LMin) AS LMin , SUM(S.LMax) AS LMax , SUM(S.UMin) AS UMin , SUM(S.UMax) AS UMax , SUM(CASE WHEN SARCU.SampleAIMID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS IncludedSample , COUNT(*) AS NumberOfSample ' + @Group + @CFCLocationGroup + ' FROM ##Statis2 S LEFT JOIN dbo.SampleAIMRefCFCUser SARCU WITH(NOLOCK) ON SARCU.SampleAIMID = S.SampleAIMID AND SARCU.CFCUserID = ' + CAST(@CFCUserID AS VARCHAR) + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMOwner AO ON AO.AIMOwnerID = S.AIMOwnerID AND AO.IsActive = 1 LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMOwnerLocation AOL ON AOL.AIMOwnerLocationID = S.AIMOwnerLocationID AND AOL.IsActive = 1 AND AOL.IsFormulationPlant = 1 LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMSource SS ON SS.AIMSourceID = S.AIMSourceID AND SS.IsActive = 1 LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMSourceLocation ASL ON ASL.AIMSourceLocationID = S.AIMSourceLocationID AND ASL.IsActive = 1 LEFT OUTER JOIN ##CFCNutrient CN ON CN.AIMNutrientID = S.AIMNutrientID LEFT OUTER JOIN ##CFCPlant CP ON CP.AIMOwnerLocationID = S.AIMOwnerLocationID LEFT OUTER JOIN ##CFCIngredient CI ON CI.AIMMaterialID = S.AIMMaterialID WHERE S.IsActive = 1 AND AOL.IsFormulationPlant = 1 ' + @CFCWhere
-- 6/30/21 - added for Randy at Perdue If @ChartsSupplierOwnerWhere > '' SET @SQL += @ChartsSupplierOwnerWhere
SET @SQL += ' GROUP BY S.IsActive , CI.CFCIngredientName , CI.CFCIngredientCode , CI.CFCIngredientID , S.AIMMaterialID , S.AIMMaterialCode , S.AIMMaterialName , S.AIMNutrientID , S.AIMNutrientCode , S.AIMNutrientName , S.MathTypeID '
IF @AnalysisQuery = 2 BEGIN SET @SQL += ', S.DataSourceTypeName ' SET @SQL += ', S.LotNumber ' --Task1147 DB260420 SET @SQL += ', S.SampleTypeID ' --Task1147 DB260421 SET @SQL += ', S.SampleTypeName' --Task1147 DB260421 SET @SQL += ', S.WLMin ' --Task1147 DB260422 SET @SQL += ', S.WLMax ' --Task1147 DB260422 END
SET @SQL += '
, CN.Unit , CI.CFCIngredientCode , CN.CFCNutrientID , CN.CFCNutrientCode , CN.CFCNutrientName ' + @Group + @CFCLocationGroup + ' ) T LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.CFCIngredientNutrient CIN ON CIN.CFCIngredientID = T.CFCIngredientID AND CIN.CFCNutrientID = T.CFCNutrientID LEFT OUTER JOIN ##Statis1 SR ON SR.AIMMaterialID = T.AIMMaterialID ' + @SRON + ' AND SR.AIMNutrientID = T.AIMNutrientID LEFT OUTER JOIN ##Proposed P ON P.AIMMaterialID = T.AIMMaterialID ' + @PON + ' AND P.AIMNutrientID = T.AIMNutrientID ' + @StrJoinNutrValue + @TWhere + ' ORDER BY T.AIMMaterialID , T.AIMNutrientID ' + @Total
-----print @CFCWhere
EXEC (@SQL) --print @SQL ----GOTO CONTINU
IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM tempdb.sys.tables WHERE [name] like '##Sample%') DROP TABLE ##Sample IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM tempdb.sys.tables WHERE [name] like '##Statis1%') DROP TABLE ##Statis1 IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM tempdb.sys.tables WHERE [name] like '##Proposed%') DROP TABLE ##Proposed IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM tempdb.sys.tables WHERE [name] like '##Statis2%') DROP TABLE ##Statis2 IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM tempdb.sys.tables WHERE [name] like '##CFCPlant%') DROP TABLE ##CFCPlant IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM tempdb.sys.tables WHERE [name] like '##CFCIngredient%') DROP TABLE ##CFCIngredient IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM tempdb.sys.tables WHERE [name] like '##CFCNutrient%') DROP TABLE ##CFCNutrient IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM tempdb.sys.tables WHERE [name] like '##SampleRowNumber%') DROP TABLE ##SampleRowNumber IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM tempdb.sys.tables WHERE [name] like '##SpecificCFCIngredientNutrient%') DROP TABLE ##SpecificCFCIngredientNutrient
continu: END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_Sample_SEL_Analysis] @AnalysisQuery INT , @StartDate DATE = NULL , @EndDate DATE = NULL , @QueryTemplateID INT = NULL , @IsDefaultLocation BIT = NULL , @IsSubSet BIT = NULL , @AimDataBaseID INT = NULL , @AIMMaterialID INT = NULL , @AIMNutrientID INT = NULL , @SampleDate DATE = NULL , @SampleID INT = NULL , @AIMOwnerID INT = NULL , @AIMOwnerLocationID INT = NULL , @AIMSourceID INT = NULL , @AIMSourceLocationID INT = NULL , @CFCPlantID INT = NULL -- currently, not used below , @CFCUserID INT = NULL , @OutlierType INT = NULL , @CFCIngredientID INT = NULL -- added 9/28/16 , @SpecificCFCPlantID INT = NULL -- added 3/15/17
-- 6/30/21 - added for Control Chart , @FromCharts BIT = NULL , @AIMSourceID2 INT = NULL , @AIMSourceLocationID2 INT = NULL , @AIMSourceID3 INT = NULL , @AIMSourceLocationID3 INT = NULL , @AIMSourceID4 INT = NULL , @AIMSourceLocationID4 INT = NULL , @AIMOwnerID2 INT = NULL , @AIMOwnerLocationID2 INT = NULL , @AIMOwnerID3 INT = NULL , @AIMOwnerLocationID3 INT = NULL , @AIMOwnerID4 INT = NULL , @AIMOwnerLocationID4 INT = NULL , @SupplierOwnerOption INT = NULL --9/8/21

BEGIN DECLARE @SQL VARCHAR(6000) = '' DECLARE @Total VARCHAR(1000) = '' DECLARE @Where VARCHAR(1000) = '' DECLARE @WhereValue VARCHAR(1000) = '' DECLARE @Group VARCHAR(1000) = '' DECLARE @CFCLocation VARCHAR(1000) = '' DECLARE @CFCLocationGroup VARCHAR(1000) = '' DECLARE @Location VARCHAR(100) = '' DECLARE @LocationStat VARCHAR(100) = '' DECLARE @SStat VARCHAR(4) = '' DECLARE @DStat VARCHAR(4) = '' DECLARE @ONStat VARCHAR(60) = '' DECLARE @QONStat VARCHAR(60) = '' DECLARE @S VARCHAR(4) = '' DECLARE @D VARCHAR(4) = '' DECLARE @ST VARCHAR(5) = '' DECLARE @ON VARCHAR(60) = '' DECLARE @SRON VARCHAR(60) = '' DECLARE @PON VARCHAR(60) = '' DECLARE @SON VARCHAR(60) = '' DECLARE @QON VARCHAR(60) = '' DECLARE @TWhere VARCHAR(500) = '' DECLARE @Outlier VARCHAR(70) = '' DECLARE @QueryFieldID INT = 0 DECLARE @StrNutrValue VARCHAR(1000) = '' DECLARE @StrJoinNutrValue VARCHAR(1000) = '' DECLARE @CFCWhere VARCHAR(1000) = '' DECLARE @WhereNutrient VARCHAR(1000) = '' DECLARE @MatNutWhere VARCHAR(1000) = '' DECLARE @SampleName VARCHAR(20) = ' ##Sample' DECLARE @ProposedName VARCHAR(20) = ' ##Proposed' DECLARE @Statis1Name VARCHAR(20) = ' ##Statis1' DECLARE @Statis2Name VARCHAR(20) = ' ##Statis2' DECLARE @SampleRowNumberName VARCHAR(25) = ' ##SampleRowNumber' DECLARE @CFCPlantName VARCHAR(20) = ' ##CFCPlant' DECLARE @CFCProductName VARCHAR(20) = ' ##CFCProduct' DECLARE @CFCNutrientName VARCHAR(20) = ' ##CFCNutrient'
SET NOCOUNT ON;
SET @SampleName = @SampleName + CAST(@CFCUserID AS VARCHAR) + ' ' SET @ProposedName = @ProposedName + CAST(@CFCUserID AS VARCHAR) + ' ' SET @Statis1Name = @Statis1Name + CAST(@CFCUserID AS VARCHAR) + ' ' SET @Statis2Name = @Statis2Name + CAST(@CFCUserID AS VARCHAR) + ' ' SET @SampleRowNumberName = @SampleRowNumberName + CAST(@CFCUserID AS VARCHAR) + ' ' SET @CFCPlantName = @CFCPlantName + CAST(@CFCUserID AS VARCHAR) + ' ' SET @CFCProductName = @CFCProductName + CAST(@CFCUserID AS VARCHAR) + ' ' SET @CFCNutrientName = @CFCNutrientName + CAST(@CFCUserID AS VARCHAR) + ' '
-- Set T-WHERE string -------------------------------------------------------- IF @IsSubSet = 1 BEGIN Set @TWhere = ' WHERE ' Set @TWhere += ' T.AIMMaterialID = ' + Cast(@AIMMaterialID as varchar) Set @TWhere += ' and T.AIMNutrientID = ' + Cast(@AIMNutrientID as varchar)
--1/4/23 --IF @SampleDate IS NOT NULL IF @SampleDate IS NOT NULL and @SampleDate <> ''
Set @TWhere += ' and T.SampleDate = ''' + Cast(@SampleDate as varchar) + ''' ' If @SampleID IS NOT NULL AND @SampleID <> 0 Set @Twhere += ' and T.SampleID = ' + Cast(@SampleID as varchar) If @AIMOwnerID IS NOT NULL AND @AIMOwnerID <> 0 Set @Twhere += ' and T.AIMOwnerID = ' + Cast(@AIMOwnerID as varchar) If @AIMOwnerLocationID IS NOT NULL AND @AIMOwnerLocationID <> 0 Set @Twhere += ' and T.AIMOwnerLocationID = ' + Cast(@AIMOwnerLocationID as varchar)
--1/4/23 If @ArchiveVersion IS NOT NULL Set @TWhere += ' and T.ArchiveVersion = ''' + @ArchiveVersion + '''' END
----------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- This is used when doing an overlay location SET @StrNutrValue = 'ISNULL(CPAN.NutrientValue, 0) AS PredictedValue, 0 AS IsOverlay '
----------------------------------------------------------------------------- --- If there is no query, only the date is used on the where statement IF @QueryTemplateID = 0 SET @Where = 'AND S.SampleDate BETWEEN ''' + CAST(@StartDate AS VARCHAR) + ''' AND ''' + CAST(@EndDate AS VARCHAR) + ''' '
----------------------------------------------------------------------------- --- This creates the where statement that the query will be using ELSE BEGIN
-- These functions create the where statements the query will use EXEC @Where = [dbo].[AnalysisReports_WhereStatement] @QueryTemplateID
-- If "Product" tab is eventually added to the Query Form, then the following function needs to be created -- (copy from AnalysisReports_CFCIngredient_WhereStatement) -- and add another record to the QueryField table -- for Product Code.
----12/21/22 EXEC @CFCWhere = [dbo].[AnalysisReports_CFCProductType_WhereStatement] @QueryTemplateID --IF LEN(@CFCWhere) > 0 -- SET @Where += @CFCWhere
EXEC @MatNutWhere = [dbo].[AnalysisReports_MaterialNutrient_WhereStatement] @QueryTemplateID IF LEN(@MatNutWhere) > 0 SET @Where += @MatNutWhere END
----------------------------------------------------------------------------- --- This is used to get the numbers for each grouping -- 1 = NoGroup -- 2 = SampleID -- 3 = SampleDate
IF @IsSubSet = 0 Begin SET @Group = CASE @AnalysisQuery
WHEN 1 THEN '' WHEN 2 THEN ', CPROD.ProductionVersion, S.SampleID, S.SampleDate, AO.OwnerCode, AO.AIMOwnerID, S.AIMOwnerLocationID, AOL.LocationCode, S.SampleCode, S.SampleAIMID ' -- WHEN 3 THEN ', CPROD.ProductionVersion, S.SampleDate ' WHEN 3 THEN ', S.SampleDate ' END End Else Begin SET @Group = CASE @AnalysisQuery
WHEN 1 THEN '' WHEN 2 THEN ', S.SampleID, S.SampleDate, AO.OwnerCode, AO.AIMOwnerID, S.AIMOwnerLocationID, AOL.LocationCode, S.SampleCode, S.SampleAIMID ' WHEN 3 THEN ', S.SampleDate '
END End ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- --This is used to get the final grouping IF @IsSubSet = 0 Begin SET @Total = CASE @AnalysisQuery WHEN 1 THEN '' WHEN 2 THEN ', T.ProductionVersion, T.SampleID, T.SampleDate, T.OwnerCode, T.AIMOwnerID, T.AIMOwnerLocationID, T.LocationCode, T.SampleCode, T.SampleAIMID ' --WHEN 3 THEN ', T.ProductionVersion, T.SampleDate ' WHEN 3 THEN ', T.SampleDate ' END End Else Begin SET @Total = CASE @AnalysisQuery WHEN 1 THEN '' WHEN 2 THEN ', T.SampleID, T.SampleDate, T.OwnerCode, T.AIMOwnerID, T.AIMOwnerLocationID, T.LocationCode, T.SampleCode, T.SampleAIMID ' WHEN 3 THEN ', T.SampleDate '
END End
----------------------------------------------------------------------------- IF @AnalysisQuery IN (2) -- All these AnalysisQueries include the OwnerLocation BEGIN SET @CFCLocation = ', T.CFCPlantID, T.CFCPlantCode, T.CFCPlantName ' SET @CFCLocationGroup = ', CP.CFCPlantID, CP.CFCPlantCode, CP.CFCPlantName ' END
----------------------------------------------------------------------------- --12/1/22 IF @ApplyToleranceGroup = 3 Begin
SELECT x.* INTO #NutrientTolerance FROM (SELECT AIMNutrientID, MinAmount as SpecsMinAmount, MinPercent as SpecsMinPercent, MaxAmount as SpecsMaxAmount, MaxPercent as SpecsMaxPercent, 0 as PredictedMinAmount, 0 as PredictedMinPercent, 0 as PredictedMaxAmount, 0 as PredictedMaxPercent FROM NutrientToleranceHeader NTH INNER JOIN NutrientToleranceDetail NTD ON NTH.NutrientToleranceHeaderID = NTD.NutrientToleranceHeaderID WHERE NTH.NutrientToleranceHeaderID = @NutrientToleranceHeaderID UNION SELECT AIMNutrientID, 0 as SpecsMinAmount, 0 as SpecsMinPercent, 0 as SpecsMaxAmount, 0 as SpecsMaxPercent, MinAmount as PredictedMinAmount, MinPercent as PredictedMinPercent, MaxAmount as PredictedMaxAmount, MaxPercent as PredictedMaxPercent FROM NutrientToleranceHeader NTH INNER JOIN NutrientToleranceDetailTarget NTDT ON NTH.NutrientToleranceHeaderID = NTDT.NutrientToleranceHeaderID WHERE NTH.NutrientToleranceHeaderID = @NutrientToleranceHeaderID ) x End
----------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- This inserts into temp Sample -- 12/19/22 - added CFCProductArchiveID to select below SET @SQL = 'SELECT S.SampleID , S.SampleCode , S.AIMMaterialID , S.AIMOwnerID , S.AIMOwnerLocationID , S.SampleDate , SR.SampleResultID , SA.IsActive , SA.AIMNutrientID , SA.AIMUsedValue , SA.SampleAIMID , AM.AIMMaterialCode , AM.AIMMaterialName , AN.AIMNutrientCode , AN.AIMNutrientName , AN.MathTypeID , S.SampleTypeID , S.CFCProductArchiveID ' if @AnalysisQuery = 2 Begin SET @SQL += ' , case when DST.Name is null then '''' else DST.Name end as DataSourceTypeName ' SET @SQL += ' , S.LotNumber ' --Task1147 DB260420 SET @SQL += ' , ISNULL(ST.SampleTypeName, '''') AS SampleTypeName ' --Task1147 DB260421 SET @SQL += ' , WL.Min AS WLMin ' --Task1147 DB260422 SET @SQL += ' , WL.Max AS WLMax ' --Task1147 DB260422 End
SET @SQL += '
INTO ' + @SampleName + 'FROM dbo.Sample S WITH(NOLOCK) INNER JOIN dbo.SampleResult SR ON SR.SampleID = S.SampleID AND SR.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN dbo.SampleAIM SA ON SA.SampleID = S.SampleID AND SA.SampleResultID = SR.SampleResultID AND SA.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN dbo.AIMMaterial AM ON AM.AIMMaterialID = S.AIMMaterialID AND AM.IsActive = 1 AND AM.MaterialTypeID = 2 INNER JOIN dbo.AIMNutrient AN ON AN.AIMNutrientID = SA.AIMNutrientID AND AN.IsActive = 1 '
if LEN(@CFCWhere) > 0 Begin SET @SQL += ' LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.CFCProductArchive CPA on S.CFCProductArchiveID = CPA.CFCProductArchiveID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.CFCProduct CP on CPA.CFCProductID = CP.CFCProductID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.CFCProductRefCFCProductType CPTX on CP.CFCProductID = CPTX.CFCProductID ' End
----------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- AnalyzerNutrient and DataSourceType joins added because Smithfield wants the option to see the datasource on the Analysis grid. -- BUT ... the datasource can show up only when the Analysis grid is set to GROUP BY SAMPLEID (@AnalysisQuery = 2) if @AnalysisQuery = 2 Begin SET @SQL += ' LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AnalyzerNutrient ANut ON SR.AnalyzerNutrientID = ANut.AnalyzerNutrientID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.DataSourceType DST ON ANut.DataSourceTypeID = DST.DataSourceTypeID ' SET @SQL += ' LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.SampleType ST ON ST.SampleTypeID = S.SampleTypeID ' --Task1147 DB260421 SET @SQL += ' LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMNutrientRefAnalyzerNutrient ANX ON ANut.AnalyzerNutrientID = ANX.AnalyzerNutrientID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.WarningLimits WL ON WL.AIMNutrientID = ANX.AIMNutrientID AND WL.AIMMaterialID = S.AIMMaterialID ' --Task1147 DB260422 End SET @SQL += ' WHERE S.IsActive = 1 ' + @Where
IF @Debug = 'D' BEGIN PRINT @SQL END ELSE BEGIN EXEC(@SQL) END
----------------------------------------------------------------------------- --This gets the numbers for the math. Any changes have to be made to the ##Proposed table --When doing the Quartile and the sample size is less than four, Quartile1 = min and Quartile3 = max of the sample set --This is so the outlier will not kick those values out if there are fewer than 4 samples.
--9/8/17 -- added "AND S.AIMNutrientID = SAM.AIMNutrientID" to join of SampleAIM table below. -- Perdue data somehow calulates exponential standard dev of 3.76972873230979E-08 -- on SampleID 53511, AIMMaterialID 947, AIMNutrientID 102, SampleResultID 271862, AIMUsedValue = 3.15
--untrimmed SampleSize is in the next select statement below. SET @SQL = 'SELECT ST.AIMMaterialID' + @ST + @Location + ' , ST.AIMNutrientID , Q.SampleSize , ISNULL(Q.Quartile1, 0) AS Quartile1 , ISNULL(Q.Quartile3, 0) AS Quartile3 , ST.Mean , ST.StandardDeviation , ST.DetailMin , ST.DetailMax , ST.DetailSQRT , ST.WarningGlobalH , ST.WarningMinMaxLimit , ISNULL(ROUND(Q.Quartile1 - 1.5 * (Q.Quartile3 - Q.Quartile1), 4), 0) AS LMin , ISNULL(ROUND(Q.Quartile1 - 3 * (Q.Quartile3 - Q.Quartile1), 4), 0) AS LMax , ISNULL(ROUND(Q.Quartile3 + 1.5 * (Q.Quartile3 - Q.Quartile1), 4), 0) AS UMin , ISNULL(ROUND(Q.Quartile3 + 3 * (Q.Quartile3 - Q.Quartile1), 4), 0) AS UMax , CASE WHEN ISNULL(Q.Quartile1, 0) = ISNULL(Q.Quartile3, 0) THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN ISNULL(Q.Quartile1, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN ISNULL(Q.Quartile3, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END END END AS IsUntrimmedValidOutlier INTO' + @Statis1Name + ' FROM ( SELECT S.AIMMaterialID' + @SStat + @LocationStat + ' , S.AIMNutrientID , ROUND(AVG(S.AIMUsedValue), 4) AS Mean , ROUND(STDEV(S.AIMUsedValue), 4) AS StandardDeviation , MIN(S.AIMUsedValue) AS DetailMin , MAX(S.AIMUsedValue) AS DetailMax , SQRT(COUNT(*)) AS DetailSQRT , SUM(CASE WHEN SAM.AimUsedValue NOT BETWEEN WL.Min and WL.Max THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as WarningMinMaxLimit , SUM(CASE WHEN SRP.GlobalH > SRP.Limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as WarningGlobalH
FROM' + @SampleName + 'S LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.SampleResultPredict SRP WITH(NOLOCK) ON SRP.SampleResultID = S.SampleResultID LEFT JOIN dbo.SampleAIM SAM WITH(NOLOCK) ON S.SampleID = SAM.SampleID AND S.AIMNutrientID = SAM.AIMNutrientID LEFT JOIN dbo.WarningLimits WL WITH(NOLOCK) ON S.AIMMaterialID = WL.AIMMaterialID AND S.AIMNutrientID = WL.AIMNutrientID GROUP BY S.AIMMaterialID' + @SStat + @LocationStat + ', S.AIMNutrientID ) ST INNER JOIN ( SELECT S.AIMMaterialID' + @SStat + @LocationStat + ' , S.AIMNutrientID , S.SampleSize , CASE WHEN SampleSize < 4 THEN MinValue ELSE Quartile1 END Quartile1 , CASE WHEN SampleSize < 4 THEN MaxValue ELSE Quartile3 END Quartile3 FROM ( SELECT S.AIMMaterialID' + @SStat + @LocationStat + ' , S.AIMNutrientID , COUNT(*) AS SampleSize , MAX(AIMUsedValue) AS MaxValue , MIN(AIMUsedValue) AS MinValue , ROUND((Max(Q1NextVal) - MAX(Q1Val)) * Max(Q1Frac) + Max(Q1Val), 4) AS Quartile1 , ROUND((Max(Q3NextVal) - MAX(Q3Val)) * Max(Q3Frac) + Max(Q3Val), 4) AS Quartile3 FROM ( SELECT D.AIMMaterialID' + @DStat + @LocationStat + ' , D.AIMNutrientID , CASE WHEN RowNum = Q1Idx THEN AIMUsedValue ELSE NULL END AS Q1Val , CASE WHEN RowNum = Q1Idx + 1 THEN AIMUsedValue ELSE NULL END AS Q1NextVal , CASE WHEN RowNum = Q3Idx THEN AIMUsedValue ELSE NULL END AS Q3Val , CASE WHEN RowNum = Q3Idx + 1 THEN AIMUsedValue ELSE NULL END AS Q3NextVal , Q1Frac , Q3Frac , AIMUsedValue FROM ( SELECT S.AIMUsedValue , S.AIMMaterialID' + @SStat + @LocationStat + ' , S.AIMNutrientID , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY S.AIMMaterialID' + ', S.AIMNutrientID ORDER BY S.AIMUsedValue) AS RowNum FROM' + @SampleName + 'S ) D LEFT OUTER JOIN (/*the values at the quartile points.*/ SELECT S.AIMMaterialID' + @SStat + @LocationStat + ' , S.AIMNutrientID , FLOOR((COUNT(*) + 3) / 4.0) AS Q1Idx , ((COUNT(*) + 3) / 4.0) - FLOOR((COUNT(*) + 3) / 4.0) AS Q1Frac , FLOOR((COUNT(*) * 3 + 1) / 4.0) AS Q3Idx , ((COUNT(*) * 3 + 1) / 4.0) - FLOOR((COUNT(*) * 3 + 1) / 4.0) AS Q3Frac FROM' + @SampleName + 'S GROUP BY S.AIMMaterialID' + @SStat + @LocationStat + ', S.AIMNutrientID HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) S ON D.AIMMaterialID = S.AIMMaterialID ' + @ONStat + 'AND D.AIMNutrientID = S.AIMNutrientID ) S GROUP BY S.AIMMaterialID ' + @SStat + @LocationStat + ', S.AIMNutrientID ) S ) Q ON Q.AIMMaterialID = ST.AIMMaterialID ' + @QONStat + 'AND Q.AIMNutrientID = ST.AIMNutrientID ORDER BY ST.AIMMaterialID , ST.AIMNutrientID'
IF @Debug = 'D' BEGIN PRINT @SQL END ELSE BEGIN EXEC(@SQL) END
----------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- 12/19/22 - added CFCProductArchiveID to select below SET @SQL = 'SELECT S.SampleID , S.SampleCode , S.AIMMaterialID , S.AIMOwnerID , S.AIMOwnerLocationID , S.SampleDate , S.IsActive , S.AIMNutrientID , S.AIMUsedValue , S.SampleAIMID , S.AIMMaterialCode , S.AIMMaterialName , S.AIMNutrientCode , S.AIMNutrientName , S.MathTypeID , S.CFCProductArchiveID '
if @AnalysisQuery = 2 Begin SET @SQL += ', S.DataSourceTypeName ' SET @SQL += ', S.LotNumber ' --Task1147 DB260420 SET @SQL += ', S.SampleTypeID ' --Task1147 DB260421 SET @SQL += ', S.SampleTypeName ' --Task1147 DB260421 SET @SQL += ', S.WLMin ' --Task1147 DB260422 SET @SQL += ', S.WLMax ' --Task1147 DB260422 End
SET @SQL += ' , CASE When S.AimUsedValue < 0 Then Case When ST.LMin < S.AIMUsedValue Then 1 Else 0 End else Case When St.LMin > S.AimUsedValue Then 1 else 0 end END as LMin , CASE When S.AimUsedValue < 0 Then Case When St.LMax < S.AimUsedValue Then 1 Else 0 End else Case When St.LMax > S.AimUsedValue Then 1 else 0 end END as LMax , CASE When S.AimUsedValue < 0 Then Case When S.AIMUsedValue < ST.UMin Then 1 Else 0 End else Case When S.AIMUsedValue > ST.UMin Then 1 else 0 end END as UMin , CASE When S.AimUsedValue < 0 Then Case When S.AIMUsedValue < ST.UMax Then 1 Else 0 End else Case When S.AIMUsedValue > ST.UMax Then 1 else 0 end END as UMax
INTO' + @Statis2Name + ' FROM' + @SampleName + 'S LEFT OUTER JOIN ' + @Statis1Name + 'ST ON ST.AIMMaterialID = S.AIMMaterialID ' + @SON + 'AND ST.AIMNutrientID = S.AIMNutrientID'
IF @Debug = 'D' BEGIN PRINT @SQL END ELSE BEGIN EXEC(@SQL) END ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- DELETE dbo.SampleAIMRefCFCUser WHERE CFCUserID = @CFCUserID AND IsUserFlag = 0
----------------------------------------------------------------------------- IF ISNULL(@OutlierType, 1) > 1 BEGIN IF @OutlierType = 2 --Mild Outlier Excluded BEGIN SET @Outlier = 'S1.LMin > S2.AIMUsedValue OR S2.AIMUsedValue > S1.UMin' END ELSE --Extreme Outlier Excluded BEGIN SET @Outlier = 'S1.LMax > S2.AIMUsedValue OR S2.AIMUsedValue > S1.UMax' END SET @SQL = 'INSERT INTO dbo.SampleAIMRefCFCUser( SampleAIMID , CFCUserID , IsUserFlag , UpdateStamp) SELECT S2.SampleAIMID , ' + CAST(@CFCUserID AS VARCHAR) + ' , 0 , GETDATE() FROM ' + @Statis2Name + 'S2 INNER JOIN ' + @Statis1Name + 'S1 ON S1.AIMMaterialID = S2.AIMMaterialID AND S1.AIMNutrientID = S2.AIMNutrientID WHERE ' + @Outlier EXEC (@SQL) END
----------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- CFCPlant temp table SET @SQL = 'SELECT CPRAOL.CFCPlantID , CPRAOL.AIMOwnerLocationID , CP.CFCPlantCode , CP.CFCPlantName INTO' + @CFCPlantName + ' FROM dbo.CFCPlantRefAIMOwnerLocation CPRAOL INNER JOIN dbo.CFCPlant CP ON CP.CFCPlantID = CPRAOL.CFCPlantID AND CP.AIMDatabaseID = ' + Cast(@AimDataBaseID as varchar) IF @Debug = 'D' BEGIN PRINT @SQL END ELSE BEGIN EXEC(@SQL) END
----------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- CFCProduct temp table -- 12/19/22 - added CFCProductArchiveID to select below SET @SQL = 'SELECT CPRAM.CFCProductID , CPRAM.AIMMaterialID , CPROD.CFCProductCode , CPROD.CFCProductName , CPA.ArchiveVersion , CPA.ProductionVersion , CPA.CFCProductArchiveID
INTO' + @CFCProductName + ' FROM dbo.CFCProductRefAIMMaterial CPRAM INNER JOIN dbo.CFCProduct CPROD ON CPROD.CFCProductID = CPRAM.CFCProductID AND CPROD.AIMDatabaseID = ' + Cast(@AimDataBaseID as varchar) + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.CFCProductArchive CPA ON CPROD.CFCProductID = CPA.CFCProductID '
IF @Debug = 'D' BEGIN PRINT @SQL END ELSE BEGIN EXEC(@SQL) END ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- CFCNutrient temp table SET @SQL = 'SELECT CNRAN.CFCNutrientID , CNRAN.AIMNutrientID , CN.CFCNutrientCode , CN.CFCNutrientName , CN.Unit INTO' + @CFCNutrientName + ' FROM dbo.CFCNutrientRefAIMNutrient CNRAN INNER JOIN dbo.CFCNutrient CN ON CN.CFCNutrientID = CNRAN.CFCNutrientID AND CN.AIMDatabaseID = ' + Cast(@AimDataBaseID as varchar)
IF @Debug = 'D' BEGIN PRINT @SQL END ELSE BEGIN EXEC(@SQL) END ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Sample Row Number SET @SQL = 'SELECT S.AIMUsedValue , S.AIMMaterialID' + @S + @Location + ' , S.AIMNutrientID , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY S.AIMMaterialID' + ', S.AIMNutrientID ORDER BY S.AIMUsedValue) AS RowNum INTO' + @SampleRowNumberName + ' FROM' + @SampleName + 'S INNER JOIN dbo.SampleAIM SA ON S.SampleID = SA.SampleID LEFT JOIN dbo.SampleAIMRefCFCUser SARCU WITH(NOLOCK) ON SARCU.SampleAIMID = S.SampleAIMID AND SARCU.CFCUserID = ' + CAST(@CFCUserID AS VARCHAR) + ' WHERE SARCU.SampleAIMRefCFCUserID IS NULL ' + @Where
IF @Debug = 'D' BEGIN PRINT @SQL END ELSE BEGIN EXEC(@SQL) END
----------------------------------------------------------------------------- --This gets the numbers for the PROPOSED math Any changes have to be made to the ##Statis1 table
--9/8/17 -- added "AND S.AIMNutrientID = SA.AIMNutrientID" to join of SampleAIM table below. -- Perdue data somehow calulates exponential standard dev of 3.76972873230979E-08 -- on SampleID 53511, AIMMaterialID 947, AIMNutrientID 102, SampleResultID 271862, AIMUsedValue = 3.15
--10/2/20 -- added TSS join and TSS.TotalSampleSize to select stmt (per Nickki)
SET @SQL = 'SELECT ST.AIMMaterialID' + @ST + @Location + ', ST.AIMNutrientID , ST.TrimmedSampleSize , TSS.TotalSampleSize , ISNULL(Q.TrimmedQuartile1, 0) AS TrimmedQuartile1 , ISNULL(Q.TrimmedQuartile3, 0) AS TrimmedQuartile3 , ST.TrimmedMean , ST.TrimmedStandardDeviation , ST.TrimmedDetailMin , ST.TrimmedDetailMax , ST.TrimmedDetailSQRT , ISNULL(ROUND(Q.TrimmedQuartile1 - 1.5 * (Q.TrimmedQuartile3 - Q.TrimmedQuartile1), 4), 0) AS TrimmedLMin , ISNULL(ROUND(Q.TrimmedQuartile1 - 3 * (Q.TrimmedQuartile3 - Q.TrimmedQuartile1), 4), 0) AS TrimmedLMax , ISNULL(ROUND(Q.TrimmedQuartile3 + 1.5 * (Q.TrimmedQuartile3 - Q.TrimmedQuartile1), 4), 0) AS TrimmedUMin , ISNULL(ROUND(Q.TrimmedQuartile3 + 3 * (Q.TrimmedQuartile3 - Q.TrimmedQuartile1), 4), 0) AS TrimmedUMax , CASE WHEN ISNULL(Q.TrimmedQuartile1, 0) = ISNULL(Q.TrimmedQuartile3, 0) THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN ISNULL(Q.TrimmedQuartile1, 0) + ISNULL(Q.TrimmedQuartile3, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN ISNULL(Q.TrimmedQuartile1, 0) + ISNULL(Q.TrimmedQuartile3, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END END END AS IsTrimmedValidOutlier INTO' + @ProposedName + ' FROM ( SELECT S.AIMMaterialID' + @S + @Location + ', S.AIMNutrientID , ROUND(AVG(S.AIMUsedValue), 4) AS TrimmedMean , ROUND(STDEV(S.AIMUsedValue), 4) AS TrimmedStandardDeviation , MIN(S.AIMUsedValue) AS TrimmedDetailMin , MAX(S.AIMUsedValue) AS TrimmedDetailMax , SQRT(COUNT(*)) AS TrimmedDetailSQRT , COUNT(*) AS TrimmedSampleSize FROM' + @SampleName + 'S LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.SampleResultPredict SRP WITH(NOLOCK) ON SRP.SampleResultID = S.SampleResultID INNER JOIN dbo.SampleAIM SA WITH(NOLOCK) ON S.SampleID = SA.SampleID AND S.AIMNutrientID = SA.AIMNutrientID LEFT JOIN dbo.SampleAIMRefCFCUser SARCU WITH(NOLOCK) ON SARCU.SampleAIMID = S.SampleAIMID AND SARCU.CFCUserID = ' + CAST(@CFCUserID AS VARCHAR) + ' WHERE S.IsActive = 1 AND SARCU.SampleAIMRefCFCUserID IS NULL ' + @Where + 'GROUP BY S.AIMMaterialID' + @S + @Location + ', S.AIMNutrientID ) ST INNER JOIN (SELECT S.AIMMaterialID, S.AIMNutrientID, COUNT(*) AS TotalSampleSize FROM' + @SampleName + 'S INNER JOIN dbo.SampleAIM SA ON S.SampleID = SA.SampleID AND S.AIMNutrientID = SA.AIMNutrientID WHERE S.IsActive = 1 ' + @Where + ' GROUP BY S.AIMMaterialID, S.AIMNutrientID ) TSS ON TSS.AIMMaterialID = ST.AIMMaterialID AND TSS.AIMNutrientID = ST.AIMNutrientID INNER JOIN ( SELECT S.AIMMaterialID' + @S + @Location + ', S.AIMNutrientID , ROUND((Max(Q1NextVal) - MAX(Q1Val)) * Max(Q1Frac) + Max(Q1Val), 4) AS TrimmedQuartile1 , ROUND((Max(Q3NextVal) - MAX(Q3Val)) * Max(Q3Frac) + Max(Q3Val), 4) AS TrimmedQuartile3 FROM ( SELECT D.AIMMaterialID' + @D + @Location + ', D.AIMNutrientID , CASE WHEN RowNum = Q1Idx THEN AIMUsedValue ELSE NULL END AS Q1Val , CASE WHEN RowNum = Q1Idx + 1 THEN AIMUsedValue ELSE NULL END AS Q1NextVal , CASE WHEN RowNum = Q3Idx THEN AIMUsedValue ELSE NULL END AS Q3Val , CASE WHEN RowNum = Q3Idx + 1 THEN AIMUsedValue ELSE NULL END AS Q3NextVal , Q1Frac , Q3Frac , AIMUsedValue FROM ' + @SampleRowNumberName + 'D LEFT OUTER JOIN (/*the values at the quartile points.*/ SELECT S.AIMMaterialID' + @S + @Location + ', S.AIMNutrientID , FLOOR((COUNT(*) + 3) / 4.0) AS Q1Idx , ((COUNT(*) + 3) / 4.0) - FLOOR((COUNT(*) + 3) / 4.0) AS Q1Frac , FLOOR((COUNT(*) * 3 + 1) / 4.0) AS Q3Idx , ((COUNT(*) * 3 + 1) / 4.0) - FLOOR((COUNT(*) * 3 + 1) / 4.0) AS Q3Frac FROM' + @SampleName + 'S INNER JOIN dbo.SampleAIM SA ON S.SampleID = SA.SampleID
LEFT JOIN dbo.SampleAIMRefCFCUser SARCU WITH(NOLOCK) ON SARCU.SampleAIMID = S.SampleAIMID AND SARCU.CFCUserID = ' + CAST(@CFCUserID AS VARCHAR) + ' WHERE SARCU.SampleAIMRefCFCUserID IS NULL ' + @Where + 'GROUP BY S.AIMMaterialID' + @S + @Location + ', S.AIMNutrientID HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) AS S ON D.AIMMaterialID = S.AIMMaterialID ' + @ON + 'AND D.AIMNutrientID = S.AIMNutrientID ) AS S GROUP BY S.AIMMaterialID ' + @S + @Location + ', S.AIMNutrientID ) Q ON Q.AIMMaterialID = ST.AIMMaterialID ' + @QON + 'AND Q.AIMNutrientID = ST.AIMNutrientID ORDER BY ST.AIMMaterialID , ST.AIMNutrientID'
IF @Debug = 'D' BEGIN PRINT @SQL END ELSE BEGIN EXEC(@SQL) END
----------------------------------------------------------------------------- --This gets the final query - and will have different columns based on the grouping SET @SQL = 'SELECT CASE WHEN T.IncludedSample = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS IsInclude , ISNULL(SR.SampleSize, 1) AS SampleSize , ISNULL(P.TrimmedSampleSize,1) AS TrimmedSampleSize , ISNULL(P.TotalSampleSize,1) AS TotalSampleSize , T.CFCProductName , T.SampleValue , T.CFCProductCode , T.Unit , T.AIMMaterialID , T.AIMMaterialCode , T.AIMMaterialName , T.AIMNutrientID , T.AIMNutrientCode , T.AIMNutrientName , T.MathTypeID '
if @AnalysisQuery = 2 Begin SET @SQL += ', T.DataSourceTypeName ' SET @SQL += ', T.LotNumber ' --Task1147 DB260420 SET @SQL += ', T.SampleTypeID ' --Task1147 DB260421 SET @SQL += ', T.SampleTypeName ' --Task1147 DB260421 SET @SQL += ', T.WLMin ' --Task1147 DB260422 SET @SQL += ', T.WLMax ' --Task1147 DB260422 SET @SQL += ', ISNULL(CASE WHEN T.SampleValue < T.WLMin THEN 1 ELSE CASE WHEN T.SampleValue > T.WLMax THEN 2 ELSE 0 END END, 0) AS ResultValueFlag ' --Task1147 DB260422 End
SET @SQL += ' , T.CFCNutrientCode , T.CFCNutrientName , T.NumberOfSample , T.CFCProductID , T.CFCNutrientID , SR.IsUntrimmedValidOutlier , ISNULL(SR.Quartile1, T.SampleValue) AS Quartile1 , ISNULL(SR.Quartile3, T.SampleValue) AS Quartile3 , ISNULL(SR.Mean, T.SampleValue) AS UntrimmedMean , ISNULL(SR.StandardDeviation, 0) AS UntrimmedStandardDeviation , ISNULL(SR.DetailMin, T.SampleValue) AS UntrimmedDetailMin , ISNULL(SR.DetailMax, T.SampleValue) AS UntrimmedDetailMax , ISNULL(SR.DetailSQRT, T.SampleValue) AS UntrimmedDetailSQRT , ISNULL(SR.WarningGlobalH, 0) AS WarningGlobalH , ISNULL(SR.WarningMinMaxLimit, 0) AS WarningMinMaxLimit , ISNULL(T.LMin,0) AS LMin , ISNULL(T.LMax,0) AS LMax , ISNULL(T.UMin,0) AS UMin , ISNULL(T.UMax,0) AS UMax , P.IsTrimmedValidOutlier , ISNULL(P.TrimmedQuartile1, T.SampleValue) AS TrimmedFirstQuartile , ISNULL(P.TrimmedQuartile3, T.SampleValue) AS TrimmedThirdQuartile , ISNULL(P.TrimmedMean, T.SampleValue) AS TrimmedMean , ISNULL(P.TrimmedStandardDeviation, 0) AS TrimmedStandardDeviation , ISNULL(P.TrimmedDetailMin, T.SampleValue) AS TrimmedDetailMin , ISNULL(P.TrimmedDetailMax, T.SampleValue) AS TrimmedDetailMax , ISNULL(P.TrimmedDetailSQRT, T.SampleValue) AS TrimmedDetailSQRT , ISNULL(CPAS.NutrientMin,0) as SpecNutrientMin , ISNULL(CPAS.NutrientMax,0) as SpecNutrientMax , ISNULL(CPAN.NutrientValue, 0) AS PredictedValue , T.CFCProductArchiveID '
Begin SET @SQL += ', T.ArchiveVersion ' End
SET @SQL += ', ' + cast(@ApplyToleranceGroup as varchar) + ' as ApplyToleranceGroup '
if @ApplyToleranceGroup = 3 Begin SET @SQL += ', SpecsMinAmount, SpecsMinPercent, SpecsMaxAmount, SpecsMaxPercent, PredictedMinAmount, PredictedMinPercent, PredictedMaxAmount, PredictedMaxPercent ' End
SET @SQL+= ', ' + @StrNutrValue + @Total + @CFCLocation + ' FROM (SELECT S.CFCProductArchiveID, S.IsActive, S.AIMMaterialID '
if @ApplyToleranceGroup = 1 OR @ApplyToleranceGroup = 3 Begin SET @SQL += ', S.AIMMaterialCode , S.AIMMaterialName ' End else if @ApplyToleranceGroup = 2 Begin SET @SQL += ', Case when GH.AIMMaterialGroupHeaderName is not null then GH.AIMMaterialCode Else S.AIMMaterialCode end as AIMMaterialCode , Case when GH.AIMMaterialGroupHeaderName is not null then GH.AIMMaterialGroupHeaderName Else S.AIMMaterialName end as AIMMaterialName ' End
SET @SQL += ' , S.AIMNutrientID , S.AIMNutrientCode , S.AIMNutrientName , S.MathTypeID '
if @AnalysisQuery = 2 Begin SET @SQL += ', S.DataSourceTypeName ' SET @SQL += ', S.LotNumber ' --Task1147 DB260420 SET @SQL += ', S.SampleTypeID ' --Task1147 DB260421 SET @SQL += ', S.SampleTypeName ' --Task1147 DB260421 SET @SQL += ', S.WLMin ' --Task1147 DB260422 SET @SQL += ', S.WLMax ' --Task1147 DB260422 end
SET @SQL += ' , CPROD.CFCProductID , CPROD.CFCProductCode , CPROD.CFCProductName '
Begin SET @SQL += ', CPROD.ArchiveVersion ' End
SET @SQL += ' , CN.Unit , CN.CFCNutrientID , CN.CFCNutrientCode , CN.CFCNutrientName, AVG(S.AIMUsedValue) AS SampleValue , SUM(S.LMin) AS LMin, SUM(S.LMax) AS LMax, SUM(S.UMin) AS UMin, SUM(S.UMax) AS UMax , SUM(CASE WHEN SARCU.SampleAIMID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS IncludedSample , COUNT(*) AS NumberOfSample ' + @Group + @CFCLocationGroup + ' FROM ' + @Statis2Name + 'S LEFT JOIN dbo.SampleAIMRefCFCUser SARCU WITH(NOLOCK) ON SARCU.SampleAIMID = S.SampleAIMID AND SARCU.CFCUserID = ' + CAST(@CFCUserID AS VARCHAR) + ' LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMOwner AO ON AO.AIMOwnerID = S.AIMOwnerID AND AO.IsActive = 1 LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMOwnerLocation AOL ON AOL.AIMOwnerLocationID = S.AIMOwnerLocationID AND AOL.IsActive = 1 AND AOL.IsFormulationPlant = 1 LEFT OUTER JOIN ' + @CFCNutrientName + 'CN ON CN.AIMNutrientID = S.AIMNutrientID LEFT OUTER JOIN ' + @CFCPlantName + 'CP ON CP.AIMOwnerLocationID = S.AIMOwnerLocationID LEFT OUTER JOIN ' + @CFCProductName + 'CPROD ON CPROD.AIMMaterialID = S.AIMMaterialID AND CPROD.CFCProductArchiveID = S.CFCProductArchiveID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.CFCProductRefCFCProductType CPTX ON CPROD.CFCProductID = CPTX.CFCProductID ' if @ApplyToleranceGroup = 2 Begin SET @SQL += ' LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMMaterialGroupDetail GD on S.AimMaterialID = GD.AIMMaterialID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMMaterialGroupHeader GH on GD.AIMMaterialGroupHeaderID = GH.AIMMaterialGroupHeaderID ' End
SET @SQL += ' WHERE S.IsActive = 1 AND AOL.IsFormulationPlant = 1 ' + @CFCWhere ----SET @SQL += ' WHERE S.IsActive = 1 AND AOL.IsFormulationPlant = 1 and S.SampleID in (84, 334, 366, 593, 1955) ' + @CFCWhere
if @ApplyToleranceGroup = 2 Begin SET @SQL += ' and GH.AIMMaterialGroupHeaderID IS NOT NULL ' End
SET @SQL += ' GROUP BY S.CFCProductArchiveID, S.IsActive, CPROD.CFCProductID, CPROD.CFCProductCode, CPROD.CFCProductName'
Begin SET @SQL += ', CPROD.ArchiveVersion, CPROD.ProductionVersion ' End
SET @SQL += ' , S.AIMMaterialID '
if @ApplyToleranceGroup = 1 OR @ApplyToleranceGroup = 3 Begin SET @SQL += ' , S.AIMMaterialCode , S.AIMMaterialName ' End else if @ApplyToleranceGroup = 2 Begin SET @SQL += ' , Case when GH.AIMMaterialGroupHeaderName is not null then GH.AIMMaterialCode Else S.AIMMaterialCode end , Case when GH.AIMMaterialGroupHeaderName is not null then GH.AIMMaterialGroupHeaderName Else S.AIMMaterialName end ' End
SET @SQL += ', S.AIMNutrientID , S.AIMNutrientCode , S.AIMNutrientName , S.MathTypeID '
if @AnalysisQuery = 2 Begin SET @SQL += ', S.DataSourceTypeName ' SET @SQL += ', S.LotNumber ' --Task1147 DB260420 SET @SQL += ', S.SampleTypeID ' --Task1147 DB260421 SET @SQL += ', S.SampleTypeName ' --Task1147 DB260421 SET @SQL += ', S.WLMin ' --Task1147 DB260422 SET @SQL += ', S.WLMax ' --Task1147 DB260422 End
SET @SQL += ', CN.Unit , CN.CFCNutrientID , CN.CFCNutrientCode , CN.CFCNutrientName ' + @Group + @CFCLocationGroup + ' ) T
LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.CFCProductArchiveNutrient CPAN ON CPAN.CFCProductArchiveID = T.CFCProductArchiveID AND CPAN.CFCNutrientID = T.CFCNutrientID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.CFCProductArchiveSpec CPAS ON CPAS.CFCProductArchiveID = T.CFCProductArchiveID AND CPAS.CFCNutrientID = T.CFCNutrientID LEFT OUTER JOIN ' + @Statis1Name + 'SR ON SR.AIMMaterialID = T.AIMMaterialID ' + @SRON + ' AND SR.AIMNutrientID = T.AIMNutrientID LEFT OUTER JOIN ' + @ProposedName + 'P ON P.AIMMaterialID = T.AIMMaterialID ' + @PON + ' AND P.AIMNutrientID = T.AIMNutrientID '
--12/2/22 if @ApplyToleranceGroup = 3 Begin SET @SQL += ' INNER JOIN #NutrientTolerance NutSpec ON NutSpec.AIMNutrientID = T.AIMNutrientID ' End SET @SQL += @StrJoinNutrValue + @TWhere + ' ORDER BY T.AIMMaterialID, T.AIMNutrientID ' + @Total
IF @Debug = 'D' BEGIN PRINT @SQL END ELSE BEGIN EXEC(@SQL) END
IF @Debug = 'T' BEGIN PRINT 'Did not drop temp tables' END ELSE BEGIN IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM tempdb.sys.tables WHERE [name] = TRIM(@SampleName)) BEGIN SET @SQL = 'DROP TABLE' + @SampleName EXEC(@SQL) END
IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM tempdb.sys.tables WHERE [name] = TRIM(@ProposedName)) BEGIN SET @SQL = 'DROP TABLE' + @ProposedName EXEC(@SQL) END
IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM tempdb.sys.tables WHERE [name] = TRIM(@Statis1Name)) BEGIN SET @SQL = 'DROP TABLE' + @Statis1Name EXEC(@SQL) END
IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM tempdb.sys.tables WHERE [name] = TRIM(@Statis2Name)) BEGIN SET @SQL = 'DROP TABLE' + @Statis2Name EXEC(@SQL) END
IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM tempdb.sys.tables WHERE [name] = TRIM(@SampleRowNumberName)) BEGIN SET @SQL = 'DROP TABLE' + @SampleRowNumberName EXEC(@SQL) END
IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM tempdb.sys.tables WHERE [name] = TRIM(@CFCPlantName)) BEGIN SET @SQL = 'DROP TABLE' + @CFCPlantName EXEC(@SQL) END
IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM tempdb.sys.tables WHERE [name] = TRIM(@CFCProductName)) BEGIN SET @SQL = 'DROP TABLE' + @CFCProductName EXEC(@SQL) END
IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM tempdb.sys.tables WHERE [name] = TRIM(@CFCNutrientName)) BEGIN SET @SQL = 'DROP TABLE' + @CFCNutrientName EXEC(@SQL) END
--12/9/22 IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM tempdb.sys.tables WHERE [name] = '#NutrientTolerance') DROP TABLE #NutrientTolerance END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_Sample_SEL_AnalysisProduct] @Debug VARCHAR(1) = NULL , @AnalysisQuery INT , @StartDate DATE = NULL , @EndDate DATE = NULL , @QueryTemplateID INT = NULL
--12/1/22 , @ApplyToleranceGroup INT = NULL
--12/9/22 , @NutrientToleranceHeaderID INT = NULL
, @IsSubSet BIT = NULL , @AimDataBaseID INT = NULL , @AIMMaterialID INT = NULL , @AIMNutrientID INT = NULL , @SampleDate DATE = NULL , @SampleID INT = NULL , @AIMOwnerID INT = NULL , @AIMOwnerLocationID INT = NULL , @CFCUserID INT = NULL , @OutlierType INT = NULL , @CFCProductID INT = NULL -- this isn't used ? , @ArchiveVersion VARCHAR(10) = NULL --1/4/23
AS

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value:
BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
DECLARE @SQL VARCHAR(6000) = '' DECLARE @Total VARCHAR(1000) = '' DECLARE @Where VARCHAR(1000) = '' DECLARE @WhereValue VARCHAR(1000) = ''
--Variables added for ##Field temp table DECLARE @ID INT = 0 DECLARE @ParenOpen VARCHAR(10) DECLARE @ParenClose VARCHAR(10) DECLARE @CFCWhere VARCHAR(1000) = '' Declare @PrevID INT = 0 DECLARE @PrevCFCID INT = 0 DECLARE @WhereNutrient VARCHAR(1000) = '' DECLARE @MatNutWhere VARCHAR(1000) = ''
IF @SampleOwnerID = 0 BEGIN SET @SampleOwnerID = NULL END
IF @AIMOwnerLocationID = 0 BEGIN SET @AIMOwnerLocationID = NULL END
IF @AIMSourceID = 0 BEGIN SET @AIMSourceID = NULL END
IF @AIMSourceLocationID = 0 BEGIN SET @AIMSourceLocationID = NULL END
IF @AIMMaterialID = 0 BEGIN SET @AIMMaterialID = NULL END
IF Len(@Ticket) = 0 BEGIN SET @Ticket = NULL END
IF @QueryTemplateID IS NULL BEGIN
SET @Where = 'WHERE AN.IsActive = 1 '
if @SampleOwnerID IS NOT NULL SET @Where += ' and S.AIMOwnerID = ' + Cast(@SampleOwnerID as varchar) + ' ' if @AIMOwnerLocationID IS NOT NULL SET @Where += ' and S.AIMOwnerLocationID = ' + Cast(@AIMOwnerLocationID as varchar) + ' ' if @AIMSourceID IS NOT NULL SET @Where += ' and S.AIMSourceID = ' + Cast(@AIMSourceID as varchar) + ' ' if @AIMSourceLocationID IS NOT NULL SET @Where += ' and S.AIMSourceLocationID = ' + Cast(@AIMSourceLocationID as varchar) + ' ' if @AIMMaterialID IS NOT NULL SET @Where += ' and S.AIMMaterialID = ' + Cast(@AIMMaterialID as varchar) + ' ' if @Ticket IS NOT NULL SET @Where += ' and S.TicketNumber = ' + Cast(@Ticket as varchar) + ' ' if @FromDate IS NOT NULL SET @Where += ' and SR.AnalysisDate >= ''' + Convert(varchar,Cast(@FromDate as datetime), 120) + ''' ' if @ToDate IS NOT NULL SET @Where += ' and SR.AnalysisDate <= ''' + Convert(varchar,Cast(@ToDate as datetime), 120) + ''' '
END ELSE BEGIN
SET @Where = ' WHERE S.IsActive = 1 '
------------------------------------------------------------------------------ DECLARE WhereCur scroll cursor for SELECT QTD.QueryFieldID, '' as ParenOpen, '' as ParenClose, QF.FieldName + ' ' + CASE WHEN QTD.Value > 0 THEN REPLACE(QO.Command, '@VALUE', QTD.Value) ELSE CASE WHEN QTD.DateValue IS NULL THEN QO.Command ELSE CASE WHEN QTD.SecondDate IS NULL THEN REPLACE(QO.Command, '@VALUE', '''' + CAST(QTD.DateValue AS VARCHAR) + '''') ELSE REPLACE(REPLACE(QO.Command, '@DateValue', '''' + CAST(QTD.DateValue AS VARCHAR) + '''') , '@SecondDate', '''' + CAST(QTD.SecondDate AS VARCHAR) + '''') END END END AS WhereValue FROM dbo.QueryTemplateDetail QTD INNER JOIN dbo.QueryField QF ON QF.QueryFieldID = QTD.QueryFieldID INNER JOIN dbo.QueryOperation QO ON QO.QueryOperationID = QTD.QueryOperationID WHERE QTD.QueryTemplateID = @QueryTemplateID AND QF.QueryFieldID <> 9 -- Omit Field = 9 here (Material/Nutrient) - handle below ORDER BY QTD.QueryFieldID
OPEN WhereCur FETCH NEXT FROM WhereCur INTO @ID, @ParenOpen, @ParenClose, @WhereValue WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN -- ALL OTHER FIELDS (EXCEPT 9) ----------------------------------- IF @ID not in (0,7) Begin if @PrevID <> @ID and @PrevID <> 0 SET @Where += ')'
if @PrevID <> @ID SET @Where += ' AND (' else SET @Where += ' OR '
SET @Where += @WhereValue SET @PrevID = @ID End
-- CFC INGREDIENT ------------------------------------------------ ELSE Begin if @PrevCFCID <> @ID and @PrevCFCID <> 0 SET @CFCWhere += ')'
if @PrevCFCID <> @ID SET @CFCWhere += ' AND (' else SET @CFCWhere += ' OR '
SET @CFCWhere += @WhereValue SET @PrevCFCID = @ID End FETCH NEXT FROM WhereCur INTO @ID, @ParenOpen, @ParenClose, @WhereValue END if LEN(@Where) > 0 SET @Where += ')' if LEN(@CFCWhere) > 0 SET @CFCWhere += ')' CLOSE WhereCur DEALLOCATE WhereCur
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- SET @ID = 0 SET @PrevID = 0 DECLARE MatNutCursor scroll cursor for SELECT QTD.Value, '' as ParenOpen, '' as ParenClose, QF.FieldName + ' ' + CASE WHEN QTD.Value > 0 THEN REPLACE(QO.Command, '@VALUE', QTD.Value) ELSE QO.Command END AS WhereValue, ' ' + QF.FieldName2 + ' = ' + CAST(QTDN.AIMNutrientID as varchar) + ' ' AS WhereNutrient FROM dbo.QueryTemplateDetail QTD INNER JOIN dbo.QueryField QF ON QF.QueryFieldID = QTD.QueryFieldID INNER JOIN dbo.QueryOperation QO ON QO.QueryOperationID = QTD.QueryOperationID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.QueryTemplateDetailNutrient QTDN on QTD.QueryTemplateDetailID = QTDN.QueryTemplateDetailID WHERE QTD.QueryTemplateID = @QueryTemplateID AND QF.QueryFieldID = 9 ORDER BY QTD.Value OPEN MatNutCursor FETCH NEXT FROM MatNutCursor INTO @ID, @ParenOpen, @ParenClose, @WhereValue, @WhereNutrient WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
if @PrevID <> @ID and @PrevID <> 0 SET @MatNutWhere += ')'
if @PrevID <> @ID Begin Begin if @PrevID = 0 set @MatNutWhere += ' AND (' else set @MatNutWhere += ') OR ' End SET @MatNutWhere += '(' + @WhereValue + ' AND (' + @WhereNutrient End else SET @MatNutWhere += ' OR ' + @WhereNutrient
SET @PrevID = @ID FETCH NEXT FROM MatNutCursor INTO @ID, @ParenOpen, @ParenClose, @WhereValue, @WhereNutrient
END
if LEN(@MatNutWhere) > 0 SET @MatNutWhere += ')) )'
CLOSE MatNutCursor DEALLOCATE MatNutCursor
END
IF LEN(@MatNutWhere) > 0 SET @Where += @MatNutWhere
/*
--- This create the where statement that the query will be using DECLARE WhereCur CURSOR FOR SELECT CASE WHEN QTD.IsAnd = 0 THEN 'OR ' ELSE 'AND ' END + QF.FieldName + ' ' + CASE WHEN QTD.Value > 0 THEN REPLACE(QO.Command, '@VALUE', QTD.Value) ELSE REPLACE(QO.Command, '@VALUE', '''' + CAST(QTD.DateValue AS VARCHAR) + '''') END AS WhereValue FROM dbo.QueryTemplateDetail QTD INNER JOIN dbo.QueryField QF ON QF.QueryFieldID = QTD.QueryFieldID INNER JOIN dbo.QueryOperation QO ON QO.QueryOperationID = QTD.QueryOperationID WHERE QTD.QueryTemplateID = @QueryTemplateID OPEN WhereCur FETCH NEXT FROM WhereCur INTO @WhereValue WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN IF @Where = '' BEGIN SET @Where += 'WHERE ' + SUBSTRING(@WhereValue, 5, LEN(@WhereValue)) END ELSE BEGIN SET @Where += ' ' + @WhereValue END FETCH NEXT FROM WhereCur INTO @WhereValue END CLOSE WhereCur DEALLOCATE WhereCur
END */
SET @SQL = 'SELECT '
If @ToDate is NOT NULL SET @Sql += '''' + convert(varchar,@ToDate) + ''' as ToDate, ' If @FromDate IS NOT NULL SET @Sql += '''' + convert(varchar,@FromDate) + ''' as FromDate, ' SET @SQL += ' AN.AIMNutrientCode , AN.AIMNutrientName , STDEV(SA.AIMUsedValue) AS StandardDeviation , SUM(SA.AIMUsedValue) as ResultValue , AVG(SA.AIMUsedValue) AS Mean , AO.OwnerName , AOL.LocationName , SS.SourceName , SL.SourceLocationName , AN.AIMNutrientCode , AN.AIMNutrientName , CI.CFCIngredientID , CI.CFCIngredientCode , CI.CFCIngredientName , CP.CFCProductID , CP.CFCProductCode , CP.CFCProductName , UT.UnitTypeDescription as Unit , AM.AIMMaterialCode AS MaterialCode , AM.AIMMaterialName AS MaterialName FROM dbo.Sample S WITH(NOLOCK) INNER JOIN dbo.SampleAIM SA WITH(NOLOCK) ON SA.SampleID = S.SampleID AND SA.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN dbo.SampleResult SR WITH(NOLOCK) ON SR.SampleID = S.SampleID AND SR.IsActive = 1 LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMOwner AO WITH(NOLOCK) ON AO.AIMOwnerID = S.AIMOwnerID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMMaterial AM WITH(NOLOCK) ON AM.AIMMaterialID = S.AIMMaterialID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMOwnerLocation AOL WITH(NOLOCK) ON AOL.AIMOwnerLocationID = S.AIMOwnerLocationID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMSource SS WITH(NOLOCK) ON SS.AIMSourceID = S.AIMSourceID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMSourceLocation SL WITH(NOLOCK) ON SL.AIMSourceLocationID = S.AIMSourceLocationID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMNutrient AN WITH(NOLOCK) ON AN.AIMNutrientID = SA.AIMNutrientID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.UnitType UT with (nolock) ON AN.UnitTypeID = UT.UnitTypeID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.CFCIngredientRefAIMMaterial CINIR WITH(NOLOCK) ON CINIR.AIMMaterialID = S.AIMMaterialID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.CFCIngredient CI WITH(NOLOCK) ON CI.CFCIngredientID = CINIR.CFCIngredientID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.CFCProductRefAIMMaterial CPNIP WITH(NOLOCK) ON CPNIP.AIMMaterialID = S.AIMMaterialID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.CFCProduct CP WITH(NOLOCK) ON CP.CFCProductID = CPNIP.CFCProductID '
+ @Where + ' ' +
'GROUP BY AN.AIMNutrientCode , AN.AIMNutrientName , AO.OwnerName , AOL.LocationName , SS.SourceName , SL.SourceLocationName , CI.CFCIngredientID , CI.CFCIngredientCode , CI.CFCIngredientName , CP.CFCProductID , CP.CFCProductCode , CP.CFCProductName , UT.UnitTypeDescription , AM.AIMMaterialCode , AM.AIMMaterialName
'
EXEC (@SQL) --print @sql
END

BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON; DECLARE @RecordID INT = 0 DECLARE @ErrorNumber INT = 0 DECLARE @ErrorMessage VARCHAR(200) = ''
SET @RecordID = (SELECT isnull(max(SampleID) ,1) as LastSample
FROM dbo.Sample S with (nolock)
INNER JOIN dbo.DataSourceType DST with (nolock) ON S.DataSourceTypeID = DST.DataSourceTypeID
WHERE S.DataSourceTypeID = @DataSourceTypeid )

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value:
BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
SET @StartDate = '2014-12-01' SET @EndDate = '2015-01-22' SET @AIMMaterialID = 4 SET @AIMNutrientID = 3
CREATE TABLE #Temp ( IsCalculate BIT NULL , CFCIngredientName NVARCHAR(50) NULL , CurrentNutrientVal NUMERIC(12,4) NULL , SampleValue NUMERIC(12,4) NULL , CFCIngredientCode NVARCHAR(50) NULL , Unit NVARCHAR(50) NULL , AIMMaterialID INT NULL , AIMMaterialCode NVARCHAR(50) NULL , AIMMaterialName NVARCHAR(50) NULL , AIMNutrientID INT NULL , AIMNutrientCode NVARCHAR(50) NULL , AIMNutrientName NVARCHAR(50) NULL , CFCNutrientCode NVARCHAR(50) NULL , CFCNutrientName NVARCHAR(50) NULL , NumberOfSample INT NULL , SampleDate DATETIME NULL , Quartile1 NUMERIC(12,4) NULL , Quartile3 NUMERIC(12,4) NULL , Mean NUMERIC(12,4) NULL , StandardDeviation NUMERIC(12,4) NULL , Min NUMERIC(12,4) NULL , Max NUMERIC(12,4) NULL , Upper95Mean NUMERIC(12,4) NULL , Lower95Mean NUMERIC(12,4) NULL , Upper90Mean NUMERIC(12,4) NULL , Lower90Mean NUMERIC(12,4) NULL , MeanPlusStandardDeviation NUMERIC(12,4) NULL , MeanMinusStandardDeviation NUMERIC(12,4) NULL )
INSERT #Temp EXEC dbo.usp_Sample_SEL_GroupBy_Date @StartDate, @EndDate
SELECT AIMMaterialID , AIMNutrientID , 'Min' AS ValueName , SampleDate , Min AS Value FROM #Temp T WHERE T.IsCalculate = 1 AND AIMMaterialID = @AIMMaterialID AND AIMNutrientID = @AIMNutrientID UNION ALL SELECT AIMMaterialID , AIMNutrientID , 'Max' AS ValueName , SampleDate , Max AS Value FROM #Temp T WHERE T.IsCalculate = 1 AND AIMMaterialID = @AIMMaterialID AND AIMNutrientID = @AIMNutrientID UNION ALL SELECT AIMMaterialID , AIMNutrientID , 'Mean' AS ValueName , SampleDate , Mean AS Value FROM #Temp T WHERE T.IsCalculate = 1 AND AIMMaterialID = @AIMMaterialID AND AIMNutrientID = @AIMNutrientID UNION ALL SELECT AIMMaterialID , AIMNutrientID , AIMNutrientName AS ValueName , SampleDate , SampleValue AS Value FROM #Temp T WHERE T.IsCalculate = 1 AND AIMMaterialID = @AIMMaterialID AND AIMNutrientID = @AIMNutrientID
DROP TABLE #Temp
END

Property.Value: CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_Sample_SEL_Chart] @StartDate DATETIME = NULL , @EndDate DATETIME = NULL , @AIMNutrientID INT = NULL , @AIMMaterialID INT = NULL AS

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value:
BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
-- exec usp_Sample_SEL_Chart_SampleList '2020-01-13', '2020-02-13', 1, 2, 2, 0
DECLARE @SQL VARCHAR(8000) = ''
SET @SQL = 'SELECT
S.Sampleid , S.SampleCode , S.SampleDate , AM.AIMMaterialCode , AM.AIMMaterialName , AN.AIMNutrientCode , AN.AIMNutrientName , sum(SR.ResultValue) AS ResultValue
FROM dbo.Sample S
INNER JOIN dbo.SampleResult SR on S.SampleID = SR.SampleID INNER JOIN dbo.AIMMaterial AM on S.AIMMaterialID = AM.AIMMaterialID INNER JOIN dbo.AIMNutrientRefAnalyzerNutrient x with(nolock) ON SR.AnalyzerNutrientID = x.AnalyzerNutrientID INNER JOIN dbo.AIMNutrient AN with(nolock) ON x.AIMNutrientID = AN.AIMNutrientID '
SET @SQL += 'WHERE S.SampleDate >= ''' + convert(varchar, @StartDate) + '''' + ' and S.SampleDate <= ''' + convert(varchar, @EndDate) + '''' + ' and S.AIMMaterialID = ' + convert(varchar, @AIMMaterialID) + ' and X.AIMNutrientID = ' + convert(varchar, @AIMNutrientID) + ' and SR.IsActive = 1 '
If @AIMSupplierID <> 0 SET @SQL += ' and S.AIMSourceID = ' + convert(varchar, @AIMSupplierID)
If @AIMSupplierLocationID <> 0 SET @SQL += ' and S.AIMSourceLocationID = ' + convert(varchar, @AIMSupplierLocationID)
SET @SQL += '
GROUP BY S.Sampleid , S.SampleCode , S.SampleDate , AM.AIMMaterialCode , AM.AIMMaterialName , AN.AIMNutrientCode , AN.AIMNutrientName '
EXEC (@SQL) --print @sql
END

BEGIN
-- EXEC dbo.usp_Sample_SEL_ColumnNames 'Sample'
SELECT C.name AS ColumnName , P.name AS DataType , P.max_length AS Size , CAST(P.precision AS VARCHAR) + '/' + CAST(P.scale AS VARCHAR) AS PrecisionScale FROM sys.Objects AS T JOIN sys.Columns AS C ON T.object_id = C.object_id JOIN sys.types AS P ON C.system_type_id = P.system_type_id WHERE T.Name = @TableName and P.Name <> 'sysname' order by c.Name
END

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value:
BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
DECLARE @SQL VARCHAR(2000) = '' DECLARE @Where VARCHAR(500) = '' DECLARE @InnerJoin VARCHAR(500) = '' DECLARE @WhereDate VARCHAR(500) = '' DECLARE @Fieldname VARCHAR(50) = '' DECLARE @SearchTable VARCHAR(25) = '' DECLARE @SearchField VARCHAR(25) = ''
Declare @SqlSampleCodeBegin varchar(100) Declare @SqlSampleCodeEnd varchar(100)
Begin
If len(@SampleCodeBeg) > 0 AND len(@SampleCodeEnd) > 0 SET @Where = '(S.SampleCode >= ''' + @SampleCodeBeg + ''' AND S.SampleCode <= ''' + @SampleCodeEnd + ''')' Else If len(@SampleCodeBeg) > 0 --SET @Where = '(S.SampleCode LIKE ''%' + @SampleCodeBeg + '%'')' SET @Where = '(S.SampleCode >= ''' + @SampleCodeBeg + ''')' Else If len(@SampleCodeEnd) > 0 --SET @Where = '(S.SampleCode LIKE ''%' + @SampleCodeBeg + '%'')' SET @Where = '(S.SampleCode <= ''' + @SampleCodeEnd + ''')'
If Len(@DateBeg) > 0 AND len(@DateEnd) > 0 SET @WhereDate = '(SampleDate >= Cast(''' + @DateBeg + ''' as date) AND SampleDate <= Cast(''' + @DateEnd + ''' as date) )' Else if Len(@DateBeg) > 0 SET @WhereDate = '(SampleDate >= Cast(''' + @DateBeg + ''' as date) )' Else if Len(@DateEnd) > 0 SET @WhereDate = '(SampleDate <= Cast(''' + @DateEnd + ''' as date) )'
if Len(@Where) > 0 SET @Where = ' WHERE ' + @Where
if Len(@Where) > 0 and Len(@WhereDate) > 0 SET @Where = @Where + ' AND ' + @WhereDate
if Len(@Where) = 0 and Len(@WhereDate) > 0 SET @Where = ' WHERE ' + @WhereDate
SET @SQL = ' SELECT S.SampleID, 0 as SampleExportDetailID , CASE WHEN S.SampleCode IS NULL or len(S.SampleCode) = 0 then convert(varchar, S.SampleID) else S.SampleCode End as SampleCode ,S.SampleDate , MT.MaterialTypeName as MaterialType , MT.MaterialTypeID , AM.AIMMaterialCode as MaterialCode , AM.AIMMaterialName as MaterialName
FROM dbo.Sample S WITH(NOLOCK) INNER JOIN dbo.AIMMaterial AM with (nolock) ON S.AIMMaterialID = AM.AIMMaterialID LEFT JOIN dbo.MaterialType MT with (nolock) on AM.MaterialTypeID = MT.MaterialTypeID
'
if len(@Where) > 0 SET @SQL += @Where
SET @SQL += ' ORDER BY CASE WHEN S.SampleCode IS NULL or len(S.SampleCode) = 0 then convert(varchar, S.SampleID) else S.SampleCode End '
EXEC(@SQL) --print @SQL
END
END

AS

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value:
BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
DECLARE @SQL VARCHAR(2000) = '' DECLARE @Where VARCHAR(500) = ''
EXEC @Where = [dbo].[AnalysisReports_WhereStatement] @ExportTemplateID
SET @Where = ' WHERE S.IsActive = 1 ' + @Where
SET @SQL = ' SELECT S.SampleID , CASE WHEN S.SampleCode IS NULL or len(S.SampleCode) = 0 then convert(varchar, S.SampleID) else S.SampleCode End as SampleCode , S.SampleDate , AM.AIMMaterialCode , AM.AIMMaterialName , AO.OwnerCode as AIMOwnerCode , AO.OwnerName as AIMOwnerName , AOL.LocationCode as AIMOwnerLocationCode , AOL.LocationName as AIMOwnerLocationName , AMS.AIMSupplierCode , AMS.SourceName as AIMSupplierName , AMSL.AIMSupplierLocationCode , AMSL.SourceLocationName as AIMSupplierLocationName , S.AlternateCode , S.BillOfLoad , S.ContractNumber , S.InvoiceNumber , S.LoadNumber , S.LotNumber , S.PoNumber , S.TicketNumber , S.VehicleNumber , AM.AIMMaterialID , AO.AIMOwnerID , AOL.AIMOwnerLocationID , AMS.AIMSourceID as AIMSupplierID , AMSL.AIMSourceLocationID as AIMSupplierLocationID , AM.MaterialTypeID
FROM dbo.Sample S WITH(NOLOCK)
LEFT JOIN dbo.AIMMaterial AM with (nolock) on S.AIMMaterialID = AM.AIMMaterialID LEFT JOIN dbo.AIMOwner AO with (nolock) on S.AIMOwnerID = AO.AIMOwnerID LEFT JOIN dbo.AIMOwnerLocation AOL with (nolock) on S.AIMOwnerLocationID = AOL.AIMOwnerLocationID LEFT JOIN dbo.AIMSource AMS with (nolock) on S.AIMSourceID = AMS.AIMSourceID LEFT JOIN dbo.AIMSourceLocation AMSL with (nolock) on S.AIMSourceLocationID = AMSL.AIMSourceLocationID LEFT OUTER JOIN CFCUser.CFCUser U WITH(NOLOCK) ON S.CFCUserID = U.CFCUserID '
SET @SQL += @Where
IF @ExportTemplateID = 0 SET @SQL += ' and S.SampleID IS NULL '
EXEC(@SQL) --print @Sql
END

-- 1/11/21 - removed link to aspnet_User table
--exec usp_Sample_SEL_Export_CSV 3
AS

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value:
BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
--exec usp_Sample_SEL_Filter 44, 'Salisbury' --exec usp_Sample_SEL_Filter 5, 'ddddd', '2015-08-19', '2015-08-19' --exec usp_Sample_SEL_Filter 0, '', '2015-08-19', '2015-08-19' --exec usp_Sample_SEL_Filter 42, 'Test', '', '' --exec usp_Sample_SEL_Filter 5, 'Test', '6/12/2015', '6/12/2015'
DECLARE @SQL VARCHAR(2000) = '' DECLARE @Where VARCHAR(500) = '' DECLARE @InnerJoin VARCHAR(500) = '' DECLARE @WhereDate VARCHAR(500) = '' DECLARE @Fieldname VARCHAR(50) = '' DECLARE @SearchTable VARCHAR(25) = '' DECLARE @SearchField VARCHAR(25) = ''
IF @FilterControlID <> 0 OR @DateBeg IS NOT NULL OR @DateEnd IS NULL Begin
If @FilterControlID <> 0 Begin SET @Fieldname = (Select SampleTableFieldName From dbo.SampleFilter with (nolock) Where ControlID = @FilterControlID)
IF @FieldName IN ('SampleCode', 'ContractNumber', 'PONumber', 'InvoiceNumber','TicketNumber', 'LoadNumber', 'BillOfLoad', 'VehicleNumber', 'LotNumber', 'AlternateCode') SET @Where = '(' + @FieldName + ' LIKE ''%' + @Value + '%'')'
ELSE Begin IF @FieldName IN ('AnalyzerMaterialID','AIMOwnerID', 'AIMOwnerLocationID', 'AIMSourceID', 'AIMSourceLocationID', 'DataSourceTypeID', 'FurtherAnalysisID', 'AIMMaterialID') Begin
SET @SearchTable = (Select SearchTable From dbo.SampleFilter with (nolock) Where ControlID = @FilterControlID) SET @SearchField = (Select SearchField From dbo.SampleFilter with (nolock) Where ControlID = @FilterControlID)
IF Len(@SearchTable) > 0 and Len(@SearchField) > 0 Begin SET @InnerJoin = ' Inner join ' + @SearchTable + ' T on S.' + @FieldName + ' = T.' + @FieldName SET @Where = '(T.' + @SearchField + ' LIKE ''%' + @Value + '%'')'
End End End End
If Len(@DateBeg) > 0 AND len(@DateEnd) > 0 SET @WhereDate = '(SampleDate >= Cast(''' + @DateBeg + ''' as date) AND SampleDate <= Cast(''' + @DateEnd + ''' as date) )' Else if Len(@DateBeg) > 0 SET @WhereDate = '(SampleDate >= Cast(''' + @DateBeg + ''' as date) )' Else if Len(@DateEnd) > 0 SET @WhereDate = '(SampleDate <= Cast(''' + @DateEnd + ''' as date) )'
if Len(@Where) > 0 SET @Where = ' WHERE ' + @Where
if Len(@Where) > 0 and Len(@WhereDate) > 0 SET @Where = @Where + ' AND ' + @WhereDate
if Len(@Where) = 0 and Len(@WhereDate) > 0 SET @Where = ' WHERE ' + @WhereDate
SET @SQL = ' SELECT S.SampleID , CASE WHEN S.SampleCode IS NULL or len(S.SampleCode) = 0 then convert(varchar, S.SampleID) else S.SampleCode End as SampleCode ,S.CreatedStamp ,S.AIMOwnerID ,S.AIMSourceID ,S.AIMSourceLocationID ,S.ContractNumber ,S.PoNumber ,S.InvoiceNumber ,S.TicketNumber ,S.LoadNumber ,S.BillOfLoad ,S.VehicleNumber ,S.LotNumber ,S.IsActive ,S.AnalyzerMaterialID ,S.SampleDate ,S.AnalysisDate ,S.AIMOwnerLocationID ,S.CFCUserID ,S.UpdateStamp ,S.FurtherAnalysisID ,S.AIMMaterialID ,S.AlternateCode ,S.DataSourceTypeID ,S.SupportingDocumentPath
FROM dbo.Sample S WITH(NOLOCK) '
if len(@InnerJoin) > 0 SET @SQL += @InnerJoin
+ '
LEFT OUTER JOIN CFCUser.CFCUser U WITH(NOLOCK) ON S.CFCUserID = U.CFCUserID '
if len(@Where) > 0 SET @SQL += @Where
EXEC(@SQL) --print @SQL
END
END

SELECT S.* FROM dbo.Sample S INNER JOIN dbo.AIMMaterial AM ON AM.AIMMaterialID = S.AIMMaterialID INNER JOIN dbo.AIMMaterialRefAnalyzerMaterial AMRAM ON AMRAM.AIMMaterialID = AM.AIMMaterialID INNER JOIN dbo.AnalyzerMaterial AML ON AML.AnalyzerMaterialID = AMRAM.AnalyzerMaterialID AND AML.DataSourceTypeID = @FurtherAnalysisID INNER JOIN dbo.APILog AL ON AL.SampleID = S.SampleID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AnalyzerPendingSample APS ON APS.SampleID = S.SampleID WHERE S.FurtherAnalysisID = @FurtherAnalysisID AND AM.MaterialTypeID = ISNULL(@MaterialTypeID, AM.MaterialTypeID) AND APS.SampleID IS NULL AND S.CreatedStamp > @CreatedStamp

Property.Value: CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_Sample_SEL_FurtherAnalysisIDMaterialTypeIDCreatedStampMissingFurtherAnalysis] @FurtherAnalysisID INT , @MaterialTypeID INT , @CreatedStamp DATETIME AS

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value:
BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
IF @MaterialTypeID = 0 BEGIN SET @MaterialTypeID = NULL END
SET @SQLResultID = @SQLResultID + '%'
SELECT S.* FROM dbo.Sample S INNER JOIN dbo.AIMMaterial AM ON AM.AIMMaterialID = S.AIMMaterialID INNER JOIN dbo.APILog AL ON AL.SampleID = S.SampleID INNER JOIN dbo.AIMMaterialRefAnalyzerMaterial AMRAM ON AMRAM.AIMMaterialID = AM.AIMMaterialID INNER JOIN dbo.AnalyzerMaterial AML ON AML.AnalyzerMaterialID = AMRAM.AnalyzerMaterialID AND AML.DataSourceTypeID = @FurtherAnalysisID INNER JOIN dbo.AnalyzerPendingSample APS ON APS.SampleID = S.SampleID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.SampleResult SR ON SR.SampleID = S.SampleID AND SR.SQLResultID LIKE @SQLResultID AND SUBSTRING(SR.SQLResultID, 7, LEN(SR.SQLResultID)) = APS.RequestCode

Property.Name: HeaderContents
Property.Value: CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_Sample_SEL_FurtherAnalysisIDMaterialTypeIDCreatedStampSQLResultIDMissingResult] @FurtherAnalysisID INT , @MaterialTypeID INT , @CreatedStamp DATETIME , @SQLResultID NVARCHAR(300) AS

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value:
BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
SELECT ST.AIMMaterialID , ST.AIMNutrientID , Q.SampleSize , Q.Quartile1 , Q.Quartile3 , ST.Mean , ST.StandardDeviation , ST.Min , ST.Max , ST.Upper95Mean , ST.Lower95Mean , ST.Upper90Mean , ST.Lower90Mean , ST.MeanPlusStandardDeviation , ST.MeanMinusStandardDeviation INTO #Statis FROM ( SELECT S.AIMMaterialID , SA.AIMNutrientID , ROUND(AVG(SA.AIMUsedValue), 4) AS Mean , ROUND(STDEV(SA.AIMUsedValue), 4) AS StandardDeviation , MIN(SA.AIMUsedValue) AS Min , MAX(SA.AIMUsedValue) AS Max , ROUND(AVG(SA.AIMUsedValue) + (1.96 * STDEV(SA.AIMUsedValue) / SQRT(COUNT(*))), 4) AS Upper95Mean , ROUND(AVG(SA.AIMUsedValue) - (1.96 * STDEV(SA.AIMUsedValue) / SQRT(COUNT(*))), 4) AS Lower95Mean , ROUND(AVG(SA.AIMUsedValue) + (1.645 * STDEV(SA.AIMUsedValue) / SQRT(COUNT(*))), 4) AS Upper90Mean , ROUND(AVG(SA.AIMUsedValue) - (1.645 * STDEV(SA.AIMUsedValue) / SQRT(COUNT(*))), 4) AS Lower90Mean , ROUND(AVG(SA.AIMUsedValue) + .5 * STDEV(SA.AIMUsedValue), 4) AS MeanPlusStandardDeviation , ROUND(AVG(SA.AIMUsedValue) - .5 * STDEV(SA.AIMUsedValue), 4) AS MeanMinusStandardDeviation FROM dbo.Sample S WITH(NOLOCK) INNER JOIN dbo.SampleAIM SA WITH(NOLOCK) ON SA.SampleID = S.SampleID WHERE S.IsActive = 1 AND S.SampleDate BETWEEN @StartDate and @EndDate AND SA.IsActive = 1 GROUP BY S.AIMMaterialID , SA.AIMNutrientID ) ST INNER JOIN ( SELECT C.AIMMaterialID , C.AIMNutrientID , COUNT(*) AS SampleSize , ROUND((Max(Q1NextVal) - MAX(Q1Val)) * Max(Q1Frac) + Max(Q1Val), 4) AS Quartile1 , ROUND((Max(Q3NextVal) - MAX(Q3Val)) * Max(Q3Frac) + Max(Q3Val), 4) AS Quartile3 FROM ( SELECT D.AIMMaterialID , D.AIMNutrientID , CASE WHEN RowNum = Q1Idx THEN AIMUsedValue ELSE NULL END AS Q1Val , CASE WHEN RowNum = Q1Idx + 1 THEN AIMUsedValue ELSE NULL END AS Q1NextVal , CASE WHEN RowNum = Q3Idx THEN AIMUsedValue ELSE NULL END AS Q3Val , CASE WHEN RowNum = Q3Idx + 1 THEN AIMUsedValue ELSE NULL END AS Q3NextVal , Q1Frac , Q3Frac , AIMUsedValue FROM /*Calculate a row number sorted by measure for each group.*/ ( SELECT SA.AIMUsedValue , S.AIMMaterialID , SA.AIMNutrientID , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY S.AIMMaterialID, SA.AIMNutrientID ORDER BY AIMUsedValue) AS RowNum FROM dbo.Sample S WITH(NOLOCK) INNER JOIN dbo.SampleAIM SA WITH(NOLOCK) ON SA.SampleID = S.SampleID WHERE S.IsActive = 1 AND S.SampleDate BETWEEN @StartDate and @EndDate ) D INNER JOIN (/*the values at the quartile points.*/ SELECT S.AIMMaterialID , SA.AIMNutrientID , FLOOR((COUNT(*) + 3) / 4.0) AS Q1Idx , ((COUNT(*) + 3) / 4.0) - dbo.CFCIngredientRefAIMMaterial CIRAM ON CIRAM.AIMMaterialID = S.AIMMaterialID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.CFCIngredient CI ON CI.CFCIngredientID = CIRAM.CFCIngredientID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.CFCIngredientNutrient CIN ON CIN.CFCIngredientID = CI.CFCIngredientID AND CIN.CFCNutrientID = CNRAN.CFCNutrientID WHERE S.IsActive = 1 AND S.SampleDate BETWEEN @StartDate and @EndDate GROUP BY BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
DECLARE @SQL VARCHAR(6000) = '' DECLARE @Where VARCHAR(1000) = ''
-- 1/11/21 - removed link to aspnet_User table -- 1/22/21 - added SampleTypeID -- 9/30/22 - added GroundUnGround
--exec usp_Sample_SEL_IsActive_SystemSettingDays 1, 1000
SET @Where = ' WHERE S.IsActive = ''' + Cast(@IsActive as varchar) + ''' '
-- If @Days = 0, then get ALL the samples
If @Days <> 0 SET @Where = @Where + ' AND S.SampleDate >= ''' + Cast(DATEADD(d,-@Days,GETDATE()) as varchar) + ''' '
SET @SQL = 'SELECT S.SampleID , CASE WHEN S.SampleCode IS NULL or len(S.SampleCode) = 0 then convert(varchar, S.SampleID) else S.SampleCode End as SampleCode ,S.CreatedStamp ,S.AIMOwnerID ,S.AIMSourceID ,S.AIMSourceLocationID ,S.ContractNumber ,S.PoNumber ,S.InvoiceNumber ,S.TicketNumber ,S.LoadNumber ,S.BillOfLoad ,S.VehicleNumber ,S.LotNumber ,S.IsActive ,S.AnalyzerMaterialID ,S.SampleDate ,S.AnalysisDate ,S.AIMOwnerLocationID ,S.CFCUserID ,S.UpdateStamp ,S.FurtherAnalysisID ,S.AIMMaterialID ,S.AlternateCode ,S.DataSourceTypeID ,S.CFCProductArchiveID ,S.Notes ,S.ExpirationDate ,S.SupportingDocumentPath ,S.SampleTypeID ,S.IsGround ,S.SampleTestTypeID ,S.GroundUnGroundID
FROM dbo.Sample S LEFT OUTER JOIN CFCUser.CFCUser U ON S.CFCUserID = U.CFCUserID ' + @Where
SET @SQL += 'ORDER BY CASE WHEN ISNUMERIC(S.SampleCode) = 1 THEN CAST(S.SampleCode AS BIGINT) ELSE NULL END, S.SampleCode '
