------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ -- The next 5 lines are the CAPTIONS for the 5 labels columns
SET @SQL = @SQL + '
, (Select TOP 1 Left(A.AlternateName,13) From dbo.AlternateName A INNER JOIN dbo.Control C ON A.ControlID = C.ControlID INNER JOIN dbo.Label L on C.ControlID = L.ControlID INNER JOIN dbo.LabelFormat LF on L.LabelID = LF.LabelID WHERE LF.OrderNumber = 1 and LF.MaterialTypeID = ' + Cast(@IngrOrProd as varchar) + ') AS Line1Caption , (Select TOP 1 Left(A.AlternateName,13) From dbo.AlternateName A INNER JOIN dbo.Control C ON A.ControlID = C.ControlID INNER JOIN dbo.Label L on C.ControlID = L.ControlID INNER JOIN dbo.LabelFormat LF on L.LabelID = LF.LabelID WHERE LF.OrderNumber = 2 and LF.MaterialTypeID = ' + Cast(@IngrOrProd as varchar) + ') AS Line2Caption , (Select TOP 1 Left(A.AlternateName,13) From dbo.AlternateName A INNER JOIN dbo.Control C ON A.ControlID = C.ControlID INNER JOIN dbo.Label L on C.ControlID = L.ControlID INNER JOIN dbo.LabelFormat LF on L.LabelID = LF.LabelID WHERE LF.OrderNumber = 3 and LF.MaterialTypeID = ' + Cast(@IngrOrProd as varchar) + ') AS Line3Caption , (Select TOP 1 Left(A.AlternateName,13) From dbo.AlternateName A INNER JOIN dbo.Control C ON A.ControlID = C.ControlID INNER JOIN dbo.Label L on C.ControlID = L.ControlID INNER JOIN dbo.LabelFormat LF on L.LabelID = LF.LabelID WHERE LF.OrderNumber = 4 and LF.MaterialTypeID = ' + Cast(@IngrOrProd as varchar) + ') AS Line4Caption , (Select TOP 1 Left(A.AlternateName,13) From dbo.AlternateName A INNER JOIN dbo.Control C ON A.ControlID = C.ControlID INNER JOIN dbo.Label L on C.ControlID = L.ControlID INNER JOIN dbo.LabelFormat LF on L.LabelID = LF.LabelID WHERE LF.OrderNumber = 5 and LF.MaterialTypeID = ' + Cast(@IngrOrProd as varchar) + ') AS Line5Caption ' ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ -- The next 5 lines indicate whether or not the line should be bold
SET @SQL = @SQL + '
, (Select FontSize From dbo.LabelFormat LF WHERE LF.OrderNumber = 1 and LF.MaterialTypeID = ' + Cast(@IngrOrProd as varchar) + ') AS Line1Size , (Select FontSize From dbo.LabelFormat LF WHERE LF.OrderNumber = 2 and LF.MaterialTypeID = ' + Cast(@IngrOrProd as varchar) + ') AS Line2Size , (Select FontSize From dbo.LabelFormat LF WHERE LF.OrderNumber = 3 and LF.MaterialTypeID = ' + Cast(@IngrOrProd as varchar) + ') AS Line3Size , (Select FontSize From dbo.LabelFormat LF WHERE LF.OrderNumber = 4 and LF.MaterialTypeID = ' + Cast(@IngrOrProd as varchar) + ') AS Line4Size , (Select FontSize From dbo.LabelFormat LF WHERE LF.OrderNumber = 5 and LF.MaterialTypeID = ' + Cast(@IngrOrProd as varchar) + ') AS Line5Size ' ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ -- The next 5 lines indicate whether or not the line should be bold
SET @SQL = @SQL + '
, (Select IsBold From dbo.LabelFormat LF WHERE LF.OrderNumber = 1 and LF.MaterialTypeID = ' + Cast(@IngrOrProd as varchar) + ') AS Line1Bold , (Select IsBold From dbo.LabelFormat LF WHERE LF.OrderNumber = 2 and LF.MaterialTypeID = ' + Cast(@IngrOrProd as varchar) + ') AS Line2Bold , (Select IsBold From dbo.LabelFormat LF WHERE LF.OrderNumber = 3 and LF.MaterialTypeID = ' + Cast(@IngrOrProd as varchar) + ') AS Line3Bold , (Select IsBold From dbo.LabelFormat LF WHERE LF.OrderNumber = 4 and LF.MaterialTypeID = ' + Cast(@IngrOrProd as varchar) + ') AS Line4Bold , (Select IsBold From dbo.LabelFormat LF WHERE LF.OrderNumber = 5 and LF.MaterialTypeID = ' + Cast(@IngrOrProd as varchar) + ') AS Line5Bold , '
-- Task1141 BD251215 Below is the querying the control table to set LineNData based on the Order Number SET @LabelLineData = '' SELECT @LabelLineData = TableColumnName FROM dbo.LabelFormat LF INNER JOIN dbo.Label L ON L.LabelID = LF.LabelID WHERE LF.MaterialTypeID = Cast(@IngrOrProd as varchar) AND LF.OrderNumber = 1 SET @LabelLineData = CASE WHEN len(@LabelLineData) = 0 THEN '''''' ELSE @LabelLineData END + ' AS Line1DataUnformatted ,' + CHAR(13) SET @SQL = @SQL + @LabelLineData
SET @LabelLineData = '' SELECT @LabelLineData = TableColumnName FROM dbo.LabelFormat LF INNER JOIN dbo.Label L ON L.LabelID = LF.LabelID WHERE LF.MaterialTypeID = Cast(@IngrOrProd as varchar) AND LF.OrderNumber = 2 SET @LabelLineData = CASE WHEN len(@LabelLineData) = 0 THEN '''''' ELSE @LabelLineData END + ' AS Line2DataUnformatted ,' + CHAR(13) SET @SQL = @SQL + @LabelLineData
SET @LabelLineData = '' SELECT @LabelLineData = TableColumnName FROM dbo.LabelFormat LF INNER JOIN dbo.Label L ON L.LabelID = LF.LabelID WHERE LF.MaterialTypeID = Cast(@IngrOrProd as varchar) AND LF.OrderNumber = 3 SET @LabelLineData = CASE WHEN len(@LabelLineData) = 0 THEN '''''' ELSE @LabelLineData END + ' AS Line3DataUnformatted ,' + CHAR(13) SET @SQL = @SQL + @LabelLineData
SET @LabelLineData = '' SELECT @LabelLineData = TableColumnName FROM dbo.LabelFormat LF INNER JOIN dbo.Label L ON L.LabelID = LF.LabelID WHERE LF.MaterialTypeID = Cast(@IngrOrProd as varchar) AND LF.OrderNumber = 4 SET @LabelLineData = CASE WHEN len(@LabelLineData) = 0 THEN '''''' ELSE @LabelLineData END + ' AS Line4DataUnformatted ,' + CHAR(13) SET @SQL = @SQL + @LabelLineData
SET @LabelLineData = '' SELECT @LabelLineData = TableColumnName FROM dbo.LabelFormat LF INNER JOIN dbo.Label L ON L.LabelID = LF.LabelID WHERE LF.MaterialTypeID = Cast(@IngrOrProd as varchar) AND LF.OrderNumber = 5 SET @LabelLineData = CASE WHEN len(@LabelLineData) = 0 THEN '''''' ELSE @LabelLineData END + ' AS Line5DataUnformatted ' SET @SQL = @SQL + @LabelLineData ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ -- The next 5 sections get the actual field name to be used to get the DATA for the 5 label columns
-- Task1141 DB2512115 -- Note: Changed the way we pull the label data. We added a column to the control table to identify which data column to pull from (LabelTableColumnName) --(Select case when (
-- (Select TOP 1 case when S.SearchField IS NULL or S.SearchField = 'Null' then 'SA.' + S.SampleTableFieldName Else -- case when S.SearchField = 'AnalyzerMaterialName' then 'AIMMaterialName' else S.SearchField end end -- FROM dbo.SampleFilter S -- INNER JOIN dbo.AlternateName A on S.ControlID = A.ControlID -- INNER JOIN dbo.Label L on A.ControlID = L.ControlID -- INNER JOIN dbo.LabelFormat LF on L.LabelID = LF.LabelID -- WHERE LF.OrderNumber = 1 -- and MaterialTypeID = @IngrOrProd) ) IS NULL then '''''' else
-- (Select TOP 1 case when S.SearchField IS NULL or S.SearchField = 'Null' then 'SA.' + S.SampleTableFieldName Else -- case when S.SearchField = 'AnalyzerMaterialName' then 'AIMMaterialName' else S.SearchField end end -- FROM dbo.SampleFilter S -- INNER JOIN dbo.AlternateName A on S.ControlID = A.ControlID -- INNER JOIN dbo.Label L on A.ControlID = L.ControlID -- INNER JOIN dbo.LabelFormat LF on L.LabelID = LF.LabelID -- WHERE LF.OrderNumber = 1 -- and MaterialTypeID = @IngrOrProd) end)
-- + ' as Line1Data
-- , ' +
-- (Select case when ( -- (Select TOP 1 case when S.SearchField IS NULL or S.SearchField = 'Null' then 'SA.' + S.SampleTableFieldName Else -- case when S.SearchField = 'AnalyzerMaterialName' then 'AIMMaterialName' else S.SearchField end end -- FROM dbo.SampleFilter S -- INNER JOIN dbo.AlternateName A on S.ControlID = A.ControlID -- INNER JOIN dbo.Label L on A.ControlID = L.ControlID -- INNER JOIN dbo.LabelFormat LF on L.LabelID = LF.LabelID -- WHERE LF.OrderNumber = 2 -- and MaterialTypeID = @IngrOrProd) ) IS NULL then '''''' else
-- (Select TOP 1 case when S.SearchField IS NULL or S.SearchField = 'Null' then 'SA.' + S.SampleTableFieldName Else -- case when S.SearchField = 'AnalyzerMaterialName' then 'AIMMaterialName' else S.SearchField end end -- FROM dbo.SampleFilter S -- INNER JOIN dbo.AlternateName A on S.ControlID = A.ControlID -- INNER JOIN dbo.Label L on A.ControlID = L.ControlID -- INNER JOIN dbo.LabelFormat LF on L.LabelID = LF.LabelID -- WHERE LF.OrderNumber = 2 -- and MaterialTypeID = @IngrOrProd) end)
-- + ' as Line2Data
-- , ' +
-- (Select case when ( -- (Select TOP 1 case when S.SearchField IS NULL or S.SearchField = 'Null' then 'SA.' + S.SampleTableFieldName Else -- case when S.SearchField = 'AnalyzerMaterialName' then 'AIMMaterialName' else S.SearchField end end -- FROM dbo.SampleFilter S -- INNER JOIN dbo.AlternateName A on S.ControlID = A.ControlID -- INNER JOIN dbo.Label L on A.ControlID = L.ControlID -- INNER JOIN dbo.LabelFormat LF on L.LabelID = LF.LabelID -- WHERE LF.OrderNumber = 3 -- and MaterialTypeID = @IngrOrProd)) IS NULL then '''''' else
-- (Select TOP 1 case when S.SearchField IS NULL or S.SearchField = 'Null' then 'SA.' + S.SampleTableFieldName Else -- case when S.SearchField = 'AnalyzerMaterialName' then 'AIMMaterialName' else S.SearchField end end -- FROM dbo.SampleFilter S -- INNER JOIN dbo.AlternateName A on S.ControlID = A.ControlID -- INNER JOIN dbo.Label L on A.ControlID = L.ControlID -- INNER JOIN dbo.LabelFormat LF on L.LabelID = LF.LabelID -- WHERE LF.OrderNumber = 3 -- and MaterialTypeID = @IngrOrProd) end)
-- + ' as Line3Data
-- , ' +
-- (Select case when ( -- (Select TOP 1 case when S.SearchField IS NULL or S.SearchField = 'Null' then 'SA.' + S.SampleTableFieldName Else -- case when S.SearchField = 'AnalyzerMaterialName' then 'AIMMaterialName' else S.SearchField end end -- FROM dbo.SampleFilter S -- INNER JOIN dbo.AlternateName A on S.ControlID = A.ControlID -- INNER JOIN dbo.Label L on A.ControlID = L.ControlID -- INNER JOIN dbo.LabelFormat LF on L.LabelID = LF.LabelID -- WHERE LF.OrderNumber = 4 -- and MaterialTypeID = @IngrOrProd) ) IS NULL then '''''' else
-- (Select TOP 1 case when S.SearchField IS NULL or S.SearchField = 'Null' then 'SA.' + S.SampleTableFieldName Else -- case when S.SearchField = 'AnalyzerMaterialName' then 'AIMMaterialName' else S.SearchField end end -- FROM dbo.SampleFilter S -- INNER JOIN dbo.AlternateName A on S.ControlID = A.ControlID -- INNER JOIN dbo.Label L on A.ControlID = L.ControlID -- INNER JOIN dbo.LabelFormat LF on L.LabelID = LF.LabelID -- WHERE LF.OrderNumber = 4 -- and MaterialTypeID = @IngrOrProd) end)
-- + ' as Line4Data
-- , ' +
-- (Select case when ( -- (Select TOP 1 case when S.SearchField IS NULL or S.SearchField = 'Null' then 'SA.' + S.SampleTableFieldName Else -- case when S.SearchField = 'AnalyzerMaterialName' then 'AIMMaterialName' else S.SearchField end end -- FROM dbo.SampleFilter S -- INNER JOIN dbo.AlternateName A on S.ControlID = A.ControlID -- INNER JOIN dbo.Label L on A.ControlID = L.ControlID -- INNER JOIN dbo.LabelFormat LF on L.LabelID = LF.LabelID -- WHERE LF.OrderNumber = 5 -- and MaterialTypeID = @IngrOrProd) ) IS NULL then '''''' else
-- (Select TOP 1 case when S.SearchField IS NULL or S.SearchField = 'Null' then 'SA.' + S.SampleTableFieldName Else -- case when S.SearchField = 'AnalyzerMaterialName' then 'AIMMaterialName' else S.SearchField end end -- FROM dbo.SampleFilter S -- INNER JOIN dbo.AlternateName A on S.ControlID = A.ControlID -- INNER JOIN dbo.Label L on A.ControlID = L.ControlID -- INNER JOIN dbo.LabelFormat LF on L.LabelID = LF.LabelID -- WHERE LF.OrderNumber = 5 -- and MaterialTypeID = @IngrOrProd) end)
-- + ' as Line5Data
SET @SQL = @SQL + '
FROM dbo.Sample SA WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMMaterial AM WITH(NOLOCK) ON AM.AIMMaterialID = SA.AIMMaterialID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMOwner AO with (nolock) ON AO.AIMOwnerID = SA.AIMOwnerID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMOwnerLocation AOL with (nolock) ON AOL.AIMOwnerLocationID = SA.AIMOwnerLocationID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMSource SO WITH(NOLOCK) ON SO.AIMSourceID = SA.AIMSourceID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMSourceLocation SL WITH(NOLOCK) ON SL.AIMSourceLocationID = SA.AIMSourceLocationID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.DataSourceType D with (nolock) ON SA.DataSourceTypeID = D.DataSourceTypeID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AnalyzerMaterial AN ON AN.AnalyzerMaterialID = SA.AnalyzerMaterialID

END

BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
-- exec usp_Sample_SEL_ProductCompliance 5, '2017-02-28', '2017-02-01'
SELECT AO.OwnerName , AOL.LocationName , AM.AIMMaterialCode , CPA.ProductionVersion , S.SampleDate , S.SampleCode , AN.AIMNutrientName , UT.UnitTypeDescription , SA.AIMUsedValue , ISNULL(CPAS.NutrientMin, 0) AS NutrientMin , ISNULL(CPAS.NutrientMax, 0) AS NutrientMax , ISNULL(CPAN.NutrientValue, 0) AS NutrientValue FROM dbo.Sample S INNER JOIN dbo.SampleAIM SA ON SA.SampleID = S.SampleID INNER JOIN dbo.AIMOwner AO ON AO.AIMOwnerID = S.AIMOwnerID INNER JOIN dbo.AIMOwnerLocation AOL ON AOL.AIMOwnerLocationID = S.AIMOwnerLocationID INNER JOIN dbo.AIMMaterial AM ON AM.AIMMaterialID = S.AIMMaterialID INNER JOIN dbo.AIMNutrient AN ON AN.AIMNutrientID = SA.AIMNutrientID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.UnitType UT ON UT.UnitTypeID = AN.UnitTypeID INNER JOIN dbo.CFCProductRefAIMMaterial CPRAM ON CPRAM.AIMMaterialID = S.AIMMaterialID INNER JOIN dbo.CFCProductArchive CPA ON CPA.CFCProductID = CPRAM.CFCProductID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.CFCNutrientRefAIMNutrient CNRAN ON CNRAN.AIMNutrientID = SA.AIMNutrientID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.CFCProductArchiveSpec CPAS ON CPAS.CFCProductArchiveID = CPA.CFCProductArchiveID AND CPAS.CFCNutrientID = CNRAN.CFCNutrientID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.CFCProductArchiveNutrient CPAN ON CPAN.CFCProductArchiveID = CPA.CFCProductArchiveID AND CPAN.CFCNutrientID = CNRAN.CFCNutrientID WHERE --S.DataSourceTypeID = @DataSourceTypeID AND S.SampleDate >= ISNULL(@FromDate, '1753-1-1')
--AND S.SampleDate <= ISNULL(@FromDate, GETDATE()) AND S.SampleDate <= ISNULL(@ToDate, GETDATE())
AND AM.MaterialTypeID = 2
END

Property.Name: HeaderContents
Property.Value: CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_Sample_SEL_ProductCompliance] @DataSourceTypeID INT , @ToDate DATE = NULL , @FromDate DATE = NULL AS

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value:
BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
-- exec usp_Sample_SEL_ProductCompliance 5, '2017-02-28', '2017-02-01'
SELECT AO.OwnerName , AOL.LocationName , AM.AIMMaterialCode , CPA.ProductionVersion , S.SampleDate , S.SampleCode , AN.AIMNutrientName , UT.UnitTypeDescription , SA.AIMUsedValue , ISNULL(CPAS.NutrientMin, 0) AS NutrientMin , ISNULL(CPAS.NutrientMax, 0) AS NutrientMax , ISNULL(CPAN.NutrientValue, 0) AS NutrientValue FROM dbo.Sample S INNER JOIN dbo.SampleAIM SA ON SA.SampleID = S.SampleID INNER JOIN dbo.AIMOwner AO ON AO.AIMOwnerID = S.AIMOwnerID INNER JOIN dbo.AIMOwnerLocation AOL ON AOL.AIMOwnerLocationID = S.AIMOwnerLocationID INNER JOIN dbo.AIMMaterial AM ON AM.AIMMaterialID = S.AIMMaterialID INNER JOIN dbo.AIMNutrient AN ON AN.AIMNutrientID = SA.AIMNutrientID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.UnitType UT ON UT.UnitTypeID = AN.UnitTypeID INNER JOIN dbo.CFCProductRefAIMMaterial CPRAM ON CPRAM.AIMMaterialID = S.AIMMaterialID INNER JOIN dbo.CFCProductArchive CPA ON CPA.CFCProductID = CPRAM.CFCProductID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.CFCNutrientRefAIMNutrient CNRAN ON CNRAN.AIMNutrientID = SA.AIMNutrientID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.CFCProductArchiveSpec CPAS ON CPAS.CFCProductArchiveID = CPA.CFCProductArchiveID AND CPAS.CFCNutrientID = CNRAN.CFCNutrientID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.CFCProductArchiveNutrient CPAN ON CPAN.CFCProductArchiveID = CPA.CFCProductArchiveID AND CPAN.CFCNutrientID = CNRAN.CFCNutrientID WHERE --S.DataSourceTypeID = @DataSourceTypeID AND S.SampleDate >= ISNULL(@FromDate, '1753-1-1') AND S.SampleDate <= ISNULL(@ToDate, GETDATE()) AND AM.MaterialTypeID = 2 AND ((AIMUsedValue < NutrientMin AND NutrientMin <> 0) OR (AIMUsedValue > NutrientMax AND NutrientMax <> 0))
OR (
(AIMUsedValue < (NutrientValue - (NutrientValue * .10)) OR AIMUsedValue > (NutrientValue + (NutrientValue * .10)) )
)
END

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value:
BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
DECLARE @SQL VARCHAR(6000) = '' DECLARE @Where VARCHAR(1000) = '' DECLARE @WhereValue VARCHAR(1000) = ''
IF @SampleOwnerID = 0 BEGIN SET @SampleOwnerID = NULL END
IF @AIMOwnerLocationID = 0 BEGIN SET @AIMOwnerLocationID = NULL END
IF @AIMSourceID = 0 BEGIN SET @AIMSourceID = NULL END
IF @AIMSourceLocationID = 0 BEGIN SET @AIMSourceLocationID = NULL END
IF @AIMMaterialID = 0 BEGIN SET @AIMMaterialID = NULL END
IF Len(@Ticket) = 0 BEGIN SET @Ticket = NULL END
IF @QueryTemplateID IS NULL BEGIN
SET @Where = 'WHERE AN.IsActive = 1 '
if @SampleOwnerID IS NOT NULL SET @Where += ' and S.AIMOwnerID = ' + Cast(@SampleOwnerID as varchar) + ' ' if @AIMOwnerLocationID IS NOT NULL SET @Where += ' and S.AIMOwnerLocationID = ' + Cast(@AIMOwnerLocationID as varchar) + ' ' if @AIMSourceID IS NOT NULL SET @Where += ' and S.AIMSourceID = ' + Cast(@AIMSourceID as varchar) + ' ' if @AIMSourceLocationID IS NOT NULL SET @Where += ' and S.AIMSourceLocationID = ' + Cast(@AIMSourceLocationID as varchar) + ' ' if @AIMMaterialID IS NOT NULL SET @Where += ' and S.AIMMaterialID = ' + Cast(@AIMMaterialID as varchar) + ' ' if @Ticket IS NOT NULL SET @Where += ' and S.TicketNumber = ' + Cast(@Ticket as varchar) + ' ' END ELSE BEGIN
SET @Where = ''
--- This create the where statement that the query will be using DECLARE WhereCur CURSOR FOR SELECT CASE WHEN QTD.IsAnd = 0 THEN 'OR ' ELSE 'AND ' END + QF.FieldName + ' ' + CASE WHEN QTD.Value > 0 THEN REPLACE(QO.Command, '@VALUE', QTD.Value) ELSE REPLACE(QO.Command, '@VALUE', '''' + CAST(QTD.DateValue AS VARCHAR) + '''') END AS WhereValue FROM dbo.QueryTemplateDetail QTD INNER JOIN dbo.QueryField QF ON QF.QueryFieldID = QTD.QueryFieldID INNER JOIN dbo.QueryOperation QO ON QO.QueryOperationID = QTD.QueryOperationID WHERE QTD.QueryTemplateID = @QueryTemplateID OPEN WhereCur FETCH NEXT FROM WhereCur INTO @WhereValue WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN IF @Where = '' BEGIN SET @Where += 'WHERE ' + SUBSTRING(@WhereValue, 5, LEN(@WhereValue)) END ELSE BEGIN SET @Where += ' ' + @WhereValue END FETCH NEXT FROM WhereCur INTO @WhereValue END CLOSE WhereCur DEALLOCATE WhereCur END
SET @SQL = 'SELECT ' If @ToDate is NOT NULL SET @Sql += '''' + convert(varchar,@ToDate) + ''' as ToDate, ' If @FromDate IS NOT NULL SET @Sql += '''' + convert(varchar,@FromDate) + ''' as FromDate, ' SET @SQL += ' DATEPART(WEEK, S.SampleDate) AS WeekID , AN.AIMNutrientCode , AN.AIMNutrientName , STDEV(SR.ResultValue) AS StandardDeviation , AVG(SR.ResultValue) AS Mean , AO.OwnerName , AOL.LocationName , SS.SourceName , SL.SourceLocationName , CI.CFCIngredientID , AM.AIMMaterialCode AS MaterialCode , AM.AIMMaterialName AS MaterialName , CP.CFCProductID , UT.UnitTypeDescription as Unit FROM dbo.Sample S WITH(NOLOCK) INNER JOIN dbo.SampleAIM SA WITH(NOLOCK) ON SA.SampleID = S.SampleID AND SA.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN dbo.SampleResult SR WITH(NOLOCK) ON SR.SampleID = S.SampleID AND SR.IsActive = 1 LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMOwner AO WITH(NOLOCK) ON AO.AIMOwnerID = S.AIMOwnerID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMMaterial AM WITH(NOLOCK) ON AM.AIMMaterialID = S.AIMMaterialID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMOwnerLocation AOL WITH(NOLOCK) ON AOL.AIMOwnerLocationID = S.AIMOwnerLocationID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMSource SS WITH(NOLOCK) ON SS.AIMSourceID = S.AIMSourceID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMSourceLocation SL WITH(NOLOCK) ON SL.AIMSourceLocationID = S.AIMSourceLocationID
LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMNutrient AN WITH(NOLOCK) ON AN.AIMNutrientID = SA.AIMNutrientID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.UnitType UT with (nolock) ON AN.UnitTypeID = UT.UnitTypeID
LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.CFCIngredientRefAIMMaterial CINIR WITH(NOLOCK) ON CINIR.AIMMaterialID = S.AIMMaterialID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.CFCIngredient CI WITH(NOLOCK) ON CI.CFCIngredientID = CINIR.CFCIngredientID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.CFCProductRefAIMMaterial CPNIP WITH(NOLOCK) ON CPNIP.AIMMaterialID = S.AIMMaterialID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.CFCProduct CP WITH(NOLOCK) ON CP.CFCProductID = CPNIP.CFCProductID '
+ @Where + ' ' +
'GROUP BY AN.AIMNutrientCode , AN.AIMNutrientName , DATEPART(WEEK, S.SampleDate) , AO.OwnerName , AOL.LocationName , SS.SourceName , SL.SourceLocationName , CI.CFCIngredientID , CI.CFCIngredientCode , CI.CFCIngredientName , AM.AIMMaterialCode , AM.AIMMaterialName , CP.CFCProductID , CP.CFCProductCode , CP.CFCProductName , UT.UnitTypeDescription
ORDER BY AO.OwnerName , AOL.LocationName , SS.SourceName , SL.SourceLocationName , CI.CFCIngredientCode , CP.CFCProductCode , AN.AIMNutrientCode , DATEPART(WEEK, S.SampleDate) '
--print @Sql EXEC (@SQL)
END

BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
DECLARE @SampleID INT DECLARE @SampleResultID INT DECLARE @AIMNutrientID INT DECLARE @ResultValue NUMERIC(18,9) DECLARE @TotalCnt INT = 0 DECLARE @Cnt INT = 0 DECLARE @Str VARCHAR(100) = '' DECLARE @Increment NUMERIC(18,4) = 1 DECLARE @Loop INT = 0
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- --Progress Bar SET @TotalCnt = (SELECT Count(*) FROM dbo.Sample S WITH(NOLOCK) INNER JOIN dbo.SampleResult SR WITH(NOLOCK) ON SR.SampleID = S.SampleID INNER JOIN dbo.AIMNutrientRefAnalyzerNutrient ANRAN WITH(NOLOCK) ON ANRAN.AnalyzerNutrientID = SR.AnalyzerNutrientID WHERE SR.IsActive = 1)
IF @TotalCnt <> 0 SET @Increment = 100 / Cast(@TotalCnt as Numeric)
DECLARE @strIncrement varchar(50) SET @strIncrement = convert(varchar(50), @Increment)
-- 6/25/19 - added ReturnMessage parameter because of memory issues at Smithfield --EXEC dbo.usp_ProgressBar_SAV_Increment @ProgressBarID, 'Rebuilding ...', @CFCUserID, 0 EXEC dbo.usp_ProgressBar_SAV_Increment @ProgressBarID, 'Rebuilding ...', @CFCUserID, 0, 0, 0 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
DECLARE db_cursor CURSOR FOR SELECT S.SampleID , SR.SampleResultID , ANRAN.AIMNutrientID , SR.ResultValue FROM dbo.Sample S WITH(NOLOCK) INNER JOIN dbo.SampleResult SR WITH(NOLOCK) ON SR.SampleID = S.SampleID INNER JOIN dbo.AIMNutrientRefAnalyzerNutrient ANRAN WITH(NOLOCK) ON ANRAN.AnalyzerNutrientID = SR.AnalyzerNutrientID WHERE SR.IsActive = 1
--AND S.SampleDate > '2018-01-01' AND S.SampleDate >= @RebuildDate
ORDER BY S.SampleID , SR.AnalyzerNutrientID , SR.AnalysisDate
OPEN db_cursor FETCH NEXT FROM db_cursor INTO @SampleID , @SampleResultID , @AIMNutrientID , @ResultValue
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN
SET @Loop = @Loop + 1 DELETE dbo.SampleAIM WHERE SampleID = @SampleID AND AIMNutrientID = @AIMNutrientID
INSERT INTO dbo.SampleAIM ( SampleID , SampleResultID , AIMNutrientID , AIMUsedValue , UpdateStamp , CFCUserID , IsActive ) VALUES ( @SampleID , @SampleResultID , @AIMNutrientID , @ResultValue , GETDATE() , 0 , 1 )
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- --Update Progress Bar table SET @Cnt = @Cnt + 1 SET @Str = 'Rebuilding ' + convert(varchar,@Cnt) + ' of ' + convert(varchar,@TotalCnt)
-- 6/25/19 - added loop because of memory issues at Smithfield IF @Loop > 200 BEGIN
-- 6/25/19 - added ReturnMessage parameter because of memory issues at Smithfield --EXEC dbo.usp_ProgressBar_SAV_Increment @ProgressBarID, @Str, @CFCUserID, @Increment EXEC dbo.usp_ProgressBar_SAV_Increment @ProgressBarID, @Str, @CFCUserID, @Increment, 0, 0
SET @Loop = 0 END
FETCH NEXT FROM db_cursor INTO @SampleID , @SampleResultID , @AIMNutrientID , @ResultValue ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
END
-- 6/25/19 - added ReturnMessage parameter because of memory issues at Smithfield --EXEC dbo.usp_ProgressBar_SAV_Increment @ProgressBarID, 'Rebuild Complete', @CFCUserID, 0 EXEC dbo.usp_ProgressBar_SAV_Increment @ProgressBarID, 'Rebuild Complete', @CFCUserID, 0, 0, 0

UPDATE dbo.SampleAIM with (rowlock) SET IsActive = @IsActive , CFCUserID = @CFCUserID , UpdateStamp = GETDATE() FROM dbo.Sample S INNER JOIN SampleAIM SA ON SA.SampleID = S.SampleID WHERE S.AIMMaterialID = @AIMMaterialID AND sa.AIMNutrientID = @AIMNutrientID AND s.SampleDate = @SampleDate END ELSE IF @SampleGroupByUpdateID = 3 --- (BOTH @OwnerLocationID and @Sample date NOT null) BEGIN
UPDATE dbo.SampleAIM with (rowlock) SET IsActive = @IsActive , CFCUserID = @CFCUserID , UpdateStamp = GETDATE() FROM dbo.Sample S INNER JOIN SampleAIM SA ON SA.SampleID = S.SampleID WHERE S.AIMMaterialID = @AIMMaterialID AND sa.AIMNutrientID = @AIMNutrientID AND s.SampleDate = @SampleDate AND s.AIMOwnerLocationID = @OwnerLocationID END ELSE IF @SampleGroupByUpdateID = 4 --- (@SampleDate is null) BEGIN
UPDATE dbo.SampleAIM with (rowlock) SET IsActive = @IsActive , CFCUserID = @CFCUserID , UpdateStamp = GETDATE() FROM dbo.Sample S INNER JOIN SampleAIM SA ON SA.SampleID = S.SampleID WHERE S.AIMMaterialID = @AIMMaterialID AND sa.AIMNutrientID = @AIMNutrientID AND s.SampleDate BETWEEN @SampleDate and @EndDate AND s.AIMOwnerLocationID = @OwnerLocationID END ELSE BEGIN UPDATE dbo.SampleAIM with (rowlock) SET IsActive = @IsActive , CFCUserID = @CFCUserID , UpdateStamp = GETDATE() FROM Sample S INNER JOIN SampleAIM SA ON SA.SampleID = S.SampleID WHERE S.AIMMaterialID = @AIMMaterialID AND sa.AIMNutrientID = @AIMNutrientID AND s.SampleDate BETWEEN @SampleDate and @EndDate END
SELECT @@IDENTITY as RecordID , @ErrorNumber AS ErrorNumber , @ErrorMessage AS ErrorMessage
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_SampleAIM_UPD] @SampleGroupByUpdateID INT , @IsActive BIT = NULL , @CFCUserID INT = NULL
, @SampleID INT = NULL -- from sample table , @AIMMaterialID INT = NULL -- from sample table , @SampleDate DATE = NULL -- from sample table , @EndDate DATE = NULL , @OwnerLocationID INT = NULL -- from sample table
, @AIMNutrientID INT = NULL -- aimSample table
AS

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value:
BEGIN
-- hard-coded parameters for TESTING DECLARE @AimNutrientID INT = 4 DECLARE @AimPriorityUsedValueID INT = 2 DECLARE @DatabaseTypeID INT = 0 DECLARE @ProgressBarID INT = 1064 DECLARE @ProgressBarCFCUserID INT = 0 --------------------------------------------
SET NOCOUNT ON;
DECLARE @ErrorNumber INT = 0 DECLARE @RecordID INT = 0 DECLARE @ErrorMessage VARCHAR(200) = ''
DECLARE @SampleID INT = 0 DECLARE @SampleResultID INT = 0 DECLARE @ResultValue DECIMAL(18,8) DECLARE @UpdateStamp DATETIME DECLARE @CFCUserID INT = 0
DECLARE @HoldSampleID INT = 0 DECLARE @HoldSampleResultID INT = 0 DECLARE @HoldResultValue DECIMAL(18,8) DECLARE @HoldUpdateStamp DATETIME DECLARE @HoldCFCUserID INT = 0
DECLARE @i int DECLARE @count int = 500 DECLARE @msg VarChar(50)
EXEC dbo.usp_ProgressBar_SAV @ProgressBarID, 'PriorityUpdateBegin', @ProgressBarCFCUserID
SET @i = 0; WHILE (@i < @count) BEGIN
DELETE FROM dbo.SampleAIM with (rowlock) WHERE AIMNutrientID = @AimNutrientID
IF @AimPriorityUsedValueID IN (2,3) BEGIN DECLARE TEMPCUR SCROLL CURSOR FOR SELECT SR.SampleID, SR.SampleResultID, SR.ResultValue, SR.UpdateStamp, SR.CFCUserID FROM dbo.SampleResult SR with (nolock) INNER JOIN dbo.AIMNutrientRefAnalyzerNutrient ANRAN with (nolock) on SR.AnalyzerNutrientID = ANRAN.AnalyzerNutrientID WHERE ANRAN.AIMNutrientID = @AimNutrientID --and sr.sampleid in (4184, 4185) ORDER BY SR.SampleID, SR.UpdateStamp OPEN TEMPCUR FETCH NEXT FROM TEMPCUR INTO @SampleID, @SampleResultID, @ResultValue, @UpdateStamp, @CFCUserID WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 Begin ------------------------------------------------------------ If @AimPriorityUsedValueID = 2 Begin If @HoldSampleID <> @SampleID Begin if @i = 10 begin EXEC dbo.usp_ProgressBar_SAV @ProgressBarID, 'Updating2-3', 2 SET @i = 0 end Set @i = @i + 1 ----Set @msg = Convert(VarChar(10), @i) + ' PERCENT COMPLETE' RaisError(@msg, 1, 1) With NoWait
INSERT INTO dbo.SampleAIM (SampleID, SampleResultID, AIMNutrientID, AIMUsedValue, UpdateStamp, CFCUserID) VALUES (@SampleID, @SampleResultID, @AimNutrientID, @ResultValue, @UpdateStamp, @CFCUserID) SET @RecordID = @SampleID SET @HoldSampleID = @SampleID End End ------------------------------------------------------------ If @AimPriorityUsedValueID = 3 Begin If @HoldSampleID <> @SampleID Begin INSERT INTO dbo.SampleAIM (SampleID, SampleResultID, AIMNutrientID, AIMUsedValue, UpdateStamp, CFCUserID) VALUES (@HoldSampleID, @HoldSampleResultID, @AimNutrientID, @HoldResultValue, @HoldUpdateStamp, @HoldCFCUserID) SET @RecordID = @HoldSampleID End SET @HoldSampleID = @SampleID SET @HoldSampleResultID = @SampleResultID SET @HoldResultValue = @ResultValue SET @HoldUpdateStamp = @UpdateStamp SET @HoldCFCUserID = @CFCUserID End
FETCH NEXT FROM TEMPCUR INTO @SampleID, @SampleResultID, @ResultValue, @UpdateStamp, @CFCUserID End CLOSE TEMPCUR DEALLOCATE TempCur SET @i = @count
END
------------------------------------------------------------------------ IF @AimPriorityUsedValueID = 4 BEGIN
DECLARE TEMPCUR SCROLL CURSOR FOR SELECT SR.SampleID, SR.SampleResultID, SR.ResultValue, SR.UpdateStamp, SR.CFCUserID FROM dbo.SampleResult SR with (nolock) INNER JOIN dbo.AIMNutrientRefAnalyzerNutrient ANRAN with (nolock) on SR.AnalyzerNutrientID = ANRAN.AnalyzerNutrientID INNER JOIN dbo.AnalyzerNutrient AN with (nolock) on ANRAN.AnalyzerNutrientID = AN.AnalyzerNutrientID WHERE ANRAN.AIMNutrientID = @AimNutrientID and AN.DataSourceTypeID = @DatabaseTypeID ORDER BY SR.SampleID, SR.UpdateStamp OPEN TEMPCUR FETCH NEXT FROM TEMPCUR INTO @SampleID, @SampleResultID, @ResultValue, @UpdateStamp, @CFCUserID WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 Begin If @HoldSampleID <> @SampleID Begin if @i = 10 begin EXEC dbo.usp_ProgressBar_SAV @ProgressBarID, 'Updating2-3', 2 SET @i = 0 end Set @i = @i + 1 -----Set @msg = Convert(VarChar(10), @i) + ' PERCENT COMPLETE' RaisError(@msg, 1, 1) With NoWait
INSERT INTO dbo.SampleAIM (SampleID, SampleResultID, AIMNutrientID, AIMUsedValue, UpdateStamp, CFCUserID) VALUES (@HoldSampleID, @HoldSampleResultID, @AimNutrientID, @HoldResultValue, @HoldUpdateStamp, @HoldCFCUserID) SET @RecordID = @HoldSampleID End SET @HoldSampleID = @SampleID SET @HoldSampleResultID = @SampleResultID SET @HoldResultValue = @ResultValue SET @HoldUpdateStamp = @UpdateStamp SET @HoldCFCUserID = @CFCUserID
FETCH NEXT FROM TEMPCUR INTO @SampleID, @SampleResultID, @ResultValue, @UpdateStamp, @CFCUserID End
CLOSE TEMPCUR DEALLOCATE TempCur SET @i = @count END END
EXEC dbo.usp_ProgressBar_SAV @ProgressBarID, 'Finished', @ProgressBarCFCUserID
SELECT @@IDENTITY as RecordID , @ErrorNumber AS ErrorNumber , @ErrorMessage AS ErrorMessage END

--exec usp_SampleFurtherAnalysis_SAV 0, 1, 1, '2022-06-22', 1, '2022-06-01'
AS

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value:
BEGIN
--exec usp_SampleFurtherAnalysis_SEL
SELECT SFA.SampleFurtherAnalysisID , SFA.SampleID , SFA.DataSourceTypeID , SFA.AIMMessageID , SFA.ProcessDate , SFA.UpdateStamp , SFA.CFCUserID , S.SampleCode , S.SampleDate , AM.Message , DST.Name as DataSourceTypeName , U.UserName FROM dbo.SampleFurtherAnalysis SFA LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.Sample S ON SFA.SampleID = S.SampleID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMMessage AM ON AM.AIMMessageID = SFA.AIMMessageID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.DataSourceType DST ON SFA.DataSourceTypeID = DST.DataSourceTypeID LEFT OUTER JOIN CFCUser.CFCUser U ON SFA.CFCUserID = U.CFCUserID WHERE SFA.ProcessDate IS NULL
END

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value:
BEGIN
-- 1 = Sample Date -- 2 = Created Date -- 3 = Process Date
--exec usp_SampleFurtherAnalysis_SEL_BeginDate_EndDate_DateField_DateSourceTypeID '20220901', '20220901', 1, 0
DECLARE @SQL VARCHAR(MAX) = ''
SET @SQL = 'SELECT SFA.SampleFurtherAnalysisID , SFA.SampleID , SFA.DataSourceTypeID , SFA.AIMMessageID , SFA.ProcessDate , SFA.UpdateStamp , SFA.CFCUserID , S.SampleCode , S.SampleDate , AM.Message , DST.Name as DataSourceTypeName , U.UserName
FROM dbo.SampleFurtherAnalysis SFA LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.Sample S ON SFA.SampleID = S.SampleID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMMessage AM ON AM.AIMMessageID = SFA.AIMMessageID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.DataSourceType DST ON SFA.DataSourceTypeID = DST.DataSourceTypeID LEFT OUTER JOIN CFCUser.CFCUser U ON SFA.CFCUserID = U.CFCUserID WHERE ' IF @DateField = 1 Begin SET @SQL += ' (S.SampleDate >= ''' + CAST(@BegDate as varchar) + ' 00:00:00.000''' SET @SQL += ' AND S.SampleDate <= ''' + CAST(@EndDate as varchar) + ' 23:59:59.999'')' End IF @DateField = 2 Begin SET @SQL += ' (SFA.UpdateStamp >= ''' + CAST(@BegDate as varchar) + ' 00:00:00.000''' SET @SQL += ' AND SFA.UpdateStamp <= ''' + CAST(@EndDate as varchar) + ' 23:59:59.999'')' End IF @DateField = 3 Begin SET @SQL += ' (SFA.ProcessDate >= ''' + CAST(@BegDate as varchar) + ' 00:00:00.000''' SET @SQL += ' AND SFA.ProcessDate <= ''' + CAST(@EndDate as varchar) + ' 23:59:59.999'')' End
IF @DataSourceTypeID > 0 SET @SQL += ' AND SFA.DataSourceTypeID = ' + CAST(@DataSourceTypeID as varchar)
EXEC (@SQL) --Print @SQL
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_SampleResult_DEL] @SampleResultID INT , @SampleID INT , @AnalyzerNutrientID INT , @CFCUserID INT , @IsActive BIT
AS

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value:
BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON; DECLARE @ErrorNumber INT = 0 DECLARE @ErrorMessage VARCHAR(200) = '' DECLARE @SampleResultID INT = 0 DECLARE @AIMNutrientID INT = 0 DECLARE @SaveUnits NVARCHAR(15) = ' ' DECLARE @Insert_Sw INT = 0
IF @AimDatabaseID = 0 BEGIN SELECT TOP 1 @AimDatabaseID = AimDatabaseID FROM dbo.AIMDatabase WHERE IsActive = 1 END
--Insert AnalyzerNutrient ------------------------------------------ IF @AnalyzerNutrientID = 0 BEGIN SELECT TOP 1 @AnalyzerNutrientID = N.AnalyzerNutrientID FROM dbo.AnalyzerNutrient N WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE N.AnalyzerNutrientCode = @AnalyzerNutrientCode and N.DataSourceTypeID = @DataSourceTypeID
IF @AnalyzerNutrientID = 0 BEGIN
INSERT INTO dbo.AnalyzerNutrient ( AnalyzerNutrientCode , AnalyzerNutrientName , CFCUserID , DataSourceTypeID , UnitType ) VALUES ( @AnalyzerNutrientCode , ISNULL(@AnalyzerNutrientName, @AnalyzerNutrientCode) , @CFCUserID , @DataSourceTypeID , @Unit ) SET @AnalyzerNutrientID = @@IDENTITY END END
-- Romer Results ------------------------------------------------------------------- IF @ImportType = 100 Begin IF EXISTS ( SELECT SR.SampleID FROM dbo.SampleResult SR WHERE SR.SampleID = @SampleID AND SR.AnalyzerNutrientID = @AnalyzerNutrientID AND SR.IsActive = 1 AND SR.SQLResultID = @SQLResultID ) BEGIN UPDATE dbo.SampleResult SET IsActive = 0 , CFCUserID = @CFCUserID , UpdateStamp = GETDATE() WHERE SampleID = @SampleID AND AnalyzerNutrientID = @AnalyzerNutrientID AND IsActive = 1 AND SQLResultID = @SQLResultID
END End
-- Regular Sample Results ---------------------------------------------------------- Else Begin IF EXISTS ( SELECT SR.SampleID FROM dbo.SampleResult SR WHERE SR.SampleID = @SampleID AND SR.AnalyzerNutrientID = @AnalyzerNutrientID AND SR.IsActive = 1 ) BEGIN UPDATE dbo.SampleResult SET IsActive = 0 , CFCUserID = @CFCUserID , UpdateStamp = GETDATE() WHERE SampleID = @SampleID AND AnalyzerNutrientID = @AnalyzerNutrientID AND IsActive = 1
END
End
--Insert Sample Result ------------------------------------------------------------- BEGIN IF Len(IsNull(@Unit,'')) > 0 SET @SaveUnits = IsNull(@Unit,'') -- 'Unit' gets populated in the import ELSE SET @SaveUnits = IsNull(@UnitType, '') -- 'UnitType' gets populated when manually entering result END INSERT dbo.SampleResult WITH(ROWLOCK) ( SampleID , AnalyzerNutrientID , AnalyzerNutrientCode , ResultValue , AnalysisDate , UpdateStamp , IsActive , CFCUserID , Unit , InstrumentID , SQLResultID
) VALUES ( @SampleID , @AnalyzerNutrientID , @AnalyzerNutrientCode , @ResultValue , @AnalysisDate , GETDATE() , 1 , @CFCUserID , @SaveUnits , @InstrumentID , @SQLResultID ) SET @SampleResultID = @@IDENTITY
--Insert Sample AIM ----------------------------------------------------------------
SELECT TOP 1 @AIMNutrientID = AIMNutrientID FROM dbo.AIMNutrientRefAnalyzerNutrient ANRAN WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ANRAN.AnalyzerNutrientID = @AnalyzerNutrientID
--IF ISNULL(@AIMNutrientID, 0) > 0 and dbo.CheckPriority(@Sampleid, @AimNutrientID, @DataSourceTypeID, @AimDatabaseID) = 1 IF ISNULL(@AIMNutrientID, 0) > 0 and dbo.CheckPriority(@Sampleid, @AimNutrientID, @DataSourceTypeID, @AimDatabaseID, @AnalyzerNutrientID) = 1
BEGIN
DELETE dbo.SampleAIM WHERE SampleID = @SampleID AND AIMNutrientID = @AIMNutrientID
INSERT INTO dbo.SampleAIM ( SampleID , SampleResultID , AIMNutrientID , AIMUsedValue , UpdateStamp , CFCUserID ) VALUES ( @SampleID , @SampleResultID , @AIMNutrientID , @ResultValue , GETDATE() , @CFCUserID ) END
--Insert SampleResultPredict ------------------------------------------------------- IF @IsResultPredict = 1 BEGIN EXEC dbo.usp_SampleResultPredict_INS @SampleResultID , @IsInPredictionRange , @GlobalH , @Limit , @IsInMaterialRange , @MaxMaterialRange , @MinMaterialRange END
-- 6/25/19 - added because of memory issues at Smithfield IF @ReturnMessage = 1 BEGIN
SELECT @SampleResultID AS RecordID , @ErrorNumber AS ErrorNumber , @ErrorMessage AS ErrorMessage END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_SampleResult_INS] @SampleID INT , @AnalyzerNutrientID INT , @AnalyzerNutrientCode NVARCHAR(100) --10/30/18 changed from (30) to (100) , @ResultValue NUMERIC(18,8) , @AnalysisDate DATETIME , @IsActive BIT , @CFCUserID INT , @Unit NVARCHAR = NULL , @IsResultPredict BIT = NULL , @IsInPredictionRange BIT = NULL , @GlobalH NUMERIC(18,8) = NULL , @Limit NUMERIC(18,8) = NULL , @IsInMaterialRange BIT = NULL , @MaxMaterialRange NUMERIC(18,8) = NULL , @MinMaterialRange NUMERIC(18,8) = NULL , @UnitType NVARCHAR(15) = NULL , @DataSourceTypeID INT = NULL , @AimDatabaseID INT = NULL , @InstrumentID INT = NULL , @AnalyzerNutrientName NVARCHAR(100) = NULL --10/30/18 changed from (50) to (100) , @SQLResultID VARCHAR(300) = NULL , @ReturnMessage BIT -- 6/25/19 - added because of memory issues at Smithfield , @ImportType INT = NULL -- 8/17/22 - added for Romer results
--EXEC usp_SampleResult_INS @SampleID=35346, @AnalyzerNutrientID=81, @AnalyzerNutrientCode='Moisture', @ResultValue=99.99, @AnalysisDate='2023-03-31', @IsActive=1, @CFCUserID=0, @DataSourceTypeID=10003, @AimDatabaseID=1, @ReturnMessage=0
AS

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value:
BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
DECLARE @SampleQualityEquationID INT DECLARE @SampleQualityEquationName NVARCHAR(50) DECLARE @AnalyzerNutrientID INT DECLARE @DataSourceTypeID INT DECLARE @ValueString VARCHAR(50) DECLARE @AnalyzerNutrientCode NVARCHAR(100) DECLARE @SampleQualityParameterID INT DECLARE @ResultValueNumeric NUMERIC(16,4) DECLARE @Result NUMERIC(16,4) DECLARE @IsDiv BIT = 0 DECLARE @Formula NVARCHAR(2000) = '' DECLARE @LastSampleQualityEquationID INT = 0 DECLARE @SQL NVARCHAR(3000) = '' DECLARE @IsActive BIT = 1 DECLARE @AnalysisDate DATETIME = GETDATE() DECLARE @PrevAnalyzerNutrientID INT = 0 DECLARE @ErrorMessage VARCHAR(200) = '' DECLARE @ResultID INT = 0 DECLARE @ErrorCount INT = 0
DECLARE @SampleQualityEquationBuildID INT
IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM tempdb.sys.tables WHERE [name] like '#Equation%') DROP TABLE #Equation
SELECT SQE.SampleQualityEquationID , SQE.SampleQualityEquationName , SQE.AnalyzerNutrientID , SQE.DataSourceTypeID , SQEB.ValueString , SQEB.SampleQualityParameterID , SQ.ResultValueNumeric , SQEB.SampleQualityEquationBuildID
INTO #Equation
FROM dbo.SampleQualityEquation SQE INNER JOIN dbo.SampleQualityEquationBuild SQEB ON SQEB.SampleQualityEquationID = SQE.SampleQualityEquationID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.SampleQuality SQ ON SQEB.SampleQualityParameterID = SQ.SampleQualityParameterID AND SQ.SampleID = @SampleID AND SQ.IsActive = 1 WHERE SQEB.Status = 1 ORDER BY SQEB.SampleQualityEquationID , SQEB.SampleQualityEquationBuildID
SELECT TOP 1 @SampleQualityEquationID = SampleQualityEquationID , @SampleQualityEquationName = SampleQualityEquationName , @AnalyzerNutrientID = AnalyzerNutrientID , @DataSourceTypeID = DataSourceTypeID , @ValueString = ValueString , @SampleQualityParameterID = SampleQualityParameterID , @ResultValueNumeric = ResultValueNumeric , @SampleQualityEquationBuildID = SampleQualityEquationBuildID FROM #Equation ORDER BY SampleQualityEquationID , SampleQualityEquationBuildID
WHILE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #Equation) > 0
BEGIN
IF @PrevAnalyzerNutrientID = 0 BEGIN SET @PrevAnalyzerNutrientID = @AnalyzerNutrientID END
IF @LastSampleQualityEquationID != @SampleQualityEquationID BEGIN SET @LastSampleQualityEquationID = @SampleQualityEquationID
IF @Formula != '' BEGIN
SET @SQL = N'SET @Result = ' + @Formula EXEC sp_executesql @sql, N'@result NUMERIC(16,4) output', @result = @result OUTPUT
IF @Result IS NOT NULL BEGIN SET @AnalyzerNutrientCode = LEFT(@SampleQualityEquationName, 30)
-- 6/25/19 - added ReturnMessage parameter because of memory issues at Smithfield --EXEC usp_SampleResult_INS @SampleID=@SampleID, @AnalyzerNutrientID=@PrevAnalyzerNutrientID, @AnalyzerNutrientCode=@AnalyzerNutrientCode, @ResultValue=@Result, @AnalysisDate=@AnalysisDate, @IsActive=@IsActive, @CFCUserID=@CFCUserID, @DataSourceTypeID=@DataSourceTypeID, @AimDatabaseID=@AimDatabaseID EXEC usp_SampleResult_INS @SampleID=@SampleID, @AnalyzerNutrientID=@PrevAnalyzerNutrientID, @AnalyzerNutrientCode=@AnalyzerNutrientCode, @ResultValue=@Result, @AnalysisDate=@AnalysisDate, @IsActive=@IsActive, @CFCUserID=@CFCUserID, @DataSourceTypeID=@DataSourceTypeID, @AimDatabaseID=@AimDatabaseID, @ReturnMessage=0
SET @PrevAnalyzerNutrientID = @AnalyzerNutrientID IF @@Error > 0 SET @ErrorCount = @ErrorCount + 1 END
END
SET @PrevAnalyzerNutrientID = @AnalyzerNutrientID SET @Formula = '' END
IF @SampleQualityParameterID = 0 BEGIN
IF @ValueString = '/' BEGIN SET @IsDiv = 1 END ELSE BEGIN SET @IsDiv = 0 END SET @Formula = @Formula + ' ' + @ValueString + ' '
END ELSE BEGIN
IF @IsDiv = 1 BEGIN SET @Formula = @Formula + N' NULLIF(' + CAST(@ResultValueNumeric AS VARCHAR) + ',0)' END ELSE BEGIN SET @Formula = @Formula + CAST(@ResultValueNumeric AS VARCHAR) END SET @IsDiv = 0
END
DELETE #Equation WHERE SampleQualityEquationID = @SampleQualityEquationID and SampleQualityEquationBuildID = @SampleQualityEquationBuildID
SELECT TOP 1 @SampleQualityEquationID = SampleQualityEquationID , @SampleQualityEquationName = SampleQualityEquationName , @AnalyzerNutrientID = AnalyzerNutrientID , @DataSourceTypeID = DataSourceTypeID , @ValueString = ValueString , @SampleQualityParameterID = SampleQualityParameterID , @ResultValueNumeric = ResultValueNumeric , @SampleQualityEquationBuildID = SampleQualityEquationBuildID
FROM #Equation ORDER BY SampleQualityEquationID , SampleQualityEquationBuildID
END
IF @PrevAnalyzerNutrientID > 0 BEGIN
SET @LastSampleQualityEquationID = @SampleQualityEquationID IF @Formula != '' BEGIN
SET @SQL = N'SET @Result = ' + @Formula EXEC sp_executesql @sql, N'@result NUMERIC(16,4) output', @result = @result OUTPUT IF @Result IS NOT NULL BEGIN SET @AnalyzerNutrientCode = LEFT(@SampleQualityEquationName, 30)
-- 6/25/19 - added ReturnMessage parameter because of memory issues at Smithfield --EXEC usp_SampleResult_INS @SampleID=@SampleID, @AnalyzerNutrientID=@AnalyzerNutrientID, @AnalyzerNutrientCode=@AnalyzerNutrientCode, @ResultValue=@Result, @AnalysisDate=@AnalysisDate, @IsActive=@IsActive, @CFCUserID=@CFCUserID, @DataSourceTypeID=@DataSourceTypeID, @AimDatabaseID=@AimDatabaseID EXEC usp_SampleResult_INS @SampleID=@SampleID, @AnalyzerNutrientID=@AnalyzerNutrientID, @AnalyzerNutrientCode=@AnalyzerNutrientCode, @ResultValue=@Result, @AnalysisDate=@AnalysisDate, @IsActive=@IsActive, @CFCUserID=@CFCUserID, @DataSourceTypeID=@DataSourceTypeID, @AimDatabaseID=@AimDatabaseID, @ReturnMessage=0
IF @@Error > 0 SET @ErrorCount = @ErrorCount + 1 END END END
IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM tempdb.sys.tables WHERE [name] like '#Equation%') DROP TABLE #Equation
IF @ErrorCount > 0 SET @ErrorMessage = 'Error Applying Quality Control Equation to Results.'
-- 6/25/19 - added because of memory issues at Smithfield IF @ReturnMessage = 1 BEGIN
SELECT @ResultID AS RecordID , @ErrorCount AS ErrorNumber , @ErrorMessage AS ErrorMessage END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_SampleResult_INS_SampleQualityEquation] @SampleID INT , @CFCUserID INT , @AimDatabaseID INT
-- 6/25/19 - added because of memory issues at Smithfield , @ReturnMessage BIT
AS

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value:
BEGIN SET NOCOUNT OFF;
DECLARE @SampleID INT DECLARE @ErrorMessage VARCHAR(200) = '' DECLARE @ResultID INT = 0 DECLARE @ErrorCount INT = 0 DECLARE @TotalCnt AS INT = 0 DECLARE @Cnt AS INT = 0 DECLARE @Str AS VARCHAR(100) = '' DECLARE @Increment AS NUMERIC(18,4) = 1 DECLARE @Loop AS INT = 0
IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM tempdb.sys.tables WHERE [name] like '##List%') DROP TABLE ##List
----Get increment for progress bar SET @TotalCnt = (SELECT Count(*) FROM ( SELECT SQ.SampleID FROM dbo.SampleQuality SQ WITH(NOLOCK)
-- 11/4/22 - join sample table to get sample date INNER JOIN dbo.Sample S ON S.SampleID = SQ.SampleID
WHERE SQ.IsActive = 1
--11/4/22 AND S.SampleDate >= @RebuildDate
GROUP BY SQ.SampleID) T) IF @TotalCnt <> 0 SET @Increment = 95 / Cast(@TotalCnt as Numeric)
-- 6/25/19 - added ReturnMessage parameter because of memory issues at Smithfield --EXEC dbo.usp_ProgressBar_SAV_Increment @ProgressBarID, 'Rerun Start', @CFCUserID, 0 EXEC dbo.usp_ProgressBar_SAV_Increment @ProgressBarID, 'Rerun Start', @CFCUserID, 0, 0, 0
SELECT SQ.SampleID
-- 11/4/22 , S.SampleDate
INTO ##List FROM dbo.SampleQuality SQ
-- 11/4/22 - join sample table to get sample date INNER JOIN dbo.Sample S ON S.SampleID = SQ.SampleID
WHERE SQ.IsActive = 1 AND SQ.SampleID > 0
--11/4/22 AND S.SampleDate >= @RebuildDate
GROUP BY SQ.SampleID
--11/4/22 , S.SampleDate
order by sq.SampleID
SELECT TOP 1 @SampleID = SampleID FROM ##List WHILE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ##List) > 0 BEGIN SET @Loop = @Loop + 1
-- 6/25/19 - added ReturnMessage parameter because of memory issues at Smithfield --EXEC dbo.usp_SampleResult_INS_SampleQualityEquation @SampleID, @CFCUserID, @AIMDatabaseID EXEC dbo.usp_SampleResult_INS_SampleQualityEquation @SampleID, @CFCUserID, @AIMDatabaseID, 0
IF @@Error > 0 SET @ErrorCount = @ErrorCount + 1
----Update progress bar SET @Cnt = @Cnt + 1 SET @Str = 'Rerun Sample Quality Equation ' + convert(varchar,@Cnt) + ' of ' + convert(varchar,@TotalCnt)
--6/25/19 --SET @Increment = @Cnt * 100 / Cast(@TotalCnt as Numeric) SET @Increment = @Cnt / Cast(@TotalCnt as Numeric)
-- 6/25/19 - added because of memory issues at Smithfield IF @Loop > 20
BEGIN -- 6/25/19 - added ReturnMessage parameter because of memory issues at Smithfield --EXEC dbo.usp_ProgressBar_SAV_Increment @ProgressBarID, @Str, @CFCUserID, @Increment EXEC dbo.usp_ProgressBar_SAV_Increment @ProgressBarID, @Str, @CFCUserID, @Increment, 0, 0
SET @Loop = 0 END
DELETE ##List WHERE SampleID = @SampleID
SELECT TOP 1 @SampleID = SampleID FROM ##List
END
IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM tempdb.sys.tables WHERE [name] like '##List%') DROP TABLE ##List
-- 6/25/19 - added ReturnMessage parameter because of memory issues at Smithfield --EXEC dbo.usp_ProgressBar_SAV_Increment @ProgressBarID, 'Quality Equation Section Complete', @CFCUserID, 0 EXEC dbo.usp_ProgressBar_SAV_Increment @ProgressBarID, 'Quality Equation Section Complete', @CFCUserID, 0, 0, 0
IF @ErrorCount > 0 SET @ErrorMessage = 'Error Rebuilding and Applying Quality Control Equations to Results.'
SELECT @ResultID AS RecordID , @ErrorCount AS ErrorNumber , @ErrorMessage AS ErrorMessage
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_SampleResult_SEL_MessageOutside_SampleID_SampleResultPredictID] @SampleID INT , @SampleResultPredictID INT , @SampleResultMessageType INT
AS

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value:
BEGIN
-- Type: -- 1 = total count of messages -- 2 = count grouped by SampleResultPredictID (for Warning grid) -- 3 = detail of messages (for Message-Detail grid) -- 4 = count grouped by AnalyzerNutrientID (for Result grid)
-- exec [usp_SampleResult_SEL_Messages_Inside] 3, 4183, NULL, NULL, 1
SET NOCOUNT ON; DECLARE @SQL VARCHAR(5000) DECLARE @Where VARCHAR(500) DECLARE @From VARCHAR(2000) DECLARE @Select VARCHAR(5000)
-- Where ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Set @Where = '' If @SampleID IS NOT NULL Set @Where += ' SR.SampleID = ' + Cast(@SampleID as varchar) IF @StartDate IS NOT NULL Begin IF LEN(@Where) > 0 Begin Set @Where += ' and ' End Set @Where += ' SR.UpdateStamp >= ''' + Convert(varchar,@StartDate,112) + ' 00:00:00.000'' ' End IF @EndDate IS NOT NULL Begin IF LEN(@Where) > 0 Begin Set @Where += ' and ' End Set @Where += ' SR.UpdateStamp <= ''' + Convert(varchar,@EndDate,112) + ' 23:59:59.999'' ' End IF LEN(@Where) > 0 Set @Where = ' WHERE ' + @Where
-- From -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Set @From = ' FROM dbo.Sample S with (nolock) INNER JOIN dbo.SampleResult SR with (nolock) ON SR.SampleID = S.SampleID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.SampleResultPredict SRP with (nolock) ON SRP.SampleResultID = SR.SampleResultID INNER JOIN dbo.AnalyzerNutrient AN with (nolock) ON AN.AnalyzerNutrientID = SR.AnalyzerNutrientID ' IF @IsActive IS NOT NULL Set @From += ' AND SR.IsActive = ' + Convert(varchar, @IsActive) + ''
Set @From += ' LEFT JOIN dbo.AIMNutrientRefAnalyzerNutrient ANRAN with (nolock) ON SR.AnalyzerNutrientID = ANRAN.AnalyzerNutrientID LEFT JOIN dbo.WarningLimits WL with (nolock) ON S.AimMaterialID = WL.AimMaterialID AND ANRAN.AimNutrientID = WL.AimNutrientID '
-- Select ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ SET @Select = 'SELECT SampleResultPredictID, AN.AnalyzerNutrientID, ''MinMax Warning'' as Message, 1 as Counter ' + @From + @Where + ' AND (ResultValue < WL.Min OR ResultValue > WL.Max) '
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Type: -- 1 = total count of messages -- 2 = count grouped by SampleResultPredictID (for Warning grid) -- 3 = detail of messages (for Message-Detail grid) -- 4 = count grouped by AnalyzerNutrientID (for Result grid)
IF @Type = 1 SET @SQL = 'SELECT Count(*) as Message FROM (' + @Select + ') X '
ELSE IF @Type = 2 SET @SQL = 'SELECT SampleResultPredictID, Sum(Counter) as Message FROM (' + @Select + ' UNION SELECT SampleResultPredictID, AN.AnalyzerNutrientID, '''' as Message, 0 as Counter ' + @From + @Where + ' AND (WL.WarningLimitsID IS NULL) ) X GROUP BY X.SampleResultPredictID '
ELSE IF @Type = 3 SET @SQL = @Select + ' UNION SELECT SampleResultPredictID, AN.AnalyzerNutrientID, '''' as Message, 0 as Counter ' + @From + @Where + ' AND (WL.WarningLimitsID IS NULL) '
ELSE IF @Type = 4 SET @SQL = 'SELECT AnalyzerNutrientID, Sum(Counter) as Message FROM (' + @Select + ' UNION SELECT SampleResultPredictID, AN.AnalyzerNutrientID, '''' as Message, 0 as Counter ' + @From + @Where + ' AND WL.WarningLimitsID IS NULL ) X GROUP BY X.AnalyzerNutrientID '
--PRINT @sql EXEC (@SQL)
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_SampleResult_SEL_Messages_Inside] @Type INT , @SampleID INT = NULL , @StartDate DATE = NULL , @EndDate DATE = NULL , @IsActive BIT = NULL
AS

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value:
BEGIN
-- Type: -- 1 = total count of messages -- 2 = count grouped by SampleResultPredictID (for Warning grid) -- 3 = detail of messages (for Message-Detail grid) -- 4 = count grouped by AnalyzerNutrientID (for Result grid)
-- exec usp_SampleResult_SEL_Messages_Outside 1, 5575, NULL, NULL, TRUE
SET NOCOUNT ON; DECLARE @SQL VARCHAR(5000) DECLARE @Where VARCHAR(500) DECLARE @From VARCHAR(2000) DECLARE @Select VARCHAR(5000)
-- Where ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Set @Where = '' If @SampleID IS NOT NULL Set @Where += ' SR.SampleID = ' + Cast(@SampleID as varchar) IF @StartDate IS NOT NULL Begin IF LEN(@Where) > 0 Begin Set @Where += ' and ' End Set @Where += ' SR.UpdateStamp >= ''' + Convert(varchar,@StartDate,112) + ' 00:00:00.000'' ' End IF @EndDate IS NOT NULL Begin IF LEN(@Where) > 0 Begin Set @Where += ' and ' End Set @Where += ' SR.UpdateStamp <= ''' + Convert(varchar,@EndDate,112) + ' 23:59:59.999'' ' End IF LEN(@Where) > 0 Set @Where = ' WHERE ' + @Where
-- From -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Set @From = ' FROM dbo.Sample S with (nolock) INNER JOIN dbo.SampleResult SR with (nolock) ON SR.SampleID = S.SampleID ' IF @IsActive IS NOT NULL Set @From += ' AND SR.IsActive = ' + Convert(varchar, @IsActive) + ''
Set @From += 'INNER JOIN dbo.SampleResultPredict SRP with (nolock) ON SRP.SampleResultID = SR.SampleResultID INNER JOIN dbo.AnalyzerNutrient AN with (nolock) ON AN.AnalyzerNutrientID = SR.AnalyzerNutrientID AND AN.IsActive = 1 '
-- Select ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ SET @Select = 'SELECT SampleResultPredictID, AN.AnalyzerNutrientID, ''Result Value < Minimum'' as Message, 1 as Counter ' + @From + @Where + ' AND (ResultValue < MinMaterialRange AND MinMaterialRange <> 0) UNION SELECT SampleResultPredictID, AN.AnalyzerNutrientID, ''Result Value > Maximum'' as Message, 1 as Counter ' + @From + @Where + ' AND (ResultValue > MaxMaterialRange AND MaxMaterialRange <> 0) UNION SELECT SampleResultPredictID, AN.AnalyzerNutrientID, ''GlobalH > Limit'' as Message, 1 as Counter ' + @From + @Where + ' AND GlobalH > Limit '
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Type: -- 1 = total count of messages -- 2 = count grouped by SampleResultPredictID (for Warning grid) -- 3 = detail of messages (for Message-Detail grid) -- 4 = count grouped by AnalyzerNutrientID (for Result grid)
IF @Type = 1 SET @SQL = 'SELECT Count(*) as Message FROM (' + @Select + ') X '
ELSE IF @Type = 2 SET @SQL = 'SELECT SampleResultPredictID, Sum(Counter) as Message FROM (' + @Select + ' UNION SELECT SampleResultPredictID, AN.AnalyzerNutrientID, '''' as Message, 0 as Counter ' + @From + @Where + ' AND (ResultValue >= MinMaterialRange AND MinMaterialRange <> 0) AND (ResultValue <= MaxMaterialRange AND MaxMaterialRange <> 0) AND (GlobalH <= Limit) ) X GROUP BY X.SampleResultPredictID ' ELSE IF @Type = 3 Begin SET @SQL = @Select SET @SQL += ' UNION SELECT SampleResultPredictID, AN.AnalyzerNutrientID, '''' as Message, 0 as Counter ' + @From + @Where + ' AND (ResultValue >= MinMaterialRange AND MinMaterialRange <> 0) AND (ResultValue <= MaxMaterialRange AND MaxMaterialRange <> 0) AND (GlobalH <= Limit) ' End ELSE IF @Type = 4 SET @SQL = 'SELECT AnalyzerNutrientID, Sum(Counter) as Message FROM (' + @Select + ' UNION SELECT SampleResultPredictID, AN.AnalyzerNutrientID, '''' as Message, 0 as Counter ' + @From + @Where + ' AND (ResultValue >= MinMaterialRange AND MinMaterialRange <> 0) AND (ResultValue <= MaxMaterialRange AND MaxMaterialRange <> 0) AND (GlobalH <= Limit) UNION SELECT 0, AN.AnalyzerNutrientID, '''' as Message, 0 as Counter FROM dbo.SampleResult SR WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN dbo.SampleResultPredict SRP WITH (NOLOCK) ON SRP.SampleResultID = SR.SampleResultID INNER JOIN dbo.AnalyzerNutrient AN WITH(NOLOCK) ON AN.AnalyzerNutrientID = SR.AnalyzerNutrientID AND AN.IsActive = 1 ' + @Where + ' AND SRP.SampleResultID IS NULL
) X GROUP BY X.AnalyzerNutrientID '
--PRINT @sql EXEC (@SQL)
END

BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON; DECLARE @ErrorNumber INT = 0 DECLARE @RecordID INT = 0 DECLARE @ErrorMessage VARCHAR(200) = '';
WITH MaxIterations AS ( SELECT SampleResultTemplateID ,CAST(ROUND(EXP(SUM(LOG(TestFrequency))),0) AS INT) AS MaxIteration FROM dbo.SampleResultTemplateDetailGroup STG WHERE SampleResultTemplateID = @SampleResultTemplateID AND STG.IsDateFrequency = 0 GROUP BY SampleResultTemplateID )
UPDATE ST SET ST.CurrentIteration = CASE WHEN CurrentIteration >= M.MaxIteration THEN 1 ELSE CurrentIteration + 1 END FROM dbo.SampleResultTemplate ST INNER JOIN MaxIterations M ON M.SampleResultTemplateID = M.SampleResultTemplateID WHERE ST.SampleResultTemplateID = @SampleResultTemplateID
UPDATE STG SET STG.StartDate = GETDATE() FROM dbo.SampleResultTemplate ST inner join dbo.SampleResultTemplateDetailGroup STG ON STG.SampleResultTemplateID = ST.SampleResultTemplateID WHERE STG.IsDateFrequency = 1 AND ST.SampleResultTemplateID = @SampleResultTemplateID AND GETDATE() > DATEADD(day, STG.TestFrequency, StartDate)
SELECT @RecordID as RecordID , @ErrorNumber AS ErrorNumber , @ErrorMessage AS ErrorMessage
END

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value:
BEGIN
--DECLARE @SampleResultTemplateID INT = 106 -- , @SampleID INT = 5259 -- , @AIMMaterialID INT = 130
--exec usp_SampleResultTemplateDetail_SEL_SampleResultTemplateID_SampleID_DataSourceTypeID 0,0,0
DECLARE @IsPrioritizeGroupTemplate BIT = 0
SET NOCOUNT ON;
CREATE TABLE #Outside ( AnalyzerNutrientID Int, Message Int ) INSERT INTO #Outside EXEC usp_SampleResult_SEL_Messages_Outside 4, @SampleID, NULL, NULL, 1
CREATE TABLE #Inside ( AnalyzerNutrientID Int, Message Int ) INSERT INTO #Inside EXEC usp_SampleResult_SEL_Messages_Inside 4, @SampleID, NULL, NULL, 1
-- SELECT @IsPrioritizeGroupTemplate = IsGroupTemplate FROM SampleResultTemplate WHERE SampleResultTemplateID = @SampleResultTemplateID
IF @IsPrioritizeGroupTemplate = 0 BEGIN SELECT SRTD.* , AN.AnalyzerNutrientCode , AN.AnalyzerNutrientName , AN.AnalyzerNutrientID , AN.UnitType , AIMN.AIMNutrientName , SR.ResultValue AS CurrentValue -- 1/11/21 - changed to remove aspnet_User table (and use CFCUser instead) --, AU.UserName , U.UserName , WL.Min , WL.Max FROM dbo.SampleResultTemplateDetail SRTD with (nolock) INNER JOIN SampleResultTemplate ST ON ST.SampleResultTemplateID = SRTD.SampleResultTemplateID INNER JOIN dbo.AnalyzerNutrient AN with (nolock) ON SRTD.AnalyzerNutrientID = AN.AnalyzerNutrientID LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT AN.AnalyzerNutrientID , IsNull(ResultValue,0) as ResultValue , AN.DataSourceTypeID FROM dbo.SampleResult SR INNER JOIN dbo.AnalyzerNutrient AN WITH(NOLOCK) ON AN.AnalyzerNutrientID = SR.AnalyzerNutrientID AND SR.SampleID = @SampleID AND AN.IsActive = 1 AND SR.IsActive = 1 ) SR ON SR.AnalyzerNutrientID = AN.AnalyzerNutrientID AND SR.DataSourceTypeID = ST.DataSourceTypeID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMNutrientRefAnalyzerNutrient ANX with (nolock) ON AN.AnalyzerNutrientID = ANX.AnalyzerNutrientID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AIMNutrient AIMN with (nolock) ON ANX.AIMNutrientID = AIMN.AIMNutrientID LEFT OUTER JOIN CFCUser.CFCUser U WITH(NOLOCK) ON SRTD.CFCUserID = U.CFCUserID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.WarningLimits WL ON WL.AIMNutrientID = ANX.AIMNutrientID AND WL.AIMMaterialID = @AIMMaterialID -- 1/11/21 - changed to remove aspnet_User table (and use CFCUser instead) --LEFT OUTER JOIN -- dbo.aspnet_Users AU WITH(NOLOCK) -- ON AU.UserId = U.UserID
WHERE SRTD.SampleResultTemplateID = @SampleResultTemplateID
ORDER BY SRTD.SortOrder END IF @IsPrioritizeGroupTemplate = 1 BEGIN IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#GridResultIsDateFalse') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #GridResultIsDateFalse
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#GridResultIsDateTrue') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #GridResultIsDateTrue SELECT STG.* , ANX.AnalyzerNutrientCode , ANX.AnalyzerNutrientName , ANX.AnalyzerNutrientID , ANX.UnitType , AIMN.AIMNutrientName , SR.ResultValue AS CurrentValue , U.UserName , SortOrder , NGD.NutrientGroupDetailID , WL.Min , WL.Max INTO #GridResultIsDateFalse FROM SampleResultTemplateDetailGroup STG INNER JOIN NutrientGroup NG ON NG.NutrientGroupID = STG.NutrientGroupID INNER JOIN NutrientGroupDetail NGD ON NG.NutrientGroupID = NGD.NutrientGroupID INNER JOIN SampleResultTemplate ST ON ST.SampleResultTemplateID = STG.SampleResultTemplateID INNER JOIN dbo.AIMNutrient AIMN ON NGD.AIMNutrientID = AIMN.AIMNutrientID LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT ANX.AnalyzerNutrientID ,ANX.AIMNutrientID ,AN.AnalyzerNutrientCode ,AN.AnalyzerNutrientName ,AN.UnitType ,AN.DataSourceTypeID FROM dbo.AIMNutrientRefAnalyzerNutrient ANX INNER JOIN dbo.AnalyzerNutrient AN ON ANX.AnalyzerNutrientID = AN.AnalyzerNutrientID ) ANX ON ANX.AIMNutrientID = NGD.AIMNutrientID AND ANX.DataSourceTypeID = ST.DataSourceTypeID LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT AN.AnalyzerNutrientID , IsNull(ResultValue,0) as ResultValue , AN.DataSourceTypeID FROM dbo.SampleResult SR INNER JOIN dbo.AnalyzerNutrient AN ON AN.AnalyzerNutrientID = SR.AnalyzerNutrientID AND SR.SampleID = @SampleID AND AN.IsActive = 1 AND SR.IsActive = 1 ) SR ON SR.AnalyzerNutrientID = ANX.AnalyzerNutrientID AND SR.DataSourceTypeID = ST.DataSourceTypeID LEFT OUTER JOIN CFCUser.CFCUser U ON STG.CFCUserID = U.CFCUserID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.WarningLimits WL ON WL.AIMNutrientID = ANX.AIMNutrientID AND WL.AIMMaterialID = @AIMMaterialID WHERE STG.SampleResultTemplateID = @SampleResultTemplateID AND ST.CurrentIteration % STG.TestFrequency = 0 AND STG.IsDateFrequency = 0 ORDER BY CASE WHEN SortOrder = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, SortOrder , NGD.NutrientGroupDetailID
SELECT STG.* , ANX.AnalyzerNutrientCode , ANX.AnalyzerNutrientName , ANX.AnalyzerNutrientID , ANX.UnitType , AIMN.AIMNutrientName , SR.ResultValue AS CurrentValue , U.UserName , SortOrder , NGD.NutrientGroupDetailID , WL.Min , WL.Max INTO #GridResultIsDateTrue FROM SampleResultTemplateDetailGroup STG INNER JOIN NutrientGroup NG ON NG.NutrientGroupID = STG.NutrientGroupID INNER JOIN NutrientGroupDetail NGD ON NG.NutrientGroupID = NGD.NutrientGroupID INNER JOIN SampleResultTemplate ST ON ST.SampleResultTemplateID = STG.SampleResultTemplateID INNER JOIN dbo.AIMNutrient AIMN ON NGD.AIMNutrientID = AIMN.AIMNutrientID LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT ANX.AnalyzerNutrientID ,ANX.AIMNutrientID ,AN.AnalyzerNutrientCode ,AN.AnalyzerNutrientName ,AN.UnitType ,AN.DataSourceTypeID FROM dbo.AIMNutrientRefAnalyzerNutrient ANX INNER JOIN dbo.AnalyzerNutrient AN ON ANX.AnalyzerNutrientID = AN.AnalyzerNutrientID ) ANX ON ANX.AIMNutrientID = NGD.AIMNutrientID AND ANX.DataSourceTypeID = ST.DataSourceTypeID LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT AN.AnalyzerNutrientID , IsNull(ResultValue,0) as ResultValue , AN.DataSourceTypeID FROM dbo.SampleResult SR INNER JOIN dbo.AnalyzerNutrient AN ON AN.AnalyzerNutrientID = SR.AnalyzerNutrientID AND SR.SampleID = @SampleID AND AN.IsActive = 1 AND SR.IsActive = 1 ) SR ON SR.AnalyzerNutrientID = ANX.AnalyzerNutrientID AND SR.DataSourceTypeID = ST.DataSourceTypeID LEFT OUTER JOIN CFCUser.CFCUser U ON STG.CFCUserID = U.CFCUserID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.WarningLimits WL ON WL.AIMNutrientID = ANX.AIMNutrientID AND WL.AIMMaterialID = @AIMMaterialID WHERE STG.SampleResultTemplateID = @SampleResultTemplateID AND GETDATE() >= DATEADD(DAY, STG.TestFrequency, StartDate) AND STG.IsDateFrequency = 1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN SortOrder = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, SortOrder , NGD.NutrientGroupDetailID
SELECT GridBoth.* , #Outside.Message as MessageOutside , #Inside.Message as MessageInside , ISNULL(CASE WHEN CurrentValue < Min THEN 1 ELSE CASE WHEN CurrentValue > Max THEN 2 ELSE 0 END END, 0) AS ResultValueFlag FROM ( SELECT SampleResultTemplateDetailGroupID , SampleResultTemplateID , NutrientGroupID , TestFrequency , IsDateFrequency , UpdateStamp , CFCUserID , AnalyzerNutrientCode , AnalyzerNutrientName , AnalyzerNutrientID , UnitType , AIMNutrientName , CurrentValue , UserName , SortOrder , NutrientGroupDetailID , Min , Max FROM #GridResultIsDateFalse UNION ALL SELECT SampleResultTemplateDetailGroupID , SampleResultTemplateID , NutrientGroupID , TestFrequency , IsDateFrequency , UpdateStamp , CFCUserID , AnalyzerNutrientCode , AnalyzerNutrientName , AnalyzerNutrientID , UnitType , AIMNutrientName , CurrentValue , UserName , SortOrder , NutrientGroupDetailID , Min , Max FROM #GridResultIsDateTrue ) AS GridBoth
LEFT OUTER JOIN #Outside ON GridBoth.AnalyzerNutrientID = #Outside.AnalyzerNutrientID LEFT OUTER JOIN #Inside ON GridBoth.AnalyzerNutrientID = #Inside.AnalyzerNutrientID ORDER BY CASE WHEN GridBoth.SortOrder = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, GridBoth.SortOrder , GridBoth.NutrientGroupDetailID END END

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value:
DECLARE @id int = 0 DECLARE @InitialCount int = 0 DECLARE @RecordCount int = 0 DECLARE @SQL varchar(1000) = '' DECLARE @Name nvarchar(128) = '' DECLARE @KeyName nvarchar(100) = '' DECLARE @IDCol smallint = 0
DECLARE @InitialDbase nvarchar(50) = 'CFCAIMInitial' DECLARE @DevelopDbase nvarchar(50) = 'CFCAIMDevelopment'
-- exec usp_SupportingTables_INITIAL_UPD --> Only updates CFCAIMInitial -- exec usp_SupportingTables_INITIAL_UPD 'SupportingTables' --> Can be used to update any database
BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- * * * When @NewTableName is not null, the records in the initial table are truncated, -- * * * and all the records are copied from development.
IF @NewTableName IS NOT NULL Begin
PRINT 'Backing up ' + @InitialDbase + ' ..... '
SET @SQL = 'BACKUP DATABASE ' + @InitialDbase + ' TO DISK = ' SET @SQL += '''E:\Program Files\Microsoft SQL Server\MSSQL11.SQL2012\MSSQL\Backup\' + @InitialDbase + convert(varchar(8),getdate(), 112) + '.Bak ''' EXEC (@SQL)
-- get IDCol setting SET @IDCol = (SELECT ISNULL((Select TOP 1 is_identity From sys.columns c where c.object_id = ss.object_id and is_nullable = 0), 0) FROM sys.objects ss WHERE type = 'u' and schema_id = 1 and name = @NewTableName)
SET @SQL = 'TRUNCATE TABLE ' + @InitialDbase + '.dbo.' + @NewTableName + ' '
If @IDCol = 1 Begin SELECT @SQL += 'SET IDENTITY_INSERT ' + @InitialDbase + '.dbo.' + @NewTableName + ' ON ' End
SELECT @SQL += 'INSERT INTO ' + @InitialDbase + '.dbo.' + @NewTableName + ' (' + STUFF (( SELECT ', [' + name + ']' FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('' + @NewTableName + '') FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') + ') SELECT ' + STUFF (( SELECT ', D.' + name FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('' + @NewTableName + '') FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') + ' FROM ' + @DevelopDbase + '.dbo.' + @NewTableName + ' D '
If @IDCol = 1 Begin SELECT @SQL += 'SET IDENTITY_INSERT ' + @InitialDbase + '.dbo.' + @NewTableName + ' OFF ' End
--print @sql EXEC (@SQL)
PRINT 'Records inserted into ' + @NewTableName + ' ..... '
GOTO EXITPROC End
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- If @InitialDbase <> 'CFCAIMInitial' GOTO EXITPROC
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- GET TABLE-NAMES FROM SYS.OBJECTS SELECT ss.name, ss.object_id as id , ISNULL((Select TOP 1 name From sys.columns c where c.object_id = ss.object_id and is_nullable = 0), '') as keyname , ISNULL((Select TOP 1 is_identity From sys.columns c where c.object_id = ss.object_id and is_nullable = 0), 0) as idcol , 0 as InitialCount, 0 as RecCount INTO ##TempInitial FROM CFCAIMInitial.sys.objects ss WHERE type = 'u' and schema_id = 1 ORDER BY name
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- LOOP THROUGH TEMP TABLE AND INSERT RECORD COUNTS DECLARE tempcur scroll cursor for SELECT name, id FROM ##TempInitial OPEN tempcur FETCH NEXT FROM tempcur into @Name, @id WHILE @@fetch_status = 0 Begin
------------------------------------------------------------------- -- GET RECORD COUNT FROM INITIAL TABLE SET @SQL = 'Select ''' + @Name + ''' as name, count(*) as RecCount INTO ##CountInitial from ' + @InitialDbase + '.dbo.' + @Name EXEC (@SQL) SET @InitialCount = (SELECT ISNULL(RecCount,0) FROM ##CountInitial)
------------------------------------------------------------------- -- GET RECORD COUNT FROM DEVELOPMENT TABLE SET @SQL = 'Select ''' + @Name + ''' as name, count(*) as RecCount INTO ##Count from ' + @DevelopDbase + '.dbo.' + @Name EXEC (@SQL) SET @RecordCount = (SELECT RecCount FROM ##Count)
------------------------------------------------------------------- -- UPDATE RECORD COUNTS ON TEMP TABLE UPDATE t SET t.InitialCount = CI.RecCount, t.RecCount = C.RecCount FROM ##TempInitial t INNER JOIN ##CountInitial CI on (t.name = CI.name) INNER JOIN ##Count C on (t.name = c.name) WHERE t.name = c.name
DROP TABLE ##CountInitial DROP TABLE ##Count
------------------------------------------------------------------- FETCH NEXT FROM tempcur INTO @Name, @id End CLOSE tempcur DEALLOCATE tempcur
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- REMOVE RECORDS WITH 0 DELETE FROM ##TempInitial WHERE InitialCount = 0
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- COMPARE RECORD COUNTS AND ADD ANY MISSING RECORDS DECLARE compareCur scroll cursor for SELECT name, id, Keyname, idcol, InitialCount, RecCount FROM ##TempInitial ORDER BY name OPEN compareCur FETCH NEXT FROM compareCur INTO @Name, @id, @KeyName, @IDCol, @InitialCount, @RecordCount WHILE @@fetch_status = 0 Begin
--INSERT RECORDS FROM DEVELOPMENT If @RecordCount > @InitialCount Begin PRINT 'Records inserted into ' + @Name + ' ..... ' SET @SQL = '' If @IDCol = 1 Begin SELECT @SQL = 'SET IDENTITY_INSERT ' + @InitialDbase + '.dbo.' + @Name + ' ON ' End
SELECT @SQL += 'INSERT INTO ' + @InitialDbase + '.dbo.' + @Name + ' (' + STUFF (( SELECT ', [' + name + ']' FROM CFCAIMInitial.sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('' + @Name + '') FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') + ') SELECT ' + STUFF (( SELECT ', D.' + name FROM CFCAIMInitial.sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('' + @Name + '') FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') + ' FROM ' + @DevelopDbase + '.dbo.' + @Name + ' D LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.' + @Name + ' I ON D.' + @KeyName + ' = I.' + @KeyName + ' WHERE I.' + @KeyName + ' IS NULL '
If @IDCol = 1 Begin SELECT @SQL += 'SET IDENTITY_INSERT ' + @InitialDbase + '.dbo.' + @Name + ' OFF ' End
--print @sql EXEC (@SQL) End
------------------------------------------------------------------------ -- DELETE RECORDS FROM INITIAL Else If @RecordCount < @InitialCount Begin PRINT 'Records deleted from ' + @Name + ' ..... ' SET @SQL = '' If @IDCol = 1 Begin SELECT @SQL = 'SET IDENTITY_INSERT ' + @InitialDbase + '.dbo.' + @Name + ' ON ' End
SELECT @SQL += 'DELETE ' + @InitialDbase + '.dbo.' + @Name + ' FROM ' + @InitialDbase + '.dbo.' + @Name + ' I LEFT OUTER JOIN ' + @DevelopDbase + '.dbo.' + @Name + ' D ON I.' + @KeyName + ' = D.' + @KeyName + ' WHERE D.' + @KeyName + ' IS NULL '
If @IDCol = 1 Begin SELECT @SQL += 'SET IDENTITY_INSERT ' + @InitialDbase + '.dbo.' + @Name + ' OFF ' End
--print @sql EXEC (@SQL) End
FETCH NEXT FROM compareCur INTO @Name, @id, @KeyName, @IDCol, @InitialCount, @RecordCount End CLOSE compareCur DEALLOCATE compareCur
DROP TABLE ##TempInitial
EXITPROC:
END

DECLARE @SupportingTablesID int = 0 DECLARE @UpdateCount int = 0 DECLARE @GoodRecordCount int = 0 DECLARE @SQL varchar(1000) = '' DECLARE @TableName nvarchar(128) = '' DECLARE @KeyName nvarchar(100) = '' DECLARE @IdentityColumn smallint = 0 DECLARE @DevelopDbase nvarchar(50) = 'CFCAIMDevelopment' DECLARE @system_Type_id int = 0
declare @colName varchar(50) = '' declare @colValue varchar(50) = '' declare @colType varchar(50) = '' declare @colID varchar(50) = '' declare @tableID varchar(50) = '' declare @savetableID varchar(50) = '' declare @pos int = 0 declare @colList NVARCHAR(MAX) = N'' declare @val varchar(1000) = '' declare @keyVal varchar (50) = ''
-- exec usp_SupportingTables_SEL_2 'CFCAIMDemo'
BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
-- create temp ##Table SELECT Space(50) as TableID,Space(50) as ColID,Space(50) as ColName, Space(50) as ColValue,Space(50) as ColType INTO ##Table
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- LOOP THROUGH SUPPORTING TABLE AND INSERT RECORD COUNTS DECLARE tempcur scroll cursor for SELECT SupportingTablesID, TableName, KeyName, IdentityColumn FROM CFCAIMDevelopment.dbo.SupportingTables OPEN tempcur FETCH NEXT FROM tempcur into @SupportingTablesID, @TableName, @KeyName, @IdentityColumn WHILE @@fetch_status = 0 Begin
------------------------------------------------------------------- -- GET RECORD COUNT FROM TABLE ON DBASE TO BE UPDATED SET @SQL = 'Select ''' + @TableName + ''' as name, count(*) as RecCount INTO ##Count From ' + @UpdateDbase + '.dbo.' + @TableName EXEC (@SQL) SET @UpdateCount = (SELECT RecCount FROM ##Count)
------------------------------------------------------------------- -- GET RECORD COUNT FROM DEVELOPMENT TABLE SET @SQL = 'Select ''' + @TableName + ''' as name, count(*) as RecCount INTO ##GoodCount From ' + @DevelopDbase + '.dbo.' + @TableName EXEC(@SQL) SET @GoodRecordCount = (SELECT RecCount FROM ##GoodCount)
------------------------------------------------------------------- --INSERT RECORDS FROM DEVELOPMENT If @GoodRecordCount > @UpdateCount Begin
-- CREATE VALUES TEMP TABLE Set @colList = '' SELECT @colList += N',' + 'D.' + name FROM sys.dm_exec_describe_first_result_set(N'SELECT * FROM ' + @DevelopDbase + '.dbo.' + @tableName, NULL, 1); SET @colList = STUFF(@colList, 1, 1, N'');
set @sql = 'Select ' + @colList + ' Into ##Values FROM ' + @DevelopDbase + '.dbo.' + @TableName + ' D LEFT OUTER JOIN ' + @UpdateDbase + '.dbo.' + @TableName + ' I ON D.' + @KeyName + ' = I.' + @KeyName + ' WHERE I.' + @KeyName + ' IS NULL ' exec (@sql)
-- Reset @colList without the table alias Set @colList = '' SELECT @colList += N',' + name FROM sys.dm_exec_describe_first_result_set(N'SELECT * FROM ' + @DevelopDbase + '.dbo.' + @tableName, NULL, 1); SET @colList = STUFF(@colList, 1, 1, N'')
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------- declare infocur scroll cursor for SELECT ORDINAL_POSITION, COLUMN_NAME, data_type FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME = @tableName ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION open infocur fetch next from infocur into @pos, @colName, @colType while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 Begin
set @colName = (Select COLUMN_NAME from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME = @tableName and ORDINAL_POSITION = @pos) set @tableID =(Select COLUMN_NAME from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME = @tableName and ORDINAL_POSITION = 1)
set @sql = 'Select ' + @tableID + ' as TableID, ' + cast(@pos as varchar) + ' as ColID,''' + @colName + ''' as ColName, ' + @colName + ' as ColValue, ''' + @colType + ''' as ColType ' set @sql += ' from ##values ' Insert into ##Table (TableID, ColID, ColName, ColValue, ColType) exec (@sql) fetch next from infocur into @pos, @colName, @colType End close infocur deallocate infocur
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------- set @keyVal = (Select TOP 1 IsNull(ColValue, '') from ##Table where ColName = @tableID group by ColValue) if @keyVal <> '' Begin if @IdentityColumn = 1 Begin Set @SQL = 'SET IDENTITY_INSERT ' + @UpdateDbase + '.dbo.' + @tablename + ' ON ' print @sql End End
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- LOOP THRU and create select statements declare tempValues scroll cursor for select ColValue from ##Table where ColName = @tableID group by ColValue open tempValues fetch next from tempValues into @keyVal while @@fetch_status = 0 begin
Set @SQL = 'INSERT INTO ' + @UpdateDbase + '.dbo.' + @tableName + ' (' + @colList + ') Values (' set @val = '' declare tempTable scroll cursor for SELECT TableID, ColID, ColName, ColValue, ColType FROM ##TABLE where TableID = @keyVal order by TableID, ColID open tempTable fetch next from tempTable into @tableID, @colID, @colName, @colValue, @colType while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 Begin if @colType = 'nvarchar' or @colType = 'varchar' or @colType = 'nchar' set @val = @val + '''' + @colValue + ''', ' else if @colType = 'datetime' set @val = @val + '''' + convert(varchar,convert(datetime, @colValue), 120) + ''', ' else set @val = @val + @colValue + ', ' fetch next from tempTable into @tableID, @colID, @colName, @colValue, @colType End close tempTable deallocate tempTable fetch next from tempValues into @keyVal
set @val = Left(@Val, Len(@Val) - 1) set @Sql = @SQL + @val + ')'
print @sql
end
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------- if @keyVal <> '' Begin if @IdentityColumn = 1 Begin Set @SQL = 'SET IDENTITY_INSERT ' + @UpdateDbase + '.dbo.' + @tablename + ' OFF ' print @sql End End
close tempValues deallocate tempValues drop table ##Values delete from ##table
End
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- DELETE RECORDS FROM INITIAL Else If @GoodRecordCount < @UpdateCount Begin
if @TableName IN ('DataSourceType', 'DataSourceTypeRefFileType') Set @SQL = 'DELETE ' + @UpdateDbase + '.dbo.' + @TableName + ' FROM ' + @UpdateDbase + '.dbo.' + @TableName + ' I LEFT OUTER JOIN ' + @DevelopDbase + '.dbo.' + @TableName + ' D ON I.' + @KeyName + ' = D.' + @KeyName + ' WHERE D.' + @KeyName + ' IS NULL AND D.DataSourceTypeID < 10000 '
Else Set @SQL = 'DELETE ' + @UpdateDbase + '.dbo.' + @TableName + ' FROM ' + @UpdateDbase + '.dbo.' + @TableName + ' I LEFT OUTER JOIN ' + @DevelopDbase + '.dbo.' + @TableName + ' D ON I.' + @KeyName + ' = D.' + @KeyName + ' WHERE D.' + @KeyName + ' IS NULL '
PRINT @SQL
End
DROP TABLE ##Count DROP TABLE ##GoodCount
FETCH NEXT FROM tempcur into @SupportingTablesID, @TableName, @KeyName, @IdentityColumn End
close tempcur deallocate tempcur drop table ##table
/* close infocur deallocate infocur close tempTable deallocate tempTable close tempValues deallocate tempValues drop table ##Values delete from ##table DROP TABLE ##Count DROP TABLE ##GoodCount close tempcur deallocate tempcur drop table ##table
*/
END

BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON; DECLARE @ErrorNumber INT = 0 DECLARE @ErrorMessage VARCHAR(200) = '' DECLARE @TempTable TABLE(TID INT, TOrder INT); DECLARE @DuplicateFound BIT = 1;
INSERT INTO dbo.TabOrder ( UserID , ControlID , TabOrder ) SELECT @UserID , ControlID , 0 FROM dbo.Control WHERE FormID = @FormID END

Property.Name: BodyScript

BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
SELECT T.TabOrderID , T.TabOrder , T.UserID , T.UpdateStamp , F.FormID , F.FormName , C.ControlID , C.ControlName , C.UserControlName , case when X.AlternateName is not null then X.AlternateName else C.UserControlName End as AlternateName , U.UserName
-- 9/30/22 , X.ShowCodeNameOrBothID
FROM dbo.Form F WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.Control C WITH(NOLOCK) ON C.FormID = F.FormID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.TabOrder T WITH(NOLOCK) ON T.ControlID = C.ControlID LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT T.UserControlName, AN.AlternateName
-- 9/30/22 , AN.ShowCodeNameOrBothID
FROM dbo.Control T WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN dbo.AlternateName AN with (nolock) on T.ControlID = AN.ControlID WHERE T.AllowAlternateName = 1) X ON C.UserControlName = X.UserControlName LEFT OUTER JOIN CFCUser.CFCUser U WITH(NOLOCK) ON T.CFCUserID = U.CFCUserID
WHERE F.FormID = @FormID AND T.UserID = @UserID and C.AllowTabOrder = 1
ORDER BY T.TabOrder

-- exec usp_TabOrder_SEL_FormID 1, 1
AS

Property.Value:
BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
SELECT T.TabOrderID , T.TabOrder , T.UserID , T.UpdateStamp , F.FormID , F.FormName , C.ControlID , C.ControlName , C.UserControlName , case when X.AlternateName is not null then X.AlternateName else C.UserControlName End as AlternateName , U.UserName , X.ShowCodeNameOrBothID
FROM dbo.Form F WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.Control C WITH(NOLOCK) ON C.FormID = F.FormID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.TabOrder T WITH(NOLOCK) ON T.ControlID = C.ControlID LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT T.UserControlName, AN.AlternateName
-- 9/30/22 , AN.ShowCodeNameOrBothID
FROM dbo.Control T WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN dbo.AlternateName AN with (nolock) on T.ControlID = AN.ControlID WHERE T.AllowAlternateName = 1) X ON C.UserControlName = X.UserControlName LEFT OUTER JOIN CFCUser.CFCUser U WITH(NOLOCK) ON T.CFCUserID = U.CFCUserID
WHERE F.FormID = @FormID AND T.UserID = @UserID and T.TabOrder >= @TabOrder and C.AllowTabOrder = 1
ORDER BY T.TabOrder
END
