Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value: BEGIN SELECT T.TestID, T.TestCode, T.TestName, T.DataSourceTypeID, DS.DataSourceTypeCode AS DataSourceTypeName, T.TestCurrentCost, T.TestPreviousCost, T.UpdateStamp, T.CFCUserID, U.UserName FROM dbo.Test T INNER JOIN dbo.DataSourceType DS ON T.DataSourceTypeID = DS.DataSourceTypeID INNER JOIN CFCuser.CFCUser U ON U.CFCUserID = T.CFCUserID END;

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value:
--DECLARE @IsGrouped BIT = 0 -- ,@StartDate DATETIME = '3/25/26' -- ,@EndDate DATETIME = '3/27/26' -- ,@AIMOwnerLocationID INT = 7
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#CostAnalysis') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #CostAnalysis
SELECT S.SampleID ,S.SampleCode ,S.SampleDate ,AOL.LocationName ,T.TestCode ,T.TestName ,T.DataSourceTypeID ,S.AIMMaterialID ,M.AIMMaterialCode ,MT.MaterialTypeName ,ISNULL(NC.AIMNutrientID, 0) AS AIMNutrientID ,CONCAT(ISNULL(NC.TestGroupName, ''), ISNULL(NC.AIMNutrientName, '')) AS AIMNutrientName ,T.TestCurrentCost AS TestCurrentCost ,ISNULL(MC.TestMaterialCurrentUpcharge, 0) AS TestMaterialCurrentUpcharge ,ISNULL(NC.TestNutrientResultCurrentUpcharge, 0) AS TestNutrientResultCurrentUpcharge
,T.TestCurrentCost + ISNULL(MC.TestMaterialCurrentUpcharge, 0) + ISNULL(NC.TestNutrientResultCurrentUpcharge, 0) AS TotalCost
INTO #CostAnalysis FROM dbo.Sample S
INNER JOIN dbo.AIMOwnerLocation AOL ON AOL.AIMOwnerLocationID = S.AIMOwnerLocationID
INNER JOIN dbo.AIMMaterial M ON M.AIMMaterialID = S.AIMMaterialID
LEFT JOIN dbo.MaterialType MT ON MT.MaterialTypeID = M.MaterialTypeID
INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT SR.SampleID ,T.TestID FROM dbo.SampleResult SR INNER JOIN dbo.AIMNutrientRefAnalyzerNutrient ANRAN ON ANRAN.AnalyzerNutrientID = SR.AnalyzerNutrientID INNER JOIN dbo.AnalyzerNutrient AN ON AN.AnalyzerNutrientID = ANRAN.AnalyzerNutrientID INNER JOIN dbo.Test T ON T.DataSourceTypeID = AN.DataSourceTypeID WHERE SR.IsActive = 1 AND SR.AnalysisDate > @StartDate AND SR.AnalysisDate < @EndDate ) ST ON ST.SampleID = S.SampleID
INNER JOIN dbo.Test T ON T.TestID = ST.TestID
OUTER APPLY ( SELECT SUM(TM.TestMaterialCurrentUpcharge) AS TestMaterialCurrentUpcharge FROM dbo.TestMaterial TM WHERE TM.TestID = T.TestID AND TM.AIMMaterialID = S.AIMMaterialID ) MC
OUTER APPLY ( SELECT SUM(TNR.TestNutrientResultCurrentUpcharge) AS TestNutrientResultCurrentUpcharge ,STRING_AGG(CAST(N.AIMNutrientID AS VARCHAR(20)), ',') AS AIMNutrientID ,STRING_AGG(N.AIMNutrientName, ', ') AS AIMNutrientName ,STRING_AGG(TGN.TestGroupName, ',') AS TestGroupName FROM dbo.SampleResult SR INNER JOIN dbo.AIMNutrientRefAnalyzerNutrient ANRAN ON ANRAN.AnalyzerNutrientID = SR.AnalyzerNutrientID INNER JOIN dbo.AIMNutrient N ON N.AIMNutrientID = ANRAN.AIMNutrientID INNER JOIN dbo.TestNutrientResult TNR ON TNR.TestID = T.TestID AND TNR.AIMNutrientID = ANRAN.AIMNutrientID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.TestGroupName TGN ON TGN.TestGroupNameID = TNR.TestGroupNameID WHERE SR.SampleID = S.SampleID AND SR.IsActive = 1 AND SR.AnalysisDate > @StartDate AND SR.AnalysisDate < @EndDate ) NC
WHERE S.AIMOwnerLocationID = @AIMOwnerLocationID AND ( T.TestCurrentCost + ISNULL(MC.TestMaterialCurrentUpcharge, 0) + ISNULL(NC.TestNutrientResultCurrentUpcharge, 0) ) > 0
IF @IsGrouped = 1 BEGIN SELECT 0 as SampleID ,'' AS SampleCode ,CAST('0001-01-01' AS datetime2) AS SampleDate ,LocationName ,TestCode ,TestName ,DataSourceTypeID ,AIMMaterialID ,AIMMaterialCode ,MaterialTypeName ,ISNULL(AIMNutrientID, 0) AS AIMNutrientID ,ISNULL(AIMNutrientName, '') AS AIMNutrientName ,Count(*) AS NumberOfTest ,TestCurrentCost AS TestCurrentCost ,ISNULL(TestMaterialCurrentUpcharge, 0) AS TestMaterialCurrentUpcharge ,ISNULL(TestNutrientResultCurrentUpcharge, 0) AS TestNutrientResultCurrentUpcharge ,TestCurrentCost + ISNULL(TestMaterialCurrentUpcharge, 0) + ISNULL(TestNutrientResultCurrentUpcharge, 0) AS Cost ,SUM(TestCurrentCost + ISNULL(TestMaterialCurrentUpcharge, 0) + ISNULL(TestNutrientResultCurrentUpcharge, 0)) AS CostTotal
FROM #CostAnalysis
GROUP BY LocationName ,TestCode ,TestName ,DataSourceTypeID ,AIMMaterialID ,AIMMaterialCode ,MaterialTypeName ,AIMNutrientID ,AIMNutrientName ,TestCurrentCost ,TestMaterialCurrentUpcharge ,TestNutrientResultCurrentUpcharge
ORDER BY MaterialTypeName DESC ,AIMMaterialCode ,TestCode ,AIMNutrientName
END ELSE BEGIN SELECT SampleID ,SampleCode ,SampleDate ,LocationName ,TestCode ,TestName ,DataSourceTypeID ,AIMMaterialID ,AIMMaterialCode ,MaterialTypeName ,ISNULL(AIMNutrientID, 0) AS AIMNutrientID ,ISNULL(AIMNutrientName, '') AS AIMNutrientName ,1 AS NumberOfTest ,TestCurrentCost AS TestCurrentCost ,ISNULL(TestMaterialCurrentUpcharge, 0) AS TestMaterialCurrentUpcharge ,ISNULL(TestNutrientResultCurrentUpcharge, 0) AS TestNutrientResultCurrentUpcharge ,TestCurrentCost + ISNULL(TestMaterialCurrentUpcharge, 0) + ISNULL(TestNutrientResultCurrentUpcharge, 0) AS Cost ,TestCurrentCost + ISNULL(TestMaterialCurrentUpcharge, 0) + ISNULL(TestNutrientResultCurrentUpcharge, 0) AS CostTotal FROM #CostAnalysis ORDER BY MaterialTypeName DESC ,AIMMaterialCode ,TestCode ,TestName ,SampleCode END
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#CostAnalysis') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #CostAnalysis

ELSE Begin UPDATE dbo.UpdateIngredientDetail SET Status = case when CN.IsComputed = 1 then 3 Else case when D.IsOverlay = 0 then 4 Else @Status End End FROM dbo.CFCNutrient CN INNER JOIN dbo.UpdateIngredientDetail D ON D.CFCNutrientID = CN.CFCNutrientID WHERE UpdateIngredientHeaderID = @UpdateIngredientHeaderID End

Begin SET @Status = 4 SET @ResultNumber = 4 End

DECLARE @ErrorNumber INT = 0 DECLARE @ErrorMessage VARCHAR(200) = '' DECLARE @RecordID INT = 0
UPDATE dbo.UpdateIngredientDetail SET IsOverlay = CASE WHEN ISNULL(CNO.CFCIngredientNutrientOverlayID, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END FROM dbo.UpdateIngredientDetail D LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.CFCIngredientNutrientOverlay CNO ON CNO.CFCPlantID = D.CFCPlantID AND CNO.CFCIngredientID = D.CFCIngredientID AND CNO.CFCNutrientID = D.CFCNutrientID WHERE D.UpdateIngredientHeaderID = @UpdateIngredientHeaderID AND D.IsOverlay != CASE WHEN ISNULL(CNO.CFCIngredientNutrientOverlayID, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
SET @ErrorNumber = @@ERROR

SELECT @RecordID AS RecordID , @@ERROR AS ErrorNumber , @ErrorMessage AS ErrorMessage
END

Property.Name: QueryScript
Property.Value: SELECT C.IsActive , C.AIMMaterialID , C.AIMNutrientID , ROUND((Max(Q1NextVal) - MAX(Q1Val)) * Max(Q1Frac) + Max(Q1Val), 4) AS Quartile1 , ROUND((Max(Q3NextVal) - MAX(Q3Val)) * Max(Q3Frac) + Max(Q3Val), 4) AS Quartile3 , ROUND(AVG(AIMUsedValue), 4) AS Mean , ROUND(STDEV(AIMUsedValue), 4) AS StandardDeviation , MIN(AIMUsedValue) AS Min , MAX(AIMUsedValue) AS Max , ROUND(AVG(AIMUsedValue) + (1.96 * STDEV(AIMUsedValue) / SQRT(COUNT(*))), 4) AS Upper95Mean , ROUND(AVG(AIMUsedValue) - (1.96 * STDEV(AIMUsedValue) / SQRT(COUNT(*))), 4) AS Lower95Mean , ROUND(AVG(AIMUsedValue) + (1.645 * STDEV(AIMUsedValue) / SQRT(COUNT(*))), 4) AS Upper90Mean , ROUND(AVG(AIMUsedValue) - (1.645 * STDEV(AIMUsedValue) / SQRT(COUNT(*))), 4) AS Lower90Mean , ROUND(AVG(AIMUsedValue) + .5 * STDEV(AIMUsedValue), 4) AS MeanPlusStandardDeviation , ROUND(AVG(AIMUsedValue) - .5 * STDEV(AIMUsedValue), 4) AS MeanMinusStandardDeviation FROM (SELECT D.IsActive , D.AIMMaterialID , D.AIMNutrientID , CASE WHEN RowNum = Q1Idx THEN AIMUsedValue ELSE NULL END AS Q1Val , CASE WHEN RowNum = Q1Idx + 1 THEN AIMUsedValue ELSE NULL END AS Q1NextVal , CASE WHEN RowNum = Q3Idx THEN AIMUsedValue ELSE NULL END AS Q3Val , CASE WHEN RowNum = Q3Idx + 1 THEN AIMUsedValue ELSE NULL END AS Q3NextVal , Q1Frac , Q3Frac , AIMUsedValue FROM /*Calculate a row number sorted by measure for each group.*/ (SELECT SA.AIMUsedValue , SA.IsActive , S.AIMMaterialID , SA.AIMNutrientID , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SA.IsActive, S.AIMMaterialID, SA.AIMNutrientID ORDER BY AIMUsedValue) AS RowNum FROM dbo.Sample S WITH(NOLOCK) INNER JOIN dbo.SampleAIM SA WITH(NOLOCK) ON SA.SampleID = S.SampleID) D INNER JOIN (/*the values at the quartile points.*/ SELECT SA.IsActive , S.AIMMaterialID , SA.AIMNutrientID , FLOOR((COUNT(*) + 3) / 4.0) AS Q1Idx , ((COUNT(*) + 3) / 4.0) - FLOOR((COUNT(*) + 3) / 4.0) AS Q1Frac , FLOOR((COUNT(*) * 3 + 1) / 4.0) AS Q3Idx , ((COUNT(*) * 3 + 1) / 4.0) - FLOOR((COUNT(*) * 3 + 1) / 4.0) AS Q3Frac FROM dbo.Sample S WITH(NOLOCK) INNER JOIN dbo.SampleAIM SA WITH(NOLOCK) ON SA.SampleID = S.SampleID WHERE S.IsActive = 1 GROUP BY SA.IsActive , S.AIMMaterialID , SA.AIMNutrientID HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS S ON D.IsActive = S.IsActive AND D.AIMMaterialID = S.AIMMaterialID AND D.AIMNutrientID = S.AIMNutrientID) AS C GROUP BY C.IsActive , C.AIMMaterialID , C.AIMNutrientID
